title: Atrial Fibrillation
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common sustained arrhythmia that requires treatment. ~3–4% of patients aged 65–75 years have clinical AF, and 10% of patients aged 80 years or older have clinical AF; 4% of patients with heart failure (HF) functional class I and 50% of patients with functional class IV have AF. AF is typically initiated by one or more premature atrial complexes, often originating around the pulmonary veins, or by atrial tachycardia or atrial flutter. Age >65, obesity, and hypertension are the 3 most common factors associated with AF on a population basis; coronary artery disease (CAD) and HF are the most common associated features in hospital series. There are 3 types of AF: paroxysmal, persistent, and permanent. The risk of stroke in the peri-cardioversion period is ~8%, reduced to <0.5% with appropriate anticoagulation. As highlighted by CASTLE-AF, AF burden is a key concept in patients with off-and-on AF.

AI.tldr: 本文综述房颤的流行病学、触发机制、分型及卒中风险，强调房颤负荷是间歇性房颤患者的关键概念。
AI.motivation: 房颤是最常见的需治疗持续性心律失常，既往证据在房颤负荷的临床意义及围复律期卒中风险方面仍需系统梳理，以指导临床决策。
AI.method: 本文为综述性文章，未报告原始研究设计、样本量、干预措施及统计方法；摘要未报告具体检索策略与终点定义。
AI.result: 65–75岁人群临床房颤患病率约3–4%，80岁及以上约10%；心功能I级心衰患者中4%、IV级中50%合并房颤。年龄>65岁、肥胖、高血压是人群层面最常见的相关因素，冠心病与心衰是医院系列中最常见的伴随特征。房颤分为阵发性、持续性和永久性三型。围心脏复律期卒中风险约8%，规范抗凝后可降至<0.5%。CASTLE-AF研究提示房颤负荷是间歇性房颤患者的关键概念。
AI.conclusion: 房颤患病率随年龄及心衰分级升高而显著增加，规范抗凝可大幅降低围复律期卒中风险；房颤负荷应作为间歇性房颤患者评估与管理的重要指标。本文为综述，未提供原始数据，相关结论需结合具体研究解读。

summary_zh: 心房颤动（AF）是需要治疗的最常见持续性心律失常。约3–4%的65–75岁患者患有临床AF，10%的80岁及以上患者患有临床AF；4%的心力衰竭（HF）功能I级患者和50%的功能IV级患者患有AF。AF通常由一个或多个房性期前复合波引发，这些复合波常起源于肺静脉周围，或由房性心动过速或心房扑动引发。年龄>65岁、肥胖和高血压是基于人群的AF相关的3个最常见因素；冠状动脉疾病（CAD）和HF是医院系列中最常见的相关特征。AF有3种类型：阵发性、持续性和永久性。围心脏复律期卒中风险约为8%，通过适当的抗凝治疗可降至<0.5%。正如CASTLE-AF所强调的，AF负荷是阵发性和持续性AF患者的一个关键概念。

title: Atrial Flutter and Atrial Tachycardia
summary: Typical atrial flutter (Aflutter) is characterized by a macroreentrant RA circuit that runs in a frontal, right-to-left plane, the base of which is a narrow isthmus bordered by the IVC and crista terminalis posteriorly and the tricuspid annulus anteriorly (cavotricuspid isthmus, CTI). Atrial tachycardia (AT) may be initiated by 3 different mechanisms: microreentry, automaticity, and triggered activity. The frequency of each of these mechanisms varies according to different studies, with each mechanism probably accounting for a third of atrial tachycardias. Multifocal atrial tachycardia (MAT) is usually associated with acute pulmonary (COPD exacerbation) or cardiac issues (HF), electrolyte disorders, drugs (theophylline, digoxin), or sepsis. An ectopic atrial rhythm is an automatic atrial rhythm characterized by an atrial rate < 100 bpm and a non-sinus P-wave morphology. It implies that a quiescent atrial pacemaker is starting to fire at a rate faster than the sinus rate.

AI.tldr: 本文为综述，系统阐述典型心房扑动的三尖瓣峡部依赖大折返机制，以及房性心动过速的三种发生机制与多源性房速的临床诱因。
AI.motivation: 典型心房扑动与房性心动过速是房颤消融领域常见的房性快速性心律失常，但两者在电生理机制、折返环路解剖及临床诱因上存在差异，临床需要清晰区分以指导标测与消融策略；既往文献对房速各机制所占比例报道不一，缺乏统一认识。
AI.method: 本文为叙述性综述，未涉及原始研究人群、样本量与统计方法。摘要未报告具体检索策略与纳入文献数量。内容涵盖：典型心房扑动为右房大折返环路，走行于额面、由右向左平面，环路基底为下腔静脉与界嵴（后界）和三尖瓣环（前界）之间的三尖瓣峡部；房速机制分为微折返、自律性与触发活动三类，各机制在不同研究中比例不一，可能各约占三分之一；多源性房速常与慢性阻塞性肺疾病急性加重、心力衰竭、电解质紊乱、茶碱或地高辛等药物及脓毒症相关；异位房性心律为自律性房性心律，心房率<100 bpm，P波形态非窦性。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量研究数据、效应量、95%置信区间或P值。定性要点为：典型心房扑动依赖三尖瓣峡部大折返环路；房速三种机制（微折返、自律性、触发活动）在不同研究中频率各异，可能各占约三分之一；多源性房速与肺部急性事件（COPD急性加重）、心力衰竭、电解质紊乱、茶碱/地高辛及脓毒症相关；异位房性心律定义为心房率<100 bpm且P波形态非窦性的自律性房性心律，提示静息心房起搏点以快于窦性频率发放冲动。
AI.conclusion: 综述强调依据电生理机制与解剖环路区分典型心房扑动与各型房速，三尖瓣峡部是典型房扑消融的关键靶点，而房速需按微折返、自律性或触发活动机制选择标测与消融策略；多源性房速应优先处理COPD、心力衰竭、电解质紊乱、药物及脓毒症等诱因。局限性在于本文为叙述性综述，未提供原始研究数据与定量证据，结论主要基于机制层面的归纳。

summary_zh: 典型心房扑动（Aflutter）的特征是右心房内一个呈额面、从右向左走行的大折返环路，其基底部为一条狭窄的峡部，后方以IVC和界嵴为界，前方以三尖瓣环为界（腔静脉三尖瓣峡部，CTI）。房性心动过速（AT）可由3种不同机制诱发：微折返、自律性和触发活动。每种机制的发生频率因不同研究而异，每种机制可能各占房性心动过速的三分之一。多源性房性心动过速（MAT）通常与急性肺部问题（COPD加重）或心脏问题（HF）、电解质紊乱、药物（茶碱、地高辛）或脓毒症相关。异位心房节律是一种自律性心房节律，其特征为心房率<100次/分和非窦性P波形态。它意味着一个静止的心房起搏点开始以快于窦性频率的频率发放冲动。

title: Basic Electrophysiologic Study
summary: This chapter focuses on four main catheters are used: right atrial catheter, right ventricular catheter, His catheter, and coronary sinus catheter. These catheters record electrograms and may also be used for pacing. In the electrophysiology lab, the atrioventricular conduction may be stressed using the incremental pacing or the extrastimulus technique or drugs. An accessory pathway connects the atrium and the ventricle. The accessory pathway may conduct from the atrium all the way to the ventricle at baseline, or may only partially conduct and not reach the ventricle. Atrial flutter is characterized by a macroreentrant right atrial circuit that runs in a frontal, right-to-left plane, the base of which is a narrow isthmus bordered by the IVC and crista terminalis posteriorly and the tricuspid annulus anteriorly. In patients with structural heart disease and unexplained syncope, one should attempt to induce ventricular tachycardia.

AI.tldr: 本章系统介绍基础电生理检查的四导管配置与起搏刺激方法，并概述房室传导评估、旁路定位、典型房扑折返环及结构性心脏病不明晕厥的室速诱发指征。
AI.motivation: 面向电生理初学者与临床医生，梳理基础电生理检查的核心操作框架，明确如何通过导管记录与起搏刺激评估房室传导、识别旁路及房扑机制，并回答结构性心脏病合并不明晕厥时是否应行室速诱发这一临床问题。
AI.method: 本章为教科书式综述，未报告研究类型、样本量或统计方法。内容涉及：常规放置右房、右室、His束及冠状窦四根导管，用于记录电图并可行起搏；采用递增起搏、期外刺激技术或药物负荷评估房室传导；描述旁路可自心房全程传导至心室或仅部分传导；描述典型房扑为右房大折返环，呈额面右向左平面，其基底部为下腔静脉与界嵴（后）及三尖瓣环（前）包绕的狭窄峡部；对结构性心脏病合并不明晕厥者应尝试诱发室速。
AI.result: 摘要未报告任何定量数据、效应量、置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 本章强调四导管基础配置与起搏刺激是电生理检查的基石，旁路传导程度与房扑峡部解剖是标测与消融的关键，结构性心脏病不明晕厥患者应行室速诱发试验。作为教学性章节，其结论基于经验总结而非原始研究数据，缺乏证据等级与统计支持，临床推广时需结合具体指南与个体化评估。

summary_zh: 本章重点介绍使用的四种主要导管：右心房导管、右心室导管、希氏束导管和冠状窦导管。这些导管记录电图，也可用于起搏。在电生理实验室中，可通过递增起搏或额外刺激技术或药物来评估房室传导。旁路连接心房和心室。旁路在基线时可能从心房一直传导至心室，也可能仅部分传导而未到达心室。心房扑动的特征是一个右心房大折返环路，该环路在额面从右向左走行，其基底部是一个狭窄的峡部，后界为下腔静脉和界嵴，前界为三尖瓣环。对于结构性心脏病和不明原因晕厥的患者，应尝试诱发室性心动过速。

title: Investigating Factors Associated with the Occurrence of Atrial Fibrillation after Non-cardiothoracic Surgery
summary: Background Although the occurrence of atrial fibrillation (AF) after cardiac and thoracic surgery is common and leads to serious complications such as patients' vital organ dysfunction, pulmonary edema, myocardial infarction, and death, evidence about the occurrence and risk factors associated with post-operative atrial fibrillation (POAF) as new AF immediately after non-cardiac thoracic surgery is limited. Therefore, the present study aimed at investigating the factors related to the occurrence of POAF after non-cardiothoracic surgery.Materials and methods The present retrospective study was conducted on 272 patients undergoing non-cardiothoracic surgeries during 2007-2020. Patients' basic and clinical information including age, sex, BMI, addiction, comorbidities, history of non-cardiac thoracic surgery, history of cardiac surgery, history of chronic kidney disease (CKD), history of ischemic heart disease (IHD), history of heart failure (HF), valvular heart disease (VHD), and the occurrence or non-occurrence of POAF was extracted from their records and then documented.Results In the present study, 48.1% and 51.9% of patients were with and without POAF, respectively. Risk factors associated with increasing the odds of POAF occurrence included age (OR = 1.094), anemia (OR = 3.947), IHD (OR = 4.23), CKD (OR = 4.765), VHD (OR = 4.781), pulmonary diseases (OR = 7.828), hypertension (HTN) (OR = 8.336), HF (OR = 11.790), and post-thoracic surgery (OR = 49.072) (P-value < 0.05).Conclusion According to the results of the present study, aging, comorbidities (i.e., anemia, pulmonary diseases, HTN, and CKD), heart diseases (i.e., IHD, VHD, and HF), and post-thoracic surgery were among the most significant risk factors associated with the increased occurrence of POAF.

AI.tldr: 非心胸外科术后房颤发生率高达48.1%，年龄、贫血、高血压、心衰及既往胸部手术史是显著危险因素。
AI.motivation: 心脏和胸科术后房颤常见且导致严重并发症，但非心胸外科术后新发房颤（POAF）的发生率和危险因素证据有限，本研究旨在填补这一缺口。
AI.method: 回顾性研究纳入2007-2020年接受非心胸外科手术的272例患者，从病历中提取年龄、性别、BMI、成瘾史、合并症、非心脏胸科手术史、心脏手术史、慢性肾病（CKD）、缺血性心脏病（IHD）、心衰（HF）、瓣膜性心脏病（VHD）及POAF发生情况，分析POAF相关因素。
AI.result: POAF发生率为48.1%。与POAF风险增加相关的因素包括：年龄（OR=1.094）、贫血（OR=3.947）、IHD（OR=4.23）、CKD（OR=4.765）、VHD（OR=4.781）、肺部疾病（OR=7.828）、高血压（OR=8.336）、HF（OR=11.790）及胸部手术史（OR=49.072），均P<0.05。摘要未报告各OR的95%置信区间。
AI.conclusion: 高龄、合并症（贫血、肺部疾病、高血压、CKD）、心脏病（IHD、VHD、HF）及胸部手术史是非心胸外科术后POAF的显著危险因素。临床应重视高危患者围术期监测与预防，但本研究为单中心回顾性设计，结论需前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：尽管心脏和胸科手术后心房颤动（AF）的发生很常见，并导致患者重要器官功能障碍、肺水肿、心肌梗死和死亡等严重并发症，但关于非心脏胸科手术后新发AF即术后心房颤动（POAF）的发生及相关危险因素的证据有限。因此，本研究旨在探讨非心胸外科手术后POAF发生的相关因素。

材料与方法：本回顾性研究纳入2007-2020年间接受非心胸外科手术的272例患者。从记录中提取患者的基本和临床信息，包括年龄、性别、BMI、成瘾性、合并症、非心脏胸科手术史、心脏手术史、慢性肾脏病（CKD）史、缺血性心脏病（IHD）史、心力衰竭（HF）史、瓣膜性心脏病（VHD）以及POAF发生与否，并进行记录。

结果：在本研究中，48.1%和51.9%的患者分别发生和未发生POAF。与增加POAF发生几率相关的危险因素包括年龄（OR = 1.094）、贫血（OR = 3.947）、IHD（OR = 4.23）、CKD（OR = 4.765）、VHD（OR = 4.781）、肺部疾病（OR = 7.828）、高血压（HTN）（OR = 8.336）、HF（OR = 11.790）和胸科手术后（OR = 49.072）（P值 < 0.05）。

结论：根据本研究结果，衰老、合并症（即贫血、肺部疾病、HTN和CKD）、心脏疾病（即IHD、VHD和HF）以及胸科手术后是与POAF发生增加相关的最重要危险因素。

title: Top 20 Research Studies of 2025 for Primary Care Physicians.
summary: This article summarizes the top 20 research studies of 2025 identified as POEMs (patient-oriented evidence that matters). Treating male sex partners of female patients with oral and topical medication reduces recurrence of bacterial vaginosis. Anti-influenza drugs do not reduce hospitalizations or mortality. COVID-19 vaccines still improve mortality and reduce hospitalizations. Influenza vaccines are safe in pregnancy. Vaginal estrogen appears to be safe in breast cancer survivors. Women with normal bone density given zoledronic acid every 5 years have fewer fractures. Early post-partum insertion of a long-acting reversible contraceptive is associated with fewer pregnancies vs delayed insertion. Early medication abortion before pregnancy confirmation is safe and effective. After stent placement in patients with atherosclerotic coronary vascular disease who are taking an anticoagulant, adding aspirin worsens outcomes. After catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation, discontinuing anticoagulants after 1 year is safe if atrial arrhythmia does not recur, whereas left atrial appendage closure is superior to oral anticoagulation. For patients with provoked venous thromboembolism and at least one ongoing risk factor, 12 months of apixaban is better than 3 months. Clopidogrel is slightly more effective than aspirin for the secondary prevention of myocardial infarction and stroke over 3 years. Intensive blood pressure lowering decreases cardiovascular events but increases rates of hypotension and syncope, and there are concerns about the applicability of the data to the United States. Duloxetine, milnacipran, and pregabalin provide meaningful pain reduction in adults with fibromyalgia. Amyloid-directed monoclonal antibodies do not provide clinically meaningful cognitive benefits and may cause harms. Bright light therapy is effective for nonseasonal depression. Water exposure 6 hours after cutaneous surgery does not increase the risk of complications. A meta-analysis of platelet-rich plasma injections for knee osteoarthritis concluded that high-quality studies found no meaningful pain improvement. Using an oral challenge to rule out sulfonamide allergy is safe when used with a risk assessment tool.

AI.tldr: 房颤消融后1年无复发可安全停用抗凝，左心耳封堵优于口服抗凝；但该文为基层研究汇总，证据细节有限。
AI.motivation: 为基层医生梳理2025年具有患者导向证据（POEM）的高影响力研究，其中房颤消融术后抗凝管理策略缺乏明确共识，需评估停用抗凝与左心耳封堵的安全性及有效性。
AI.method: 本文为年度研究汇总（非原始研究），纳入20项POEM研究；房颤相关部分涉及导管消融术后患者，比较停用抗凝（1年无房性心律失常复发）与继续抗凝，以及左心耳封堵与口服抗凝；具体样本量、终点定义及统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值；仅定性指出：消融后1年无房性心律失常复发者停用抗凝安全，左心耳封堵优于口服抗凝。
AI.conclusion: 房颤消融后无复发患者可考虑1年后停用抗凝，左心耳封堵可作为口服抗凝的替代选择；但证据来自汇总性描述，缺乏原始数据，临床决策需结合个体化评估。

summary_zh: 本文总结了2025年被评为POEMs（以患者为导向的重要证据）的20项顶级研究。对女性细菌性阴道病患者的男性性伴侣进行口服和外用药物治疗可减少细菌性阴道病的复发。抗流感药物不能降低住院率或死亡率。COVID-19疫苗仍可改善死亡率并减少住院。流感疫苗在妊娠期是安全的。阴道雌激素在乳腺癌幸存者中似乎是安全的。骨密度正常的女性每5年给予一次唑来膦酸可减少骨折。产后早期放置长效可逆避孕药与延迟放置相比，妊娠次数更少。在确认妊娠前进行早期药物流产是安全有效的。动脉粥样硬化性冠状动脉血管疾病患者在接受抗凝治疗并放置支架后，加用阿司匹林会使结局恶化。心房颤动导管消融后，如果房性心律失常未复发，1年后停用抗凝药是安全的，而左心耳封堵优于口服抗凝。对于诱发性静脉血栓栓塞且至少有一项持续危险因素的患者，阿哌沙班治疗12个月优于3个月。氯吡格雷在心肌梗死和卒中3年二级预防方面略优于阿司匹林。强化降压可减少心血管事件，但会增加低血压和晕厥的发生率，并且有人担心这些数据对美国的适用性。度洛西汀、米那普仑和普瑞巴林可对成人纤维肌痛产生有意义的疼痛减轻。靶向淀粉样蛋白的单克隆抗体不能提供有临床意义的认知获益，并可能造成伤害。明亮光疗法对非季节性抑郁症有效。皮肤手术后6小时接触水不会增加并发症风险。一项关于富血小板血浆注射治疗膝骨关节炎的荟萃分析得出结论，高质量研究未发现有意义的疼痛改善。当与风险评估工具一起使用时，使用口服激发试验排除磺胺类药物过敏是安全的。

title: Lipoperoxidation processes and antioxidant defense factors in plasma and erythrocytes in patients with comorbid metabolic syndrome and atrial fibrillation
summary: Background . Metabolic syndrome (MetS) and atrial fibrillation (AF) are interrelated pathologies, oxidative stress plays important role in their pathogenesis. However, a comprehensive assessment of the lipid peroxidationantioxidant defense (LPO-AOD) system in both plasma and erythrocytes in comorbid MetS and AF remains insufficiently studied. Objective . To conduct a comparative study of the features of the LPO-AOD system in plasma and erythrocytes in patients with both MetS and AF, relative to patients with MetS (without AF), AF (without MetS), and healthy individuals. Design and methods . A cross-sectional observational case-control study included 237 individuals aged 55–70 years, divided into 4 groups: MetS without AF (n = 50), MetS with AF (n = 89), AF without MetS (n = 48), and a comparison group (apparently healthy individuals, n = 50). The concentration of TBARS and the activity of superoxide dismutase (SOD) and catalase (CAT) were determined in plasma and erythrocytes using spectrophotometric methods according to the validated modifications. Results . In all patient groups, SOD and CAT activity in erythrocytes was significantly lower than in the comparison group (p < 0,001), with no significant differences between the patient groups. The TBARS level in erythrocytes was lower in the AF without MetS group. In all patient groups, the TBARS plasma level was significantly higher, while SOD and CAT activity was lower than in the comparison group. The most pronounced increase in plasma TBARS was noted in the group with comorbid MetS and AF. Conclusion . The comorbid MetS and AF are characterized by an imbalance in the LPO-AOD system, manifesting as a predominance of extracellular lipoperoxidation (elevated plasma TBARS) and suppression of antioxidant defense in both erythrocytes and plasma. The identified alterations, particularly the maximal increase in TBARS and decrease in CAT activity in plasma, may provide a rationale for considering antioxidant therapy.

AI.tldr: 合并代谢综合征与房颤患者存在脂质过氧化/抗氧化防御系统失衡，表现为血浆TBARS升高最显著及红细胞和血浆抗氧化酶活性降低。
AI.motivation: 代谢综合征（MetS）和房颤（AF）相互关联，氧化应激在两者发病机制中起重要作用，但合并MetS和AF患者血浆和红细胞中脂质过氧化-抗氧化防御（LPO-AOD）系统的综合评估尚不充分。
AI.method: 横断面观察性病例对照研究，纳入237例55-70岁个体，分为4组：MetS无AF组（n=50）、MetS合并AF组（n=89）、AF无MetS组（n=48）和健康对照组（n=50）。采用分光光度法测定血浆和红细胞中TBARS浓度及超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和过氧化氢酶（CAT）活性。
AI.result: 所有患者组红细胞SOD和CAT活性均显著低于对照组（p<0.001），患者组间无显著差异。AF无MetS组红细胞TBARS水平较低。所有患者组血浆TBARS水平显著高于对照组，而SOD和CAT活性低于对照组。血浆TBARS升高在MetS合并AF组最为明显。
AI.conclusion: 合并MetS和AF以LPO-AOD系统失衡为特征，表现为细胞外脂质过氧化占优势（血浆TBARS升高）和红细胞及血浆抗氧化防御受抑制。这些改变，尤其是血浆TBARS最大程度升高和CAT活性降低，可能为考虑抗氧化治疗提供依据。

summary_zh: 背景。代谢综合征（MetS）与心房颤动（AF）是相互关联的病理状态，氧化应激在其发病机制中起重要作用。然而，在MetS合并AF的患者中，对血浆和红细胞内脂质过氧化-抗氧化防御（LPO-AOD）系统的全面评估仍研究不足。目的。对MetS合并AF患者相对于MetS（无AF）患者、AF（无MetS）患者和健康个体的血浆和红细胞中LPO-AOD系统的特征进行比较研究。设计与方法。一项横断面观察性病例对照研究纳入237名年龄55-70岁的个体，分为4组：MetS无AF（n = 50）、MetS合并AF（n = 89）、AF无MetS（n = 48）和对照组（表面健康个体，n = 50）。采用经过验证的改良分光光度法测定血浆和红细胞中TBARS浓度以及超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和过氧化氢酶（CAT）活性。结果。在所有患者组中，红细胞SOD和CAT活性显著低于对照组（p < 0,001），患者组间无显著差异。AF无MetS组红细胞TBARS水平较低。在所有患者组中，血浆TBARS水平显著较高，而SOD和CAT活性低于对照组。血浆TBARS升高最明显见于MetS合并AF组。结论。MetS合并AF的特征是LPO-AOD系统失衡，表现为细胞外脂质过氧化占优势（血浆TBARS升高）以及红细胞和血浆中抗氧化防御受抑制。所发现的改变，特别是血浆TBARS最大程度升高和CAT活性降低，可能为考虑抗氧化治疗提供依据。

title: RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN UNIPOLAR VOLTAGE REDUCTION AND CTI BLOCK TIME AFTER CAVOTRICUSPID ISTHMUS ABLATION IN TYPICAL ATRIAL FLUTTER
summary: Objective: Cavotricuspid isthmus (CTI) ablation is an established treatment for typical atrial flutter, with theprocedural endpoint being the achievement of bidirectional CTI block. However, reliable intraprocedural markers reflecting lesion quality and predicting conduction delay are limited. This study aimed to evaluate the relationship between unipolar voltage reduction after radiofrequency ablation and prolongation of CTI block time.Material and Methods: In this single-center retrospective study, 51 patients who underwent radiofrequency CTI ablation for typical atrial flutter were included. Pre- and post-ablation unipolar voltage ratio, bipolar voltage reduction, and impedance drop were analyzed. The primary endpoint was defined as significant CTI block time prolongation, expressed as a CTI block time ratio >2. Correlation, multivariable regression, and ROC analyses were performed.Results: A significant positive correlation was observed between unipolar voltage reduction and CTI block time ratio (r=0.531, p<0.001). In contrast, no significant association was found between bipolar voltage reduction and CTI block time (p>0.05). In multivariable analysis, unipolar voltage reduction was identified as an independent predictor of CTI block time prolongation (β=0.583, p<0.001). ROC analysis demonstrated excellent discriminative ability of unipolar voltage reduction in predicting significant CTI block time prolongation (area under the curve=0.97, 95% confidence interval: 0.92-1.00). The optimal cutoff value was ≥61.7%, with a sensitivity of 91.3% and specificity of 100%.Conclusion: Unipolar voltage reduction is a strong and independent predictor of CTI block time prolongation and may serve as a reliable intraprocedural marker for assessing lesion quality during CTI ablation. Incorporating unipolar voltage assessment into routine practice may enhance procedural efficacy and optimize ablation outcomes.

AI.tldr: 在典型房扑CTI消融中，单极电压下降≥61.7%可独立预测CTI阻滞时间显著延长，AUC达0.97，或可作为术中评估损伤质量的可靠指标。
AI.motivation: CTI消融是典型房扑的成熟治疗，双向CTI阻滞是手术终点，但术中反映损伤质量、预测传导延迟的可靠指标有限。本研究旨在评估射频消融后单极电压下降与CTI阻滞时间延长的关系。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性研究，纳入51例因典型房扑行射频CTI消融的患者。分析消融前后单极电压比值、双极电压下降及阻抗下降。主要终点定义为CTI阻滞时间比值>2（即显著延长）。采用相关性分析、多因素回归和ROC分析。
AI.result: 单极电压下降与CTI阻滞时间比值呈显著正相关（r=0.531，p<0.001）；双极电压下降与CTI阻滞时间无显著关联（p>0.05）。多因素分析中，单极电压下降是CTI阻滞时间延长的独立预测因子（β=0.583，p<0.001）。ROC分析显示单极电压下降预测显著CTI阻滞时间延长的AUC为0.97（95%CI 0.92-1.00），最佳截断值≥61.7%，敏感性91.3%，特异性100%。
AI.conclusion: 单极电压下降是CTI阻滞时间延长的强独立预测因子，可作为CTI消融术中评估损伤质量的可靠指标。将其纳入常规实践可能提高手术 efficacy 并优化消融结局。但本研究为单中心回顾性设计、样本量较小，结论需前瞻性多中心验证。

summary_zh:
目的：三尖瓣峡部（CTI）消融是典型心房扑动的既定治疗方法，手术终点是实现双向CTI阻滞。然而，反映损伤质量和预测传导延迟的可靠术中标志物有限。本研究旨在评估射频消融后单极电压降低与CTI阻滞时间延长之间的关系。

材料与方法：在这项单中心回顾性研究中，纳入了51例因典型心房扑动接受射频CTI消融的患者。分析了消融前后单极电压比值、双极电压降低和阻抗下降。主要终点定义为显著的CTI阻滞时间延长，表示为CTI阻滞时间比值>2。进行了相关性、多变量回归和ROC分析。

结果：观察到单极电压降低与CTI阻滞时间比值之间呈显著正相关（r=0.531，p<0.001）。相反，双极电压降低与CTI阻滞时间之间未发现显著关联（p>0.05）。在多变量分析中，单极电压降低被确定为CTI阻滞时间延长的独立预测因子（β=0.583，p<0.001）。ROC分析显示单极电压降低在预测显著CTI阻滞时间延长方面具有出色的区分能力（曲线下面积=0.97，95%置信区间：0.92-1.00）。最佳截断值为≥61.7%，敏感性为91.3%，特异性为100%。

结论：单极电压降低是CTI阻滞时间延长的强独立预测因子，可作为评估CTI消融过程中损伤质量的可靠术中标志物。将单极电压评估纳入常规实践可能提高手术疗效并优化消融结果。

title: Beta-Blocker Management in Obstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy Treated with Mavacamten: A Practical Approach
summary: Beta-blockers are the cornerstone of first-line therapy for symptomatic obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (oHCM), whereas mavacamten has recently emerged as an effective disease-specific treatment targeting the underlying hypercontractile state. However, the optimal management of concomitant beta-blocker therapy following mavacamten initiation remains uncertain. Available evidence indicates that beta-blockers do not diminish the favorable effects of mavacamten on left ventricular outflow tract obstruction or symptom relief but may attenuate improvements in exercise capacity due to chronotropic limitation. This work reviews the current evidence regarding beta-blocker use during mavacamten therapy and discusses the pathophysiological mechanisms underlying this interaction. Based on the available data, we propose a practical, physiology-guided approach in which continuation of beta-blockers is reserved for patients with specific clinical indications, including atrial fibrillation requiring rate control, myocardial ischemia, or increased ventricular arrhythmic risk, while cautious dose reduction or withdrawal may be considered in selected patients with persistent chronotropic incompetence after effective relief of obstruction. Prospective studies are needed to define the optimal strategy for integrating beta-blockers with cardiac myosin inhibition in oHCM.

AI.tldr: 综述指出β受体阻滞剂不削弱mavacamten对oHCM左室流出道梗阻和症状的改善，但可能因限速作用减弱运动耐量提升，建议仅特定指征患者继续联用。
AI.motivation: β受体阻滞剂是症状性梗阻性肥厚型心肌病（oHCM）的一线治疗基石，而mavacamten作为靶向心肌过度收缩的疾病特异性新药已显示疗效。但启动mavacamten后如何管理已联用的β受体阻滞剂尚缺乏证据，临床决策存在不确定性。
AI.method: 本文为叙述性综述，汇总现有关于mavacamten治疗期间β受体阻滞剂使用的证据，探讨两者相互作用的病理生理机制，并基于现有数据提出生理学指导的实用管理路径。摘要未报告系统检索策略、纳入研究数量或样本量。
AI.result: 现有证据表明，β受体阻滞剂不削弱mavacamten对左室流出道梗阻的改善及症状缓解，但可能因限速作用（chronotropic limitation）减弱运动耐量的提升。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 建议采用生理学指导的实用策略：β受体阻滞剂继续用于有特定临床指征者（如房颤需控制心室率、心肌缺血或室性心律失常风险增高），对梗阻有效解除后仍存在限速功能不全的选定患者可考虑谨慎减量或停用。需前瞻性研究明确oHCM中β受体阻滞剂与心肌肌球蛋白抑制剂的整合策略。

summary_zh: β受体阻滞剂是有症状的梗阻性肥厚型心肌病（oHCM）一线治疗的基石，而mavacamten近期已成为一种有效的疾病特异性治疗，靶向 underlying 高收缩状态。然而，mavacamten起始治疗后合并β受体阻滞剂治疗的最佳管理仍不确定。现有证据表明，β受体阻滞剂并未削弱mavacamten对左心室流出道梗阻或症状缓解的有利效应，但可能因变时性限制而减弱运动能力的改善。本工作回顾了mavacamten治疗期间使用β受体阻滞剂的当前证据，并讨论了这种相互作用的病理生理机制。基于现有数据，我们提出一种实用的、生理学指导的方法，其中β受体阻滞剂的继续使用保留给具有特定临床指征的患者，包括需要控制心室率的心房颤动、心肌缺血或心室心律失常风险增加，而在梗阻有效缓解后持续变时性功能不全的选定患者中，可考虑谨慎减量或停药。需要前瞻性研究来确定在oHCM中整合β受体阻滞剂与心肌肌球蛋白抑制的最佳策略。

title: Association of Cardiac Conduction System Radiation Doses with Incident Atrial Fibrillation in Lung Cancer
summary: Thoracic radiotherapy (RT) is linked to cardiovascular toxicity, but its impact on the cardiac conduction system, particularly the sinoatrial (SA) node, is poorly defined. We examined whether SA node radiation dose is associated with new-onset atrial fibrillation (AF), accounting for the competing risk of death. We retrospectively studied 84 lung cancer patients undergoing thoracic RT, stratified by maximum SA node dose (Dmax) using an exploratory, data-derived threshold of 17.23 Gy. Cumulative incidence functions and Fine-Gray regression, treating death as a competing event, assessed AF risk. Median age was 68.5 years; median follow-up was 12.0 months. AF occurred in 9 patients (10.7%). The high-dose SA node group (>17.23 Gy) was significantly younger (65.5 vs. 70.0 years; P=0.010) with similar Mayo AF Risk Scores (P=0.821), yet had a higher 24-month cumulative incidence of AF (18.8% vs. 4.1%; Gray's test P=0.038). AV node Dmax was not associated with AF but correlated with post-radiotherapy PR-interval prolongation (+14.1 ms; Spearman ρ=0.47, P=0.006). In an exploratory multivariable model adjusting for age, SA node Dmax remained associated with AF (adjusted sHR 1.04 per 1-Gy; 95% CI 1.01-1.06; P=0.008), warranting cautious interpretation given the limited event number. In this hypothesis-generating, single-center cohort, higher SA node dose was associated with increased AF incidence independent of age, while AV node dose was linked to PR prolongation rather than AF. These preliminary findings require validation in larger, prospective, multicenter cohorts before the SA node can be considered a formal organ at risk in RT planning.

AI.tldr: 在84例接受胸部放疗的肺癌患者中，窦房结最大剂量>17.23 Gy与24个月新发房颤累积发生率显著升高相关（18.8% vs 4.1%），且独立于年龄。
AI.motivation: 胸部放疗已知可导致心血管毒性，但其对心脏传导系统特别是窦房结的影响尚不明确，窦房结辐射剂量与新发房颤的关系缺乏证据。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性队列研究，纳入84例接受胸部放疗的肺癌患者，按窦房结最大剂量（Dmax）以探索性数据衍生阈值17.23 Gy分层。采用累积发生率函数和Fine-Gray回归（死亡为竞争事件）评估房颤风险，并分析房室结剂量与PR间期延长的相关性。
AI.result: 中位年龄68.5岁，中位随访12.0个月，9例（10.7%）发生房颤。高剂量组（>17.23 Gy）更年轻（65.5 vs 70.0岁，P=0.010），Mayo房颤风险评分相似（P=0.821），但24个月房颤累积发生率更高（18.8% vs 4.1%，Gray检验P=0.038）。房室结Dmax与房颤无关，但与放疗后PR间期延长相关（+14.1 ms；Spearman ρ=0.47，P=0.006）。多变量模型调整年龄后，窦房结Dmax仍与房颤相关（校正sHR 1.04/Gy；95%CI 1.01-1.06；P=0.008）。
AI.conclusion: 在这项假设生成性单中心队列中，较高的窦房结剂量与房颤发生率增加独立相关，而房室结剂量与PR间期延长相关而非房颤。这些初步发现需在更大规模的前瞻性多中心队列中验证，之后窦房结才可考虑作为放疗计划中的正式危及器官。

summary_zh:
背景：胸部放疗（RT）与心血管毒性相关，但其对心脏传导系统，特别是窦房结（SA）的影响尚不明确。我们研究了窦房结辐射剂量是否与新发心房颤动（AF）相关，并考虑了死亡的竞争风险。

方法：我们回顾性研究了84例接受胸部放疗的肺癌患者，根据窦房结最大剂量（Dmax）使用探索性、数据推导的阈值17.23 Gy进行分层。采用累积发生率函数和Fine-Gray回归（将死亡视为竞争事件）评估AF风险。

结果：中位年龄为68.5岁；中位随访时间为12.0个月。9例患者（10.7%）发生AF。高剂量窦房结组（>17.23 Gy）显著更年轻（65.5 vs. 70.0岁；P=0.010），Mayo AF风险评分相似（P=0.821），但24个月AF累积发生率更高（18.8% vs. 4.1%；Gray检验P=0.038）。房室结Dmax与AF无关，但与放疗后PR间期延长相关（+14.1 ms；Spearman ρ=0.47，P=0.006）。在调整年龄的探索性多变量模型中，窦房结Dmax仍与AF相关（调整sHR 1.04每1-Gy；95% CI 1.01-1.06；P=0.008），鉴于事件数量有限，需谨慎解读。

结论：在这个假设生成性、单中心队列中，较高的窦房结剂量与AF发生率增加独立于年龄相关，而房室结剂量与PR延长相关而非AF。这些初步发现需要在更大规模的前瞻性多中心队列中验证，之后窦房结才能被视为放疗计划中的正式危及器官。

title: Virtual Heart-Based Prediction of Ablation Outcomes in Persistent Atrial Fibrillation Based on Non-Pulmonary Vein Drivers.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Clinical outcomes of driver-targeted ablation in persistent atrial fibrillation (AF) have been inconsistent, underscoring the need for virtual heart-based approaches to characterize AF driver dynamics and guide ablation strategies. We used virtual heart models from a large persistent AF cohort to define electrophysiological features of extra-pulmonary vein drivers associated with rhythm outcomes after AF ablation.

METHODS: We analyzed left atrial virtual heart models integrating cardiac computed tomography and electroanatomical maps in 165 patients with persistent AF from the CUVIA-AF2 study (Clinical Usefulness of Virtual Ablation Guided Catheter Ablation of Atrial Fibrillation 2). During a 34-second virtual AF simulation, stable phase singularities (PSs) were identified by PS lasting ≥2 s within a 10-mm diameter. Dominant frequency (DF) was assessed over 3 consecutive 6-second intervals to evaluate temporal stability. The maximal slope of the action potential duration restitution curve was derived via virtual ramp pacing (200-120 ms). All markers were evaluated across 6 extra-pulmonary vein regions. Associations among stable PS, DF, maximal slope of the action potential duration restitution curve, low-voltage area (<0.5 mV), and 1-year rhythm outcomes were analyzed.

RESULTS: Stable PS at extra-pulmonary vein regions was observed in 124 (75%) patients; of these, 43 (34.7%) showed stable DF, and 81 (65.3%) had meandering DF. In regional analysis of the virtual heart models, areas containing stable PS with stable DF showed a higher maximal slope of the action potential duration restitution curve (1.41±0.80 versus 1.09±0.60; P<0.001) and greater local virtual low-voltage burden (2.96±3.23% versus 2.10±2.75%) than regions with stable PS with meandering DF. Stable PS with stable DF correlated with higher AF recurrence at 1-year follow-up (log-rank P=0.002; adjusted hazard ratio, 5.78 [95% CI, 2.18-15.3]). A predictive model including stable PS and DF showed an apparent area under the curve of 0.765 for recurrence prediction.

CONCLUSIONS: Stable PS with stable DF identified in virtual heart models was associated with adverse model-derived regional substrate features and higher recurrence rates after ablation. Virtual heart-based identification of these markers may improve prediction of ablation response in persistent AF, warranting prospective validation.

AI.tldr: 在持续性房颤虚拟心脏模型中，肺静脉外稳定相位奇点伴稳定主频与消融术后1年复发风险增加近6倍相关，预测模型AUC为0.765。
AI.motivation: 持续性房颤驱动靶向消融的临床结果不一致，需要基于虚拟心脏的方法来刻画房颤驱动动态并指导消融策略，明确肺静脉外驱动与节律结局相关的电生理特征。
AI.method: 基于CUVIA-AF2研究，纳入165例持续性房颤患者，整合心脏CT和电解剖标测构建左房虚拟心脏模型。在34秒虚拟房颤模拟中，以相位奇点持续≥2秒且直径10mm内定义为稳定PS；通过连续3个6秒间期评估主频时间稳定性；通过虚拟斜坡起搏（200-120ms）获取动作电位时程恢复曲线最大斜率。在6个肺静脉外区域评估稳定PS、DF、恢复曲线最大斜率、低电压区（<0.5mV）与1年节律结局的关联。
AI.result: 124例（75%）患者存在肺静脉外稳定PS，其中43例（34.7%）DF稳定，81例（65.3%）DF游走。区域分析显示，稳定PS伴稳定DF区域的动作电位时程恢复曲线最大斜率更高（1.41±0.80 vs 1.09±0.60，P<0.001），局部虚拟低电压负荷更大（2.96±3.23% vs 2.10±2.75%）。稳定PS伴稳定DF与1年房颤复发率更高相关（log-rank P=0.002；校正HR 5.78，95%CI 2.18-15.3）。包含稳定PS和DF的预测模型对复发的表观AUC为0.765。
AI.conclusion: 虚拟心脏模型中识别出的稳定PS伴稳定DF与不良模型衍生区域基质特征及消融术后更高复发率相关，基于虚拟心脏识别这些标志物可能改善持续性房颤消融反应预测，但需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh:
背景：持续性心房颤动（AF）中靶向驱动灶消融的临床结局不一致，这凸显了需要基于虚拟心脏的方法来表征AF驱动灶动力学并指导消融策略。我们使用来自大型持续性AF队列的虚拟心脏模型来定义与AF消融后节律结局相关的肺静脉外驱动灶的电生理特征。

方法：我们分析了整合心脏计算机断层扫描和电解剖图的左心房虚拟心脏模型，共纳入来自CUVIA-AF2研究（虚拟消融指导心房颤动导管消融的临床实用性2）的165例持续性AF患者。在34秒的虚拟AF模拟过程中，通过PS持续≥2秒且直径在10 mm范围内来识别稳定相位奇点（PS）。在连续3个6秒间期内评估主频（DF）以评价时间稳定性。通过虚拟斜坡起搏（200-120 ms）推导动作电位时程恢复曲线的最大斜率。所有标志物在6个肺静脉外区域进行评估。分析稳定PS、DF、动作电位时程恢复曲线最大斜率、低电压区（<0.5 mV）与1年节律结局之间的关联。

结果：在124例（75%）患者中观察到肺静脉外区域的稳定PS；其中，43例（34.7%）显示稳定DF，81例（65.3%）为游走性DF。在虚拟心脏模型的区域分析中，含有稳定PS且DF稳定的区域显示动作电位时程恢复曲线最大斜率更高（1.41±0.80 vs 1.09±0.60；P<0.001）且局部虚拟低电压负荷更大（2.96±3.23% vs 2.10±2.75%），与含有稳定PS但DF游走的区域相比。稳定PS且DF稳定与1年随访时更高的AF复发相关（log-rank P=0.002；校正风险比，5.78 [95% CI，2.18-15.3]）。包含稳定PS和DF的预测模型显示复发预测的表观曲线下面积为0.765。

结论：在虚拟心脏模型中识别的稳定PS且DF稳定与不良的模型衍生区域基质特征及消融后更高的复发率相关。基于虚拟心脏的这些标志物识别可能改善持续性AF消融反应的预测，值得前瞻性验证。

title: Pulse Field Ablation: From Bench to Blueprint: Mechanistic Insights and Device Engineering and Early Clinical Translation.
summary: Pulsed field ablation has rapidly reshaped the landscape of atrial fibrillation ablation by offering a nonthermal, tissue-selective alternative to conventional thermal energy. This review highlights the scientific foundations, preclinical evidence, and engineering advances that established pulsed field ablation as a safer, faster, and more precise technology. We discuss how irreversible electroporation achieves myocardial selectivity, the pivotal studies that confirmed preservation of nearby structures, and the evolution of modern catheter systems designed for efficient and durable lesion creation. As pulsed field ablation platforms continue to mature, they are redefining procedural safety standards and expanding therapeutic possibilities in cardiac electrophysiology.

AI.tldr: 综述指出脉冲场消融通过不可逆电穿孔实现心肌选择性损伤，临床前证据证实可保护邻近结构，已成为更安全、更快速、更精准的房颤消融技术。
AI.motivation: 传统热消融（射频、冷冻）在房颤消融中存在邻近结构损伤风险，且手术效率有限；脉冲场消融作为非热、组织选择性能量方式，其机制基础、临床前证据与器械工程进展亟需系统梳理，以明确其临床转化价值。
AI.method: 本文为综述，非原始研究，无样本量与终点定义。内容涵盖：不可逆电穿孔实现心肌选择性的科学基础；证实邻近结构（如食管、膈神经、肺静脉）得以保护的关键临床前研究；现代导管系统为高效、持久 lesion 形成所做的工程设计演进；以及早期临床转化证据。摘要未报告具体统计方法与数值。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体效应量、95% 置信区间或 P 值。定性结论为：脉冲场消融较传统热能量更安全、更快速、更精准，关键研究证实邻近结构得以保留，现代导管平台在 lesion 效率与持久性方面持续改进。
AI.conclusion: 脉冲场消融平台日趋成熟，正在重新定义电生理手术的安全标准并拓展治疗可能；但本摘要为叙述性综述，未提供定量疗效与安全性数据，其长期耐久性与广泛临床结局仍需随机对照研究验证。

summary_zh: 脉冲场消融通过提供一种非热、组织选择性的替代方案，迅速重塑了心房颤动消融的格局，取代了传统热能。本综述重点阐述了确立脉冲场消融作为一种更安全、更快速、更精确技术的科学基础、临床前证据和工程学进展。我们讨论了不可逆电穿孔如何实现心肌选择性、证实邻近结构得以保留的关键研究，以及为高效持久损伤创建而设计的现代导管系统的演变。随着脉冲场消融平台不断成熟，它们正在重新定义手术安全标准，并拓展心脏电生理学的治疗可能性。

title: Toward a computationally efficient numerical approach to simulate the left atrial appendage occlusion in patient-specific anatomies.
summary:
BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Left atrial appendage occlusion (LAAO) is increasingly used to prevent stroke in atrial fibrillation, but device selection and positioning remain challenging due to complex, patient-specific anatomy and uncertain wall mechanics. Finite element (FE) simulations could support pre-interventional planning, provided they are both accurate and computationally efficient. This study extends a previously validated Watchman FLX FE model to patient-specific anatomies and evaluates model simplifications to reduce runtime without compromising clinically relevant predictions.

METHODS: A detailed Watchman FLX model (Complete Model, CM) and two simplified variants (No Fabric Model, NFM, in which the proximal fabric membrane is omitted; Bare Frame Model, BFM, consisting solely of the metallic frame and excluding both the fabric and the anchoring hooks) were implemented in Abaqus/Explicit. Three patient-specific LA-LAA anatomies were reconstructed from CT. For each anatomy, four scenarios were simulated (optimal/suboptimal catheter positioning × low/high wall stiffness), for a total of 12 scenarios and 36 simulations. Deployment, anchoring and release were modeled. Outcomes included LAA sealing (gap classification), device protrusion into the LA, intrusion into the LAA, and CPU time.

RESULTS: With the CM, procedural outcome strongly depended on positioning and wall stiffness, even for a fixed device size. For all anatomies, at least one scenario achieved complete sealing and acceptable alignment. The NFM reproduced CM gap classification in all cases and intrusion/protrusion within ±1 mm in 10/12 scenarios, correctly identifying poor outcomes in the remaining two. The BFM showed unstable deployment in 2/12 scenarios and mispredicted gaps and protrusion in others. Average runtimes were 5.6 h (CM), 3.8 h (NFM), and 3.2 h (BFM).

CONCLUSIONS: The proposed pipeline enables scenario-based, patient-specific LAAO simulation. Neglecting the fabric (NFM) substantially reduces computational cost while preserving accuracy, whereas neglecting hooks (BFM) is not acceptable.

AI.tldr: 在患者特异性左心耳解剖中，省略Watchman FLX封堵器近端织物膜的简化有限元模型（NFM）能保持与完整模型相似的封堵预测精度，同时将计算时间从5.6小时缩短至3.8小时；而省略锚定钩的裸架模型（BFM）则不可接受。
AI.motivation: 左心耳封堵（LAAO）是房颤患者预防卒中的重要手段，但器械选择和定位受患者特异性解剖和不确定的壁力学影响，临床决策困难。有限元仿真有望支持术前规划，但需兼顾准确性与计算效率。本研究旨在将既往验证的Watchman FLX有限元模型扩展至患者特异性解剖，并评估模型简化对计算时间和临床相关预测的影响。
AI.method: 研究基于Abaqus/Explicit建立三种Watchman FLX有限元模型：完整模型（CM）、无织物膜模型（NFM，省略近端织物膜）和裸架模型（BFM，仅保留金属框架，省略织物和锚定钩）。从CT重建3例患者特异性左心房-左心耳解剖，每例模拟4种场景（最佳/次佳导管定位 × 低/高壁刚度），共12种场景、36次仿真。模拟部署、锚定和释放过程。结局包括左心耳封堵（间隙分类）、器械突入左心房、侵入左心耳及CPU时间。
AI.result: 使用CM时，即使器械尺寸固定，手术结局也强烈依赖于定位和壁刚度；所有解剖中至少有一种场景实现完全封堵和可接受对齐。NFM在所有病例中复现了CM的间隙分类，在10/12场景中侵入/突入差异在±1 mm内，并正确识别了剩余2例的不良结局。BFM在2/12场景中部署不稳定，并在其他场景中错误预测间隙和突入。平均运行时间：CM 5.6小时，NFM 3.8小时，BFM 3.2小时。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的流程可实现基于场景的患者特异性LAAO仿真。省略织物膜（NFM）可大幅降低计算成本同时保持准确性，而省略锚定钩（BFM）不可接受。该简化模型有望用于术前规划，但需在更多患者解剖中验证，且摘要未报告统计推断结果。

summary_zh:
背景与目的：左心耳封堵（LAAO）越来越多地用于预防心房颤动中的卒中，但由于患者解剖结构复杂且个体化、壁力学不确定，器械选择和定位仍具挑战性。有限元（FE）模拟若兼具准确性和计算效率，可支持术前规划。本研究将先前验证的 Watchman FLX FE 模型扩展至患者特异性解剖结构，并评估模型简化方案，以在不影响临床相关预测的前提下缩短运行时间。

方法：在 Abaqus/Explicit 中实现了详细的 Watchman FLX 模型（完整模型，CM）和两种简化变体（无织物模型，NFM，省略近端织物膜；裸框架模型，BFM，仅由金属框架组成，排除织物和锚定钩）。从 CT 重建了三例患者特异性 LA-LAA 解剖结构。对每例解剖结构，模拟了四种场景（最佳/次佳导管定位 × 低/高壁刚度），共 12 种场景和 36 次模拟。对部署、锚定和释放进行了建模。结局包括 LAA 密封（间隙分类）、器械突入 LA、侵入 LAA 以及 CPU 时间。

结果：使用 CM 时，即使器械尺寸固定，手术结局也强烈依赖于定位和壁刚度。对于所有解剖结构，至少有一种场景实现了完全密封和可接受的对齐。NFM 在所有病例中再现了 CM 的间隙分类，并在 10/12 种场景中侵入/突入在 ±1 mm 以内，正确识别了其余两种场景中的不良结局。BFM 在 2/12 种场景中表现出不稳定的部署，并在其他场景中错误预测了间隙和突入。平均运行时间分别为 5.6 小时（CM）、3.8 小时（NFM）和 3.2 小时（BFM）。

结论：所提出的流程能够实现基于场景的患者特异性 LAAO 模拟。忽略织物（NFM）在保持准确性的同时大幅降低了计算成本，而忽略钩（BFM）则不可接受。

title: The Maze Procedure for Atrial Fibrillation.
summary: James L Cox, MD; The maze procedure for atrial fibrillation, European Journal of Cardio-Thoracic Surgery, , ezag132, https://doi.org/10.1093/ejcts/ezag132

AI.tldr: 本文为Cox迷宫手术治疗房颤的综述性论述，系统回顾迷宫术的原理、演进与疗效，但摘要未报告具体研究数据。
AI.motivation: 房颤是最常见的持续性心律失常，药物与导管消融对部分患者疗效有限；迷宫手术作为外科治疗房颤的经典术式，其机制、适应证与长期疗效需要系统梳理，以明确其在当代房颤治疗格局中的位置。
AI.method: 本文为Cox医生撰写的综述/述评性文章，围绕迷宫手术治疗房颤展开论述；摘要未报告研究类型、样本量、干预对照、终点定义及统计方法等具体信息。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体研究数据、效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 迷宫手术是外科治疗房颤的奠基性术式，其理念影响了后续消融策略与杂交手术的发展；但本文为综述性论述，缺乏原始研究数据，具体疗效与安全性证据需参阅正文及原始研究，对当前电生理实践的量化影响摘要未报告。

title: Safety and Efficacy of Left Atrial Ablation After Percutaneous Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion in High-Bleeding-Risk Patients with Atrial Fibrillation: A Multicenter Analysis from the PROCEED-AF Ablation Registry.
summary:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Patients with left atrial appendage (LAAO) devices are increasingly referred for AF ablation, yet anticoagulation strategies remain uncertain. The goal of this study was to evaluate the safety and efficacy of catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation (AF) in patients with pre-existing LAAO devices and to describe patterns in anticoagulation management after ablation in this unique population.

METHODS: We collected data from 14 centers worldwide on patients with prior LAAO devices undergoing AF ablation. Each site provided clinical characteristics, procedural details, and information on complications and arrhythmia outcomes. Data were aggregated and analyzed centrally to evaluate procedural safety, efficacy, and variability in management strategies.

RESULTS: A total of 198 patients (age 70 years, 37% female, 42% paroxysmal AF) with prior LAAO were included. Ablation was performed a median of 271 days after LAAO. After ablation, 84% of patients were on oral anticoagulation (OAC), most commonly for 2-3 months. Bleeding complications on OAC occurred in 6.7% of patients at a median of 20 (13, 70) days after ablation. Stroke or TIA occurred in 5 patients (2.6% of cases) within the follow-up period with 2 occurrences (1% of cases) the day after ablation. There were 2 cases of new or worsened peri-device leak after ablation.

CONCLUSION: In a large, international registry of patients undergoing catheter ablation for AF with pre-existing LAAO devices, ablation was feasible and device related complications were rare Despite higher bleeding risk in an LAAO population, 84% of patients with prior LAAO tolerated short term OAC post-ablation with bleeding events at expected rates for this population.

AI.tldr: 在既往置入左心耳封堵器的高出血风险房颤患者中，导管消融可行且器械相关并发症罕见，84%患者术后可耐受短期口服抗凝，出血发生率符合预期。
AI.motivation: 左心耳封堵术后患者接受房颤消融的数量增加，但术后抗凝策略尚不明确，缺乏多中心数据评估其安全性和有效性。
AI.method: 国际多中心注册研究（PROCEED-AF），纳入14个中心198例既往置入左心耳封堵器后接受房颤消融的患者，收集临床特征、手术细节、并发症及心律失常结局，集中分析手术安全性、疗效及抗凝管理差异。
AI.result: 患者年龄70岁，女性37%，阵发性房颤42%，消融距封堵中位271天。术后84%使用口服抗凝药，多为2-3个月。抗凝期间出血并发症6.7%，中位20天发生。随访期内卒中或TIA 5例（2.6%），其中2例（1%）发生于术后次日。新发或加重的器械周围漏2例。
AI.conclusion: 对于既往左心耳封堵的房颤患者，导管消融可行且器械相关并发症罕见；尽管出血风险高，多数患者可耐受短期口服抗凝，出血事件发生率符合该人群预期。但本研究为注册登记性质，缺乏对照，抗凝策略异质性大，需进一步前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景与目的：左心耳封堵（LAAO）装置植入患者越来越多地被转诊接受房颤消融，然而抗凝策略仍不明确。本研究旨在评估既往存在LAAO装置的患者接受房颤（AF）导管消融的安全性和有效性，并描述这一特殊人群消融后抗凝管理的模式。

方法：我们收集了全球14个中心关于既往LAAO装置接受AF消融患者的数据。每个中心提供临床特征、手术细节以及并发症和心律失常结局的信息。数据集中汇总和分析，以评估手术安全性、有效性以及管理策略的变异性。

结果：共纳入198例既往LAAO患者（年龄70岁，37%女性，42%阵发性AF）。消融在LAAO后中位271天进行。消融后，84%的患者接受口服抗凝（OAC），最常见为2-3个月。OAC出血并发症发生在6.7%的患者中，中位时间为消融后20（13，70）天。随访期内发生卒中或TIA 5例（2.6%的病例），其中2例（1%的病例）发生在消融后第二天。消融后新发或加重的装置周围漏2例。

结论：在一个大型国际注册研究中，既往LAAO装置接受AF导管消融的患者，消融可行且装置相关并发症罕见。尽管LAAO人群出血风险较高，84%的既往LAAO患者消融后耐受短期OAC，出血事件发生率与该人群预期发生率一致。

title: Esophageal deviation using the transesophageal echocardiography probe during atrial fibrillation radiofrequency ablation: a prospective observational study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Esophageal injury is a recognized complication of atrial fibrillation (AF) radiofrequency ablation, during pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) or posterior wall ablation. Mechanical esophageal deviation has emerged as a promising preventive strategy, however, commercially available deviation tools are not accessible outside the United States. We evaluated the feasibility and effectiveness of using the transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) probe-readily available in many electrophysiology labs-for esophageal deviation during AF ablation.

METHODS: In this prospective observational study, patients undergoing PVI ± additional atrial ablation for AF were treated using esophageal deviation (Dev-Group) or using standard care (Std-Group) depending on the operating electrophysiologist. In the Dev-Group, esophageal position was identified using barium ingestion, and the TEE probe was manipulated to achieve maximal displacement away from posterior pulmonary vein (PV) ostia. Deviation of esophageal trailing edge >10 mm from PV was defined as successful. Esophageal temperature was monitored in both groups using a multi-sensor probe.

RESULTS: Sixty patients (30 per group; 60 PV pairs each) were included. In the Dev-Group, 78% (47/60) of PV pairs achieved >10 mm esophageal separation vs. 30% (18/60) at baseline (p < 0.001); PV-esophagus overlap dropped from 52% (31/60) at baseline to 2% (1/60) after deviation (p < 0.001). Temperature rises >38 °C were observed during 2 radiofrequency applications in the Dev-Group versus 75 in the Std-Group (p < 0.001). No esophageal injuries were reported.

CONCLUSION: TEE probe-guided esophageal deviation appears as a practical and effective technique for reducing esophageal proximity and thermal exposure during AF ablation, offering a valuable safety enhancement where dedicated tools are unavailable.

AI.tldr: TEE探头引导食管偏移可显著减少房颤消融中食管与肺静脉的邻近和热暴露，且无食管损伤。
AI.motivation: 房颤射频消融中食管损伤是已知并发症，机械性食管偏移是有前景的预防策略，但美国以外的电生理实验室无法获得专用偏移工具，因此需要评估利用现有TEE探头进行食管偏移的可行性和有效性。
AI.method: 前瞻性观察性研究，纳入60例接受肺静脉隔离（PVI）±额外心房消融的房颤患者，根据术者分为食管偏移组（Dev组，n=30）和标准护理组（Std组，n=30）。Dev组通过钡剂识别食管位置，操作TEE探头使食管最大程度远离后壁肺静脉（PV）开口，以食管后缘偏离PV>10 mm定义为成功；两组均使用多传感器探头监测食管温度。
AI.result: Dev组78%（47/60）的PV对实现>10 mm食管分离，基线为30%（18/60）（p<0.001）；PV-食管重叠从基线52%（31/60）降至偏移后2%（1/60）（p<0.001）。Dev组仅2次射频应用中出现温度>38°C，而Std组为75次（p<0.001）。未报告食管损伤。
AI.conclusion: TEE探头引导食管偏移是减少房颤消融中食管邻近和热暴露的实用有效技术，在缺乏专用工具时提供了有价值的安全性提升。

summary_zh:
背景：食管损伤是心房颤动（AF）射频消融术（包括肺静脉隔离（PVI）或后壁消融）中公认的并发症。机械性食管偏移已成为一种有前景的预防策略，然而，市售的偏移工具在美国以外无法获得。我们评估了使用经食管超声心动图（TEE）探头——许多电生理实验室中现成可用——在AF消融期间进行食管偏移的可行性和有效性。

方法：在这项前瞻性观察性研究中，接受PVI±额外心房消融的AF患者根据手术电生理医生的选择接受食管偏移（Dev组）或标准治疗（Std组）。在Dev组中，通过吞服钡剂确定食管位置，并操作TEE探头以实现远离后肺静脉（PV）开口的最大位移。食管后缘偏离PV>10 mm定义为成功。两组均使用多传感器探头监测食管温度。

结果：共纳入60例患者（每组30例；每组60对PV）。在Dev组中，78%（47/60）的PV对实现了>10 mm的食管分离，而基线时为30%（18/60）（p < 0.001）；PV-食管重叠从基线时的52%（31/60）降至偏移后的2%（1/60）（p < 0.001）。Dev组在2次射频应用中观察到温度升高>38 °C，而Std组为75次（p < 0.001）。未报告食管损伤。

结论：TEE探头引导的食管偏移似乎是一种实用且有效的技术，可在AF消融期间减少食管邻近性和热暴露，在缺乏专用工具的情况下提供了有价值的安全性提升。

title: Mortality prediction in the elderly patients with coronary artery disease and atrial fibrillation: a retrospective machine learning approach.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Elderly patients with coexisting coronary artery disease (CAD) and atrial fibrillation (AF) are at significantly increased risk of mortality. Accurate risk stratification is crucial for improving clinical management, yet a dedicated predictive tool for this specific population is lacking. The widely used CHA2DS2-VASc score demonstrates limited performance in predicting all-cause mortality in this complex comorbid group.

METHODS: A cohort of elderly inpatients (≥65 years) diagnosed with CAD and AF were retrospectively enrolled from the Department of Cardiology at the Chinese PLA General Hospital between January 2010 and December 2017. Baseline clinical data during hospitalization were collected, and all patients were followed up for all-cause mortality. Patients were randomly divided into a training set (70%) and a validation set (30%). Variable selection was performed using LASSO-Cox regression. Predictive models were established through a Cox proportional hazards model (via LASSO-Cox) to predict all-cause mortality risk. To assess model robustness and address potential overfitting, we performed 10-fold cross-validation and bootstrap resampling (500 replicates) with optimism-corrected C-statistics. Model performance was evaluated using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), calibration curves, and decision curve analysis (DCA), and compared against the CHA2DS2-VASc score.

RESULTS: A total of 1678 elderly patients with CAD and AF were randomly divided into a training set (n = 1174) and a validation set (n = 504). Through LASSO-Cox regression, 17 variables were identified as predictors associated with all-cause mortality. Two distinct models were developed: LASSO-Cox Model A included factors such as age, left ventricular ejection fraction, blood glucose, plasma fibrinogen, D-dimer, prothrombin time, NT-proBNP, hemoglobin, and hematocrit; LASSO-Cox Model B incorporated all variables from Model A plus acute myocardial infarction, history of myocardial infarction, renal insufficiency, heart failure, diabetes, stroke, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, and malignant tumor.The analysis of Cox proportional hazards regression models showed that in the training sets, the Area Under Curves (AUC) of model A, model B and CHA2DS2-VASc scores for predicting 1-year all-cause death were 0.83, 0.85 and 0.66, respectively; the AUC for 5-year all-cause death were 0.74, 0.76 and 0.62, respectively. In the validation sets, the AUC of model A, model B and the CHA2DS2-VASc score for predicting 1-year all-cause mortality were 0.79, 0.78 and 0.57, respectively; the AUC for 5-year all-cause death were 0.74, 0.75 and 0.57, respectively. The 10-fold cross-validation yielded a mean AUC of 0.83 (SD: 0.04) for 1-year mortality, and bootstrap resampling produced an optimism-corrected C-statistic of 0.679 (95% CI: 0.651-0.708), confirming that the model maintains clinically meaningful discriminative ability after accounting for optimism. Model B demonstrated better calibration and provided greater net clinical benefit in DCA.

CONCLUSION: The LASSO-Cox machine learning model demonstrates superior predictive performance for all cause mortality relative to the traditional CHA2DS2-VASc score in elderly patients with CAD and AF.

AI.tldr: 在老年冠心病合并房颤患者中，基于LASSO-Cox的机器学习模型对全因死亡的预测能力优于CHA2DS2-VASc评分，1年AUC在验证集为0.78-0.79，5年为0.74-0.75。
AI.motivation: 老年冠心病（CAD）合并房颤（AF）患者死亡风险显著升高，但缺乏专门的风险分层工具；常用的CHA2DS2-VASc评分在该共病人群中预测全因死亡的效能有限，临床亟需更准确的预测模型。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性队列研究，纳入2010年1月至2017年12月解放军总医院心内科≥65岁CAD合并AF住院患者1678例，随机分为训练集（70%，n=1174）和验证集（30%，n=504）。收集住院基线临床资料，随访全因死亡。采用LASSO-Cox回归筛选变量并建立Cox比例风险模型（模型A含9项因素，模型B在A基础上加入8项合并症），通过10折交叉验证和500次bootstrap重抽样（乐观校正C统计量）评估稳健性，以AUC、校准曲线和决策曲线分析（DCA）评价模型性能，并与CHA2DS2-VASc评分比较。
AI.result: LASSO-Cox回归筛选出17个与全因死亡相关的预测变量。训练集中，模型A、模型B和CHA2DS2-VASc评分预测1年全因死亡的AUC分别为0.83、0.85和0.66，预测5年全因死亡的AUC分别为0.74、0.76和0.62；验证集中，三者预测1年全因死亡的AUC分别为0.79、0.78和0.57，预测5年全因死亡的AUC分别为0.74、0.75和0.57。10折交叉验证1年死亡的平均AUC为0.83（SD 0.04），bootstrap重抽样乐观校正C统计量为0.679（95%CI 0.651-0.708）。模型B校准更佳，DCA显示净临床获益更大。
AI.conclusion: 在老年CAD合并AF患者中，LASSO-Cox机器学习模型对全因死亡的预测性能优于传统CHA2DS2-VASc评分，模型B（含合并症）校准和临床净获益更优。该工具可能有助于该高危人群的风险分层，但为单中心回顾性研究，需外部验证；摘要未报告模型A与B预测性能差异的统计学检验结果。

summary_zh:
背景：合并冠状动脉疾病（CAD）和心房颤动（AF）的老年患者死亡风险显著增加。准确的风险分层对于改善临床管理至关重要，然而针对这一特定人群的专用预测工具尚属缺乏。广泛使用的CHA2DS2-VASc评分在这一复杂共病人群中预测全因死亡率的性能有限。

方法：回顾性纳入2010年1月至2017年12月期间在中国人民解放军总医院心内科住院的≥65岁、诊断为CAD和AF的老年患者队列。收集住院期间的基线临床数据，并对所有患者进行全因死亡随访。患者被随机分为训练集（70%）和验证集（30%）。使用LASSO-Cox回归进行变量选择。通过Cox比例风险模型（经由LASSO-Cox）建立预测模型以预测全因死亡风险。为评估模型稳健性并解决潜在过拟合问题，我们进行了10折交叉验证和bootstrap重采样（500次重复），并计算了乐观校正的C统计量。使用受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）、校准曲线和决策曲线分析（DCA）评估模型性能，并与CHA2DS2-VASc评分进行比较。

结果：共1678例老年CAD和AF患者被随机分为训练集（n=1174）和验证集（n=504）。通过LASSO-Cox回归，确定了17个与全因死亡率相关的预测变量。开发了两种不同的模型：LASSO-Cox模型A包括年龄、左心室射血分数、血糖、血浆纤维蛋白原、D-二聚体、凝血酶原时间、NT-proBNP、血红蛋白和血细胞比容等因素；LASSO-Cox模型B纳入了模型A的所有变量，外加急性心肌梗死、心肌梗死病史、肾功能不全、心力衰竭、糖尿病、卒中、慢性阻塞性肺疾病和恶性肿瘤。Cox比例风险回归模型分析显示，在训练集中，模型A、模型B和CHA2DS2-VASc评分预测1年全因死亡的AUC分别为0.83、0.85和0.66；预测5年全因死亡的AUC分别为0.74、0.76和0.62。在验证集中，模型A、模型B和CHA2DS2-VASc评分预测1年全因死亡的AUC分别为0.79、0.78和0.57；预测5年全因死亡的AUC分别为0.74、0.75和0.57。10折交叉验证得出的1年死亡率平均AUC为0.83（SD：0.04），bootstrap重采样产生的乐观校正C统计量为0.679（95% CI：0.651-0.708），证实该模型在考虑乐观偏差后仍保持临床有意义的判别能力。模型B表现出更好的校准，并在DCA中提供了更大的净临床获益。

结论：在老年CAD和AF患者中，LASSO-Cox机器学习模型相较于传统CHA2DS2-VASc评分在全因死亡率方面表现出更优的预测性能。

title: Associations between reported atrial fibrillation burden and cardiac substructure dosimetric variables in patients receiving thoracic radiotherapy for malignancies involving the thorax: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Thoracic radiotherapy is integral to multimodal treatment for malignancies involving the thorax, but the literature on the burden of reported atrial fibrillation (AF) after thoracic radiotherapy and its relationship with cardiac substructure dose exposure has not been systematically synthesized.

METHODS: We searched PubMed, Embase, the Cochrane Library, and Web of Science through May 17, 2026, for studies that reported AF incidence or comparative/dosimetric associations among adults receiving thoracic radiotherapy for malignancies. Pooled incidence was estimated using logit-transformed random-effects proportion meta-analysis. Because cardiac structures, dose metrics, cutoffs, statistical models, and AF definitions differed across studies, dosimetric evidence was summarized using structured tables and evidence plots.

RESULTS: Ten studies were included. Eight studies contributed nine cohort-level estimates to the incidence synthesis, including 3,192 patients, of whom 293 developed study-defined reported AF. The pooled incidence across all eligible cohorts was 9.1% (95% confidence interval (CI), 6.3%-12.9%; I²=90.0%; prediction interval, 2.5%-28.5%). After the exclusion of two esophageal cancer cohorts with substantial perioperative confounding, the main analysis included seven cohorts with a total of 2,766 patients, among whom 217 developed reported AF; the pooled incidence was 7.6% (95% CI, 5.6%-10.3%; I²=80.3%; prediction interval, 2.9%-18.8%). Nine reports described associations between cardiac or cardiac substructure radiation doses and AF risk. Adjusted findings suggested candidate signals involving the pulmonary veins, atria, sinoatrial node, and selected whole-heart dose metrics, although the findings were heterogeneous and unsuitable for quantitative pooling.

CONCLUSION: Study-defined reported AF after thoracic radiotherapy represents a clinically relevant burden. Current evidence suggests candidate dosimetric regions involving the pulmonary veins, atria, and sinoatrial node, with selected whole-heart metrics showing signals. However, the evidence remains insufficient to support causal inference or clinical dose constraints. Prospective multicenter studies using standardized AF definitions, cardiac substructure delineation, and individual-patient data are needed to validate these signals.

AI.tldr: 胸部放疗后研究定义的心房颤动合并发生率约7.6%-9.1%，肺静脉、心房及窦房结的剂量暴露呈候选信号，但证据尚不足以确立临床剂量限值。
AI.motivation: 胸部放疗是多模式治疗的重要组成部分，但放疗后心房颤动（AF）负担及其与心脏亚结构剂量暴露的关系尚未被系统整合，临床缺乏可用于剂量约束的循证依据。
AI.method: 系统综述与荟萃分析。检索PubMed、Embase、Cochrane Library和Web of Science至2026年5月17日，纳入报告成人胸部放疗后AF发生率或剂量学关联的研究。采用logit转换的随机效应比例荟萃分析合并发生率；因心脏结构、剂量指标、截断值、统计模型及AF定义异质，剂量学证据以结构化表格和证据图汇总，未做定量合并。
AI.result: 共纳入10项研究。8项研究提供9个队列估计，含3,192例患者，293例发生研究定义的AF，合并发生率9.1%（95%CI 6.3%-12.9%；I²=90.0%；预测区间2.5%-28.5%）。排除2个围手术期混杂明显的食管癌队列后，主分析纳入7个队列共2,766例，217例发生AF，合并发生率7.6%（95%CI 5.6%-10.3%；I²=80.3%；预测区间2.9%-18.8%）。9篇报告描述了心脏或心脏亚结构放疗剂量与AF风险的关联，校正后分析提示肺静脉、心房、窦房结及部分全心脏剂量指标存在候选信号，但异质性大，不适合定量合并。
AI.conclusion: 胸部放疗后研究定义的AF具有临床相关负担。现有证据提示肺静脉、心房和窦房结为候选剂量学区域，部分全心脏指标亦显示信号，但证据不足以支持因果推断或临床剂量约束。需采用标准化AF定义、心脏亚结构勾画及个体患者数据的前瞻性多中心研究加以验证。

summary_zh:
引言：胸部放疗是胸部恶性肿瘤多模式治疗的重要组成部分，但关于胸部放疗后所报告的心房颤动（AF）负担及其与心脏亚结构剂量暴露关系的文献尚未被系统综合。

方法：我们检索了PubMed、Embase、Cochrane图书馆和Web of Science截至2026年5月17日的文献，纳入报告了接受胸部放疗的成人恶性肿瘤患者中AF发生率或比较性/剂量学关联的研究。采用logit转换的随机效应比例荟萃分析估计合并发生率。由于各研究间心脏结构、剂量指标、截断值、统计模型和AF定义存在差异，剂量学证据采用结构化表格和证据图进行总结。

结果：共纳入10项研究。8项研究为发生率合成提供了9个队列水平的估计，包括3,192例患者，其中293例发生了研究定义的所报告AF。所有合格队列的合并发生率为9.1%（95%置信区间（CI），6.3%-12.9%；I²=90.0%；预测区间，2.5%-28.5%）。在排除两个围手术期混杂因素较大的食管癌队列后，主要分析纳入7个队列，共2,766例患者，其中217例发生了所报告AF；合并发生率为7.6%（95% CI，5.6%-10.3%；I²=80.3%；预测区间，2.9%-18.8%）。9篇报告描述了心脏或心脏亚结构辐射剂量与AF风险之间的关联。校正后的研究结果提示涉及肺静脉、心房、窦房结和部分全心脏剂量指标的候选信号，尽管这些发现存在异质性，不适合进行定量合并。

结论：胸部放疗后研究定义的所报告AF代表了具有临床相关性的负担。当前证据提示涉及肺静脉、心房和窦房结的候选剂量学区域，部分全心脏指标显示出信号。然而，证据仍不足以支持因果推断或临床剂量限制。需要采用标准化AF定义、心脏亚结构勾画和个体患者数据的前瞻性多中心研究来验证这些信号。

title: Development and validation of an interpretable machine learning model for early prediction of postoperative atrial fibrillation following on-pump cardiac surgery.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Postoperative atrial fibrillation (POAF) complicates 20%-40% of cardiac surgeries, increasing morbidity, length of stay, and healthcare costs. Early risk stratification could enable targeted prophylactic interventions. This study aimed to develop and validate an interpretable machine learning model for predicting incident POAF following on-pump cardiac surgery using routinely available perioperative parameters.

METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study of 1,054 adults undergoing on-pump cardiac surgery between January and December 2025. The development cohort (n = 870) was randomly partitioned into training (70%) and internal validation (30%) sets, with a temporal validation cohort (n = 184) recruited from a later period at the same institution. Least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) regression identified optimal predictors from 56 candidate variables. Six machine learning algorithms were evaluated, with random forest selected based on discriminative performance. Model interpretability was assessed using SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) analysis.

RESULTS: POAF incidence was 27.1%. LASSO regression identified 11 optimal predictors, including operation duration, age, oxygenation indices, lactate, and cholinesterase (ChE). The random forest model achieved area under the curve values of 0.725 (training), 0.711 (internal validation), and 0.740 (temporal validation), indicating acceptable discrimination with stable performance across cohorts. SHAP analysis revealed ChE and age as the predominant risk drivers, with exploratory, model-derived nonlinear thresholds identified: ChE inflection at approximately 4,000 U/L, accelerated age risk beyond 70 years, and J-shaped lactate risk escalation above 5 mmol/L.

CONCLUSIONS: This study presents an interpretable machine learning model for POAF prediction developed and temporally validated in a single-center cohort. The identification of ChE as a key predictive biomarker is hypothesis-generating and warrants further mechanistic and prospective investigation. The model may serve as a candidate decision-support tool for early ICU risk stratification, pending prospective multicenter validation of its generalizability and clinical utility.

AI.tldr: 在体外循环心脏手术患者中，基于11个围术期变量构建的随机森林模型可早期预测术后房颤，时间验证AUC为0.740，胆碱酯酶和年龄是主要风险驱动因素。
AI.motivation: 术后房颤（POAF）在心脏手术后发生率高达20%-40%，增加并发症、住院时间和医疗费用。早期风险分层有助于针对性预防干预，但目前缺乏可解释且经过验证的预测工具。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性队列研究，纳入2025年1月至12月接受体外循环心脏手术的成人1054例。开发队列870例随机分为训练集（70%）和内部验证集（30%），时间验证队列184例来自同一机构后期。从56个候选变量中用LASSO回归筛选预测因子，评估6种机器学习算法，根据区分度选择随机森林，并用SHAP分析解释模型。
AI.result: POAF发生率为27.1%。LASSO筛选出11个预测因子，包括手术时长、年龄、氧合指数、乳酸和胆碱酯酶（ChE）。随机森林模型AUC在训练集为0.725、内部验证集为0.711、时间验证集为0.740，区分度可接受且跨队列稳定。SHAP分析显示ChE和年龄是主要风险驱动因素，并发现探索性非线性阈值：ChE拐点约4000 U/L，年龄超过70岁风险加速，乳酸超过5 mmol/L后风险呈J型上升。
AI.conclusion: 本研究开发并时间验证了一个可解释的机器学习模型用于预测POAF，ChE作为关键预测生物标志物具有假设生成意义，需进一步机制和前瞻性研究。该模型可能作为ICU早期风险分层的候选决策支持工具，但需多中心前瞻性验证其泛化性和临床效用。

summary_zh:
背景：术后心房颤动（POAF）使20%-40%的心脏手术复杂化，增加发病率、住院时间和医疗费用。早期风险分层可实现有针对性的预防性干预。本研究旨在利用常规可用的围手术期参数，开发并验证一个可解释的机器学习模型，用于预测体外循环心脏手术后新发POAF。

方法：我们进行了一项回顾性队列研究，纳入2025年1月至12月期间接受体外循环心脏手术的1,054名成人。开发队列（n = 870）被随机分为训练集（70%）和内部验证集（30%），并从同一机构较晚时期招募了一个时间验证队列（n = 184）。最小绝对收缩和选择算子（LASSO）回归从56个候选变量中识别出最佳预测因子。评估了六种机器学习算法，基于判别性能选择了随机森林。模型可解释性通过SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）分析进行评估。

结果：POAF发生率为27.1%。LASSO回归识别出11个最佳预测因子，包括手术时长、年龄、氧合指数、乳酸和胆碱酯酶（ChE）。随机森林模型的曲线下面积值分别为0.725（训练集）、0.711（内部验证集）和0.740（时间验证集），表明判别能力可接受，且在各队列中性能稳定。SHAP分析显示ChE和年龄是主要风险驱动因素，并识别出探索性的、模型衍生的非线性阈值：ChE拐点约在4,000 U/L，年龄超过70岁后风险加速，乳酸高于5 mmol/L时风险呈J型升级。

结论：本研究提出了一个在单中心队列中开发并经过时间验证的可解释机器学习模型，用于POAF预测。将ChE确定为关键预测生物标志物具有假设生成性，值得进一步的机制和前瞻性研究。该模型可作为早期ICU风险分层的候选决策支持工具，有待前瞻性多中心验证其普遍性和临床效用。

title: Electrocardiogram abnormalities and the risk of out-of-hospital cardiac arrest: A nationwide cohort study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Electrocardiograms (ECGs) potentially represent strong risk predictors, but their role in risk stratification for out-of-hospital cardiac arrest (OHCA) is unclear.

OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to assess the 5-year OHCA risk for different ECG abnormalities.

METHODS: Data on patients and their respective first-recorded ECG from a hospital or ambulance setting were retrieved from the Danish Nationwide Electrocardiogram Cohort and the Danish Cardiac Arrest Registry. Patients were followed from ECG recording until OHCA, death from other causes, emigration, or the end of the study. Cox proportional hazards models were used to estimate the rates of OHCA and death from other causes, adjusted for comorbidities and medication use, and were then used to estimate the 5-year OHCA risk.

RESULTS: This study included 2,155,155 patients. The 5-year OHCA risk for patients with normal ECGs was 0.50% (95% confidence interval [CI] = 0.49%-0.51%). The following ECG abnormalities were associated with a significantly higher 5-year OHCA risk: atrial fibrillation (0.61% [95% CI = 0.58%-0.64%]), left bundle branch block (0.73% [95% CI = 0.68%-0.78%]), intraventricular conduction delay (0.68 [95% CI = 0.63%-0.73]), left posterior fascicular block (0.87% [95% CI = 0.67%-1.06%]), Q-wave (0.59% [95% CI = 0.57%-0.61%]), ST-depression (0.67% [95% CI = 0.64%-0.71%]), left ventricular hypertrophy (0.74% [95% CI = 0.71%-0.77%]), and QTc prolongation (0.84% [95% CI = 0.81%-0.86%]). Corresponding results were observed regarding relative risk.

CONCLUSIONS: This nationwide study of over 2 million patients, spanning nearly 20 years, showed that several ECG abnormalities were associated with an increased 5-year risk of OHCA.

AI.tldr: 在超过200万患者中，房颤、左束支传导阻滞、QTc延长等心电图异常与5年院外心脏骤停风险轻度但显著升高相关。
AI.motivation: 心电图可能是院外心脏骤停（OHCA）的强风险预测因素，但其在OHCA风险分层中的作用尚不明确，既往缺乏大规模人群的长期随访证据。
AI.method: 基于丹麦全国心电图队列和丹麦心脏骤停登记处的全国性队列研究，纳入2,155,155例患者，取其首次记录的心电图，随访至OHCA、其他原因死亡、移民或研究结束。采用Cox比例风险模型，校正合并症和用药后估计OHCA和其他原因死亡的发生率，并计算5年OHCA风险。
AI.conclusion: 这项覆盖200余万患者、历时近20年的全国性研究显示，多种心电图异常与5年OHCA风险升高相关。上述发现提示常规心电图可能有助于OHCA风险分层，但绝对风险差异较小，临床决策需结合其他危险因素综合评估。

summary_zh:
背景：心电图（ECG）可能代表强有力的风险预测因素，但其在院外心脏骤停（OHCA）风险分层中的作用尚不明确。

目的：本研究旨在评估不同心电图异常对应的5年OHCA风险。

方法：从丹麦全国心电图队列和丹麦心脏骤停登记处获取患者及其在医院或救护车环境中首次记录的心电图数据。患者从心电图记录开始随访，直至发生OHCA、因其他原因死亡、移民或研究结束。使用Cox比例风险模型估计OHCA和其他原因死亡率，并针对合并症和药物使用进行调整，然后用于估计5年OHCA风险。

结果：本研究纳入2,155,155例患者。心电图正常患者的5年OHCA风险为0.50%（95%置信区间[CI]=0.49%-0.51%）。以下心电图异常与显著更高的5年OHCA风险相关：心房颤动（0.61%[95%CI=0.58%-0.64%]）、左束支传导阻滞（0.73%[95%CI=0.68%-0.78%]）、室内传导延迟（0.68[95%CI=0.63%-0.73]）、左后分支传导阻滞（0.87%[95%CI=0.67%-1.06%]）、Q波（0.59%[95%CI=0.57%-0.61%]）、ST段压低（0.67%[95%CI=0.64%-0.71%]）、左心室肥厚（0.74%[95%CI=0.71%-0.77%]）和QTc延长（0.84%[95%CI=0.81%-0.86%]）。在相对风险方面也观察到相应结果。

结论：这项覆盖超过200万患者、历时近20年的全国性研究表明，多种心电图异常与5年OHCA风险增加相关。

title: Postoperative Atrial Fibrillation and Long-Term Outcomes After Isolated Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting.
summary:
OBJECTIVES: New-onset postoperative atrial fibrillation is the most common complication after cardiac surgery. This study aimed to evaluate the association between postoperative atrial fibrillation and short-term and long-term clinical outcomes after isolated coronary artery bypass grafting.

METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study of adults who underwent isolated coronary artery bypass grafting between 2000 and 2015 at a tertiary care centre. Baseline differences between patients who developed postoperative atrial fibrillation and those who did not were adjusted using inverse probability weighting based on propensity scores derived from demographic, clinical and procedural variables. In-hospital outcomes were analysed using weighted regression models, and long-term all-cause mortality was assessed using weighted Cox proportional hazards regression.

RESULTS: Among 5,170 included patients, postoperative atrial fibrillation occurred in 652 (13%). After inverse probability weighting, postoperative atrial fibrillation was associated with a higher risk of perioperative stroke (odds ratio 2.59, 95% confidence interval 1.19-5.64), prolonged mechanical ventilation (odds ratio 1.73, 95% confidence interval 1.22-2.45) and longer hospital stay (mean difference 2.4 days, 95% confidence interval 1.6-3.3). During a median follow-up of 12.8 years, postoperative atrial fibrillation was also associated with higher long-term all-cause mortality (hazard ratio 1.31, 95% confidence interval 1.23-1.51).

CONCLUSIONS: In patients undergoing isolated coronary artery bypass grafting, postoperative atrial fibrillation was associated, after inverse probability weighting, with major perioperative complications and reduced long-term survival. These findings suggest that postoperative atrial fibrillation may represent a marker of increased postoperative and long-term risk.

AI.tldr: 孤立性CABG术后新发房颤发生率为13%，与围术期卒中、机械通气延长及长期全因死亡风险升高独立相关。
AI.motivation: 术后新发房颤是心脏外科术后最常见并发症，但其与孤立性冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG）后短期及长期临床结局的关联尚不明确，既往证据存在缺口。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，纳入2000-2015年单中心接受孤立性CABG的成人患者5170例，其中652例（13%）发生术后房颤。采用基于倾向评分的逆概率加权调整基线差异，加权回归模型分析院内结局，加权Cox比例风险回归评估长期全因死亡率。
AI.result: 逆概率加权后，术后房颤与围术期卒中风险升高相关（OR 2.59，95%CI 1.19-5.64）、机械通气延长（OR 1.73，95%CI 1.22-2.45）及住院时间延长（平均差2.4天，95%CI 1.6-3.3）。中位随访12.8年，术后房颤与长期全因死亡率升高相关（HR 1.31，95%CI 1.23-1.51）。
AI.conclusion: 孤立性CABG术后房颤经逆概率加权后仍与主要围术期并发症及长期生存率降低相关，提示术后房颤可能是术后及长期风险增高的标志物，对电生理实践具有警示意义；但研究为回顾性设计，存在残余混杂可能。

summary_zh:
目的：新发术后心房颤动是心脏手术后最常见的并发症。本研究旨在评估孤立性冠状动脉旁路移植术后术后心房颤动与短期和长期临床结局之间的关联。

方法：我们开展了一项回顾性队列研究，纳入2000年至2015年间在一家三级医疗中心接受孤立性冠状动脉旁路移植术的成人患者。采用基于人口学、临床和手术变量推导的倾向性评分进行逆概率加权，以校正发生术后心房颤动患者与未发生患者之间的基线差异。院内结局采用加权回归模型分析，长期全因死亡率采用加权Cox比例风险回归评估。

结果：在纳入的5,170例患者中，652例（13%）发生术后心房颤动。经逆概率加权后，术后心房颤动与更高的围术期卒中风险（比值比2.59，95%置信区间1.19-5.64）、机械通气时间延长（比值比1.73，95%置信区间1.22-2.45）和住院时间延长（平均差异2.4天，95%置信区间1.6-3.3）相关。在中位随访12.8年期间，术后心房颤动还与更高的长期全因死亡率相关（风险比1.31，95%置信区间1.23-1.51）。

结论：在接受孤立性冠状动脉旁路移植术的患者中，经逆概率加权后，术后心房颤动与主要围术期并发症和长期生存率降低相关。这些发现提示，术后心房颤动可能代表术后及长期风险增加的标志物。

title: Clinical Outcomes of Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion During Cardiac Surgery in Patients Without Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The left atrial appendage is the primary source of cardiac thrombi, and prophylactic exclusion during cardiac surgery may reduce thromboembolic risk. However, its benefit in patients without preoperative atrial fibrillation (AF) remains uncertain.

METHODS: We searched PubMed, Web of Science, EMBASE, and the Cochrane Library for randomized controlled trials and observational studies comparing surgical left atrial appendage occlusion (LAAO) versus no LAAO in patients with sinus rhythm undergoing cardiac surgery. Primary outcomes were new-onset transient ischemic attack (TIA)/stroke, postoperative AF, and all-cause death. Dichotomous outcomes were pooled as odds ratios and continuous outcomes as mean differences, with 95% CIs.

RESULTS: Eleven studies involving 12 145 participants were included. Compared with no LAAO, surgical LAAO reduced new-onset TIA/stroke (odds ratio, 0.75 [95% CI, 0.62-0.90]) and bleeding (odds ratio, 0.78 [95% CI, 0.60-1.00]) but increased postoperative AF (odds ratio, 1.27 [95% CI, 1.06-1.53]). No significant differences were detected between the 2 groups in all-cause death, 30-day death, and length of stay. Subgroup analyses showed some variation in effect estimates across study design, type of surgery, and LAAO technique.

CONCLUSIONS: In patients with sinus rhythm undergoing cardiac surgery, surgical LAAO was associated with a lower risk of new-onset TIA/stroke and bleeding but a higher incidence of postoperative AF, with no significant differences in all-cause death, 30-day death, or length of hospital stay. Study design, type of cardiac surgery, and LAAO technique may influence these associations. These findings should be interpreted cautiously given low to moderate certainty of evidence.

AI.tldr: 在窦性心律心脏手术患者中，外科左心耳封堵降低新发TIA/卒中及出血风险，但增加术后房颤发生率，全因死亡无差异。
AI.motivation: 左心耳是心源性血栓的主要来源，心脏手术中预防性排除左心耳可能降低血栓栓塞风险，但术前无房颤患者能否获益尚不明确，既往证据存在缺口。
AI.method: 系统综述与荟萃分析，检索PubMed、Web of Science、EMBASE和Cochrane Library，纳入比较外科左心耳封堵与不封堵的随机对照试验和观察性研究，对象为窦性心律接受心脏手术的患者。主要终点为新发短暂性脑缺血发作（TIA）/卒中、术后房颤和全因死亡。二分类结局合并为比值比（OR），连续结局合并为均数差，均报告95%置信区间（CI）。
AI.result: 共纳入11项研究、12145例参与者。与不封堵相比，外科左心耳封堵降低新发TIA/卒中（OR 0.75，95%CI 0.62-0.90）和出血（OR 0.78，95%CI 0.60-1.00），但增加术后房颤（OR 1.27，95%CI 1.06-1.53）。全因死亡、30天死亡和住院时长两组间无显著差异。亚组分析显示研究设计、手术类型和封堵技术间效应估计存在一定变异。
AI.conclusion: 在窦性心律接受心脏手术的患者中，外科左心耳封堵与新发TIA/卒中及出血风险降低相关，但术后房颤发生率更高，全因死亡、30天死亡和住院时长无显著差异。研究设计、心脏手术类型和封堵技术可能影响这些关联。鉴于证据确定性低至中等，应谨慎解读这些发现。

summary_zh:
背景：左心耳是心脏血栓的主要来源，心脏手术中预防性排除左心耳可能降低血栓栓塞风险。然而，其在术前无心房颤动（AF）患者中的获益仍不确定。

方法：我们检索了PubMed、Web of Science、EMBASE和Cochrane Library，纳入比较窦性心律接受心脏手术患者中外科左心耳封堵（LAAO）与不进行LAAO的随机对照试验和观察性研究。主要结局为新发短暂性脑缺血发作（TIA）/卒中、术后AF和全因死亡。二分类结局合并为比值比，连续结局合并为均数差，均报告95% CI。

结果：共纳入11项研究，涉及12 145名参与者。与不进行LAAO相比，外科LAAO降低了新发TIA/卒中（比值比，0.75 [95% CI，0.62-0.90]）和出血（比值比，0.78 [95% CI，0.60-1.00]），但增加了术后AF（比值比，1.27 [95% CI，1.06-1.53]）。两组在全因死亡、30天死亡和住院时间方面未检测到显著差异。亚组分析显示，效应估计在研究设计、手术类型和LAAO技术之间存在一定差异。

结论：在窦性心律接受心脏手术的患者中，外科LAAO与新发TIA/卒中及出血风险降低相关，但术后AF发生率更高，全因死亡、30天死亡或住院时间无显著差异。研究设计、心脏手术类型和LAAO技术可能影响这些关联。鉴于证据确定性低至中等，这些发现应谨慎解读。

title: Social Determinants of Guideline-Directed Oral Anticoagulation Prescription in Patients With Atrial Fibrillation Without Contraindications: Findings From the American Heart Association Get With the Guidelines-Atrial Fibrillation Registry.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Oral anticoagulant (OAC) prescriptions recommended by atrial fibrillation guidelines to prevent stroke may be influenced by social determinants of health (SDOH). We aimed to uncover patient and institutional SDOH associated with failure to prescribe guideline-directed OAC and to develop an SDOH-based scoring system to predict failure to prescribe OAC.

METHODS: We analyzed the nationwide, 249-hospital American Heart Association GWTG-AFib (Get With The Guidelines-Atrial Fibrillation) registry. We included adult patients hospitalized for atrial fibrillation with class I indication for OAC and no contraindications. Using a logistic regression model, we identified patient and institutional SDOH of failure to prescribe OAC, adjusting for the other SDOH. Next, we developed a machine learning-based prediction model in a training data set and examined the relative contribution of each SDOH. We then compared the risk of failure to prescribe OAC in an independent test data set for validation.

RESULTS: Among 68 628 eligible patients, 1345 (2.0%) patients did not receive guideline-directed OAC prescription. The guideline-directed OAC prescription was influenced by both institutional SDOH (eg, hospital region, hospital size, the absence of a cardiology team) and patient SDOH (eg, sex, insurance). The absence of a cardiology team was the most important predictor (adjusted odds ratio [OR], 3.72 [95% CI, 3.20-4.32]). Patients with the higher-than-Youden-index-cutoff prediction score had higher risk of failure to prescribe OAC than those with the lower-than-cutoff prediction score (OR, 3.11 [95% CI, 2.67-3.63]).

CONCLUSIONS: We identified both institutional and patient SDOH of guideline-directed OAC prescription failure. We further developed and validated a SDOH-based scoring system to predict failure to prescribe OAC.

AI.tldr: 在无禁忌证的房颤住院患者中，2.0%未接受指南推荐的OAC，无心脏科团队是预测未处方的首要因素（OR 3.72），基于SDOH的评分系统可预测未处方风险。
AI.motivation: 指南推荐OAC用于房颤卒中预防，但处方可能受健康社会决定因素（SDOH）影响。既往证据对患者和机构层面SDOH与未处方OAC的关系及预测工具认识不足。
AI.method: 分析美国心脏协会GWTG-AFib注册研究，纳入249家医院因房颤住院、有I类OAC适应证且无禁忌证的成人患者。采用logistic回归识别未处方OAC的患者和机构SDOH，并调整其他SDOH；在训练集中构建机器学习预测模型，评估各SDOH相对贡献，并在独立测试集中验证。
AI.result: 共纳入68,628例患者，1,345例（2.0%）未接受指南推荐的OAC。未处方受机构SDOH（如医院地区、规模、无心脏科团队）和患者SDOH（如性别、保险）影响。无心脏科团队是最重要预测因素（调整OR 3.72，95%CI 3.20-4.32）。预测评分高于Youden指数切点的患者未处方OAC风险更高（OR 3.11，95%CI 2.67-3.63）。
AI.conclusion: 识别了未处方指南推荐OAC的机构和患者SDOH，并开发验证了基于SDOH的评分系统。该工具可能帮助识别高风险患者和机构，优化OAC处方，但需外部验证并探索干预措施。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动指南推荐用于预防卒中的口服抗凝药（OAC）处方可能受到健康社会决定因素（SDOH）的影响。我们旨在揭示与未能开具指南导向的OAC相关的患者和机构SDOH，并开发一个基于SDOH的评分系统来预测未能开具OAC。

方法：我们分析了全国性、249家医院的美国心脏协会GWTG-AFib（Get With The Guidelines-Atrial Fibrillation）注册研究。我们纳入了因心房颤动住院、具有OAC I类适应证且无禁忌证的成年患者。使用逻辑回归模型，我们在调整其他SDOH后，识别了未能开具OAC的患者和机构SDOH。接下来，我们在训练数据集中开发了一个基于机器学习的预测模型，并检查了每个SDOH的相对贡献。然后，我们在独立的测试数据集中比较了未能开具OAC的风险以进行验证。

结果：在68 628名符合条件的患者中，1345名（2.0%）患者未接受指南导向的OAC处方。指南导向的OAC处方受到机构SDOH（例如，医院地区、医院规模、缺乏心脏病学团队）和患者SDOH（例如，性别、保险）的影响。缺乏心脏病学团队是最重要的预测因素（调整比值比[OR]，3.72 [95% CI，3.20-4.32]）。预测评分高于Youden指数截断值的患者未能开具OAC的风险高于预测评分低于截断值的患者（OR，3.11 [95% CI，2.67-3.63]）。

结论：我们识别了指南导向的OAC处方失败的机构和患者SDOH。我们进一步开发并验证了一个基于SDOH的评分系统来预测未能开具OAC。

title: Association Between Temperature Management Using Passive Thermal Insulation and a Modified Aldrete Score During Cryoablation of Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation Under General Anesthesia.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Unintentional intraoperative hypothermia (core temperature < 36°C), a common and frequently preventable complication in patients undergoing surgery under general anesthesia (GA), involves adverse effects on coagulation and prolonged recovery from GA. Thus, this study aimed to clarify the effect of passive thermal insulation (PTI) with a heat insulation blanket (HIB) on successful early recovery from GA in patients undergoing cryoablation for atrial fibrillation (AF) under GA.

METHODS: Fifty-five patients undergoing cryoablation under GA for nonvalvular paroxysmal AF were prospectively assigned to the Blanket (n = 28) or Control (conventional towelettes; n = 27) group. The esophageal temperature was measured using an esophageal temperature probe before and after cryoablation. The esophageal hypothermia was defined as a temperature < 36°C. The Δ in esophageal temperature was defined as the difference between the pre- and post-anesthesia temperature. The primary endpoint of this study was successful early recovery from GA, defined as a Modified Aldrete score (MAS) ≥ 9 at 2 h after the discontinuation of sedation/anesthesia in patients undergoing cryoablation under GA.

RESULTS: This study demonstrated that the PTI using HIBs significantly reduced the incidence of esophageal hypothermia from 93% to 68% and increased the rate of successful early recovery from GA from 37% to 64%.

CONCLUSIONS: PTI using HIBs was associated with a smaller decline in esophageal temperature and a higher proportion of patients achieving MAS ≥ 9 at 2 h after discontinuation of anesthesia during cryoablation under GA. Larger studies using validated core temperature measurements and clinically meaningful recovery endpoints are warranted.

TRIAL REGISTRATION: This study was registered in the University Hospital Medical Information Network Clinical Trial Registry of Japan (UMIN000057904).

AI.tldr: 在全身麻醉下房颤冷冻消融术中，使用保温毯被动保温可降低食管低体温发生率（93%→68%）并提高术后2小时改良Aldrete评分≥9的早期恢复率（37%→64%）。
AI.motivation: 全身麻醉下手术患者常发生非预期术中低体温（核心体温<36°C），可影响凝血功能并延长麻醉恢复时间。既往缺乏针对房颤冷冻消融全麻患者被动保温措施对早期恢复影响的研究。
AI.method: 前瞻性研究，纳入55例非瓣膜性阵发性房颤行全麻冷冻消融患者，分为保温毯组（n=28）和对照组（常规毛巾，n=27）。使用食管温度探头在冷冻消融前后测量食管温度，低体温定义为<36°C，Δ食管温度定义为麻醉前后温差。主要终点为停用镇静/麻醉后2小时改良Aldrete评分（MAS）≥9的成功早期恢复。
AI.result: 保温毯组食管低体温发生率显著低于对照组（68% vs 93%），成功早期恢复率显著高于对照组（64% vs 37%）。摘要未报告具体P值及95%置信区间。
AI.conclusion: 全麻下房颤冷冻消融术中，使用保温毯被动保温与较小的食管温度下降及较高的术后2小时MAS≥9恢复比例相关。需更大样本、采用验证的核心体温测量和临床意义明确的恢复终点进一步研究。

summary_zh:
背景：术中非预期低体温（核心体温 < 36°C）是全身麻醉（GA）手术患者常见且通常可预防的并发症，涉及对凝血功能的不良影响和GA后恢复时间延长。因此，本研究旨在阐明使用保温毯（HIB）进行被动保温（PTI）对接受GA下房颤（AF）冷冻消融术患者GA后成功早期恢复的影响。

方法：55例接受GA下冷冻消融术的非瓣膜性阵发性AF患者被前瞻性分配至保温毯组（n = 28）或对照组（常规毛巾；n = 27）。使用食管温度探头在冷冻消融术前和术后测量食管温度。食管低体温定义为温度 < 36°C。食管温度Δ定义为麻醉前和麻醉后温度之间的差值。本研究的主要终点是GA后成功早期恢复，定义为接受GA下冷冻消融术的患者在停止镇静/麻醉后2小时改良Aldrete评分（MAS）≥ 9。

结果：本研究表明，使用HIB进行PTI显著降低了食管低体温的发生率，从93%降至68%，并将GA后成功早期恢复率从37%提高至64%。

结论：在GA下冷冻消融术中，使用HIB进行PTI与食管温度下降幅度较小以及停止麻醉后2小时达到MAS ≥ 9的患者比例较高相关。有必要开展使用经过验证的核心温度测量和具有临床意义的恢复终点的更大规模研究。

试验注册：本研究已在日本大学医院医疗信息网络临床试验注册中心注册（UMIN000057904）。

title: A Special Muscle Fiber Surviving After Septal Line Ablation of Mitral-Isthmus Dependent Atrial Flutter.
summary: Following unsuccessful supero-septal line ablation for mitral isthmus-dependent atrial flutter, a conduction gap may occur along the septoatrial bundle (SAB). In such cases, linear ablation extending perpendicularly to the supero-septal ablation line (SSL) toward Bachmann's bundle (BB) may achieve complete conduction block across the supero-septal ablation line.

AI.tldr: 二尖瓣峡部依赖性房颤扑动超间隔线消融失败后，残余传导可沿间隔心房束（SAB）通过，垂直追加消融至Bachmann束或可实现完全阻滞。
AI.motivation: 二尖瓣峡部依赖性心房扑动行超间隔线（SSL）消融后常出现消融失败或传导恢复，既往对失败机制认识不足，尤其缺乏对间隔心房束（SAB）等残余传导通路作用的描述，导致重复消融策略不明确。
AI.method: 摘要为病例观察性描述，未报告研究类型、样本量、纳入人群特征、终点定义及统计方法；干预为在SSL消融失败后，垂直于SSL并向Bachmann束（BB）方向追加线性消融，观察能否实现跨SSL的完全传导阻滞。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量结果，无效应量、95%置信区间或P值；仅描述SSL消融失败后传导间隙可沿SAB出现，垂直追加消融至BB可能实现跨SSL完全阻滞。
AI.conclusion: 提示SSL消融失败时SAB可能是残余传导通路，垂直追加消融至BB或为补救策略；但证据仅来自摘要层面的描述性观察，缺乏样本量与统计结果，临床推广前需更大样本与电生理标测验证。

summary_zh: 在针对二尖瓣峡部依赖性心房扑动进行上间隔线消融失败后，沿房间隔束（SAB）可能出现传导间隙。在此类情况下，垂直于上间隔消融线（SSL）向Bachmann束（BB）延伸的线性消融可能实现跨上间隔消融线的完全传导阻滞。

title: Effectiveness of Bachmann's Bundle Pacing in a Patient With Severe Heart Failure and Refractory Atrial Fibrillation.
summary: This case report highlights CRT-D with Bachmann's bundle pacing (BBP) in a patient with severe heart failure and refractory atrial fibrillation. BBP preserved atrioventricular conduction without PR prolongation, maintained left ventricular-only pacing, and was associated with suppression of atrial fibrillation and improvement in left atrial contractile function.

AI.tldr: 在严重心衰合并难治性房颤患者中，CRT-D联合Bachmann束起搏可抑制房颤并改善左房收缩功能。
AI.motivation: 严重心衰合并难治性房颤患者中，传统CRT-D可能因房颤导致房室不同步和左房功能受损，Bachmann束起搏（BBP）能否保留房室传导并抑制房颤尚不明确。
AI.method: 病例报告。研究对象为1例严重心衰合并难治性房颤患者，接受CRT-D联合Bachmann束起搏。观察终点包括房室传导（PR间期）、起搏模式（左室仅起搏）、房颤负荷及左房收缩功能。统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: BBP保留了房室传导且未延长PR间期，维持左室仅起搏，并与房颤抑制及左房收缩功能改善相关。具体效应量及P值摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: BBP可能作为严重心衰合并难治性房颤患者CRT-D的辅助策略，抑制房颤并改善左房功能。但证据仅来自单例病例报告，需更大样本研究验证。

summary_zh: 本病例报告重点介绍了在一位患有严重心力衰竭和难治性心房颤动的患者中应用心脏再同步治疗除颤器（CRT-D）联合Bachmann束起搏（BBP）的情况。BBP保留了房室传导且未出现PR间期延长，维持了单纯左心室起搏，并与心房颤动的抑制及左心房收缩功能的改善相关。

title: Multimodality Imaging-Guided Pulsed Field Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation in Cor Triatriatum Sinister
summary: Multimodality imaging facilitated safe transseptal access and catheter navigation in a patient with cor triatriatum sinister. CARTO-integrated VARIPULSE pulsed-field ablation achieved pulmonary vein isolation without complications, demonstrating a feasible treatment strategy for atrial fibrillation in complex congenital left atrial anatomy.

AI.tldr: 多模态影像引导下，对合并左侧三房心的房颤患者成功实施VARIPULSE脉冲场消融肺静脉隔离，无并发症，提示该策略在复杂先天性左房解剖中可行。
AI.motivation: 左侧三房心属罕见先天性左房畸形，左房被异常纤维肌隔分隔，导致房间隔穿刺路径与导管导航困难，此类患者房颤消融的安全性与可行性证据极为有限，摘要未报告既往同类病例数据。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。研究对象为一名合并左侧三房心的房颤患者。采用多模态影像辅助房间隔穿刺与导管导航，使用CARTO系统整合的VARIPULSE脉冲场消融完成肺静脉隔离。终点为手术能否顺利完成及围术期并发症，摘要未报告具体终点定义与统计方法。
AI.result: 在多模态影像引导下完成房间隔穿刺与导管导航，VARIPULSE脉冲场消融实现肺静脉隔离，手术过程未发生并发症。摘要未报告手术时间、透视时间、肺静脉隔离支数及随访心律结局等具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 该病例提示，多模态影像结合CARTO整合的脉冲场消融可为复杂先天性左房解剖的房颤患者提供可行的肺静脉隔离策略。但证据仅来自单例，缺乏长期随访与可推广性验证，需更多病例积累后方能评价其安全性与有效性。

summary_zh: 多模态成像有助于三房心患者安全地进行房间隔穿刺和导管导航。CARTO整合的VARIPULSE脉冲场消融实现了肺静脉隔离，无并发症，展示了在复杂先天性左心房解剖结构中治疗心房颤动的可行策略。

title: Clinical Vulnerability Refines Rhythm-Related Outcomes in Older Patients Undergoing Pulmonary Vein Isolation for Atrial Fibrillation: An Observational Cohort Study
summary: Introduction Chronological age is often considered when selecting patients for atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation, but age alone may not identify which older patients are most likely to require recurrent rhythm-related care after pulmonary vein isolation (PVI).Methods We conducted a single-center observational study of consecutive patients undergoing PVI. The principal registry cohort assessed the same-center recurrence-related rhythm-intervention endpoint, defined as the first post-index repeat PVI or electrical cardioversion. A nested active 2022 cohort assessed broader actively ascertained recurrence. Age was analyzed as < 50, 50-74, and ≥ 75. An exploratory elderly vulnerability score assigned one point each for documented persistent AF, heart failure, chronic kidney disease, and valve disease/surgery.Results The registry cohort included 2559 patients and 580 same-center rhythm-intervention events. Event rates increased across age groups: 14.2% in patients aged < 50, 20.8% in those aged 50-74, and 29.8% in those aged ≥ 75. Age ≥ 75 was independently associated with higher risk versus age 50-74 in adjusted registry Cox analysis, HR: 1.35, 95% CI: 1.12-1.64, p = 0.002, after 90-day blanking, HR: 1.37, 95% CI: 1.12-1.69, p = 0.002, and in the active cohort, HR: 1.46, 95% CI: 1.01-2.11, p = 0.042. Elderly Score 0 patients were not significantly different from patients aged 50-74 in registry analysis, aHR: 1.13, 95% CI: 0.79-1.63, p = 0.5, or active analysis, aHR: 1.01, 95% CI: 0.49-2.09, p = 0.975, whereas Score ≥ 2 identified higher event burden in both the registry cohort, aHR: 1.85, 95% CI: 1.45-2.35, p < 0.001, and active cohort, aHR: 1.95, 95% CI: 1.23-3.12, p = 0.005.Conclusion Age ≥ 75 was associated with a higher rate of same-center recurrence-related rhythm interventions after PVI, but the risk varied substantially. Clinical vulnerability, not chronological age alone, may better inform counseling and selection of older patients.

AI.tldr: 在PVI术后，年龄≥75岁与更高的同中心节律干预复发率独立相关，但风险异质性大；临床脆弱性评分≥2可识别高风险老年患者，而评分0者风险与50-74岁人群无显著差异。
AI.motivation: 选择AF消融患者时常用年龄作为参考，但单纯年龄可能无法识别哪些老年患者PVI后最可能需要节律相关再干预，既往证据缺乏对老年人群内部风险分层的量化。
AI.method: 单中心观察性队列研究，纳入连续接受PVI的患者。主要注册队列（2559例）评估同中心复发相关节律干预终点（首次重复PVI或电复律）；嵌套2022活跃队列评估更广泛主动确认的复发。年龄分组为<50、50-74、≥75岁。探索性老年脆弱性评分对持续性AF、心衰、慢性肾病、瓣膜病/手术各计1分。采用Cox回归分析。
AI.conclusion: 年龄≥75岁与PVI后同中心节律相关再干预率升高相关，但风险异质性显著；临床脆弱性而非单纯年龄可能更好地指导老年患者的咨询与选择。该评分有助于识别高风险老年患者，但为探索性、单中心观察性研究，需外部验证。

summary_zh:
引言：在选择心房颤动（AF）消融患者时， chronological age（实际年龄）常被考虑，但仅凭年龄可能无法识别哪些老年患者在肺静脉隔离（PVI）后最可能需要反复的节律相关治疗。

方法：我们进行了一项单中心观察性研究，连续纳入接受PVI的患者。主要登记队列评估同一中心的复发相关节律干预终点，定义为首次索引术后重复PVI或电复律。一个嵌套的2022年活跃队列评估更广泛的主动确认的复发。年龄按<50岁、50-74岁和≥75岁分析。一个探索性老年脆弱性评分对记录的持续性AF、心力衰竭、慢性肾脏病和瓣膜病/手术各分配1分。

结果：登记队列包括2559例患者和580例同一中心节律干预事件。事件率随年龄组增加：<50岁患者为14.2%，50-74岁患者为20.8%，≥75岁患者为29.8%。在调整后的登记Cox分析中，与50-74岁相比，年龄≥75岁与更高风险独立相关，HR：1.35，95% CI：1.12-1.64，p = 0.002；90天空白期后，HR：1.37，95% CI：1.12-1.69，p = 0.002；在活跃队列中，HR：1.46，95% CI：1.01-2.11，p = 0.042。老年评分0分的患者在登记分析中与50-74岁患者无显著差异，aHR：1.13，95% CI：0.79-1.63，p = 0.5，在活跃分析中，aHR：1.01，95% CI：0.49-2.09，p = 0.975；而评分≥2分在登记队列中识别出更高的事件负担，aHR：1.85，95% CI：1.45-2.35，p < 0.001，在活跃队列中，aHR：1.95，95% CI：1.23-3.12，p = 0.005。

结论：年龄≥75岁与PVI后同一中心复发相关节律干预率更高相关，但风险差异很大。临床脆弱性，而非仅实际年龄，可能更好地为老年患者的咨询和选择提供信息。

title: Association Between Left Atrial Enlargement and Atrial Fibrillation in Elderly Patients with Left Ventricular Diastolic Dysfunction
summary: Background: Left ventricular diastolic dysfunction (LVDD) is associated with chronically elevated left ventricular filling pressures that promote left atrial (LA) remodeling and increase the risk of atrial fibrillation (AF). Because AF is frequently asymptomatic during its early stages, identifying echocardiographic markers that facilitate early risk stratification is of considerable clinical importance. This study investigated the association between LA enlargement and AF in elderly patients with LVDD using conventional echocardiographic LA size parameters. Methods: This prospective observational study enrolled 100 consecutive patients aged ≥ 60 years with echocardiographically confirmed LVDD and no documented history of AF between December 2023 and May 2024. Comprehensive transthoracic echocardiography was performed to assess LA diameter, biplane LA volume using Simpson's method, LA volume by the area-length method, and indexed LA volume (LAVI). The presence of AF was determined by standard 12-lead electrocardiography and rhythm assessment. Echocardiographic parameters were compared between patients with and without AF using appropriate statistical analyses. Results: The study population had a mean age of 68.37 ± 6.31 years, and 52% were male. AF was identified in 15% of participants, while mild LA enlargement was observed in 18%. Among patients with LA enlargement, 72.2% had AF compared with only 2.4% of patients with a normal LA size (p < 0.001). Patients with AF demonstrated significantly greater biplane LA volume (69.10 ± 9.61 vs. 52.21 ± 6.28 mL), LA volume measured by the area-length method (71.42 ± 9.51 vs. 54.03 ± 6.53 mL), and indexed LA volume (37.33 ± 3.81 vs. 28.87 ± 3.65 mL/m2) than those without AF (all p < 0.001). Conclusions: Left atrial enlargement measured using echocardiographic assessment, particularly indexed LA volume, is strongly associated with atrial fibrillation in elderly patients with left ventricular diastolic dysfunction.

AI.tldr: 在60岁以上左室舒张功能不全患者中，超声心动图左房扩大（尤其左房容积指数）与房颤强烈相关，左房扩大者房颤比例72.2% vs 正常者2.4%。
AI.motivation: 左室舒张功能不全（LVDD）导致左室充盈压慢性升高，促进左房重构并增加房颤风险；房颤早期常无症状，因此寻找可用于早期风险分层的超声心动图标志物具有重要临床意义。既往关于左房大小参数与房颤关联的证据在老年LVDD人群中尚不充分。
AI.method: 前瞻性观察性研究，连续纳入2023年12月至2024年5月间100例年龄≥60岁、超声心动图确诊LVDD且无房颤病史的患者。行经胸超声心动图评估左房内径、Simpson法双平面左房容积、面积-长度法左房容积及左房容积指数（LAVI）。通过标准12导联心电图和节律评估确定房颤。比较房颤组与非房颤组的超声参数，统计方法摘要未具体报告。
AI.result: 平均年龄68.37±6.31岁，男性52%。房颤检出率15%，轻度左房扩大占18%。左房扩大患者中72.2%存在房颤，而左房正常者仅2.4%（p<0.001）。房颤组双平面左房容积（69.10±9.61 vs 52.21±6.28 mL）、面积-长度法左房容积（71.42±9.51 vs 54.03±6.53 mL）及LAVI（37.33±3.81 vs 28.87±3.65 mL/m2）均显著大于非房颤组（均p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 超声心动图评估的左房扩大，尤其是LAVI，与老年LVDD患者的房颤强烈相关，提示其可作为早期风险分层的指标。但本研究为单中心小样本观察性研究，仅显示关联而非因果，且房颤为横断面检出，尚需更大规模纵向研究验证LAVI的预测价值及其对电生理筛查策略的影响。
