summary_zh: 背景：左心室舒张功能障碍（LVDD）与左心室充盈压长期升高相关，后者促进左心房（LA）重构并增加心房颤动（AF）的风险。由于AF在早期常无症状，识别有助于早期风险分层的超声心动图标志物具有重要的临床意义。本研究使用常规超声心动图左心房大小参数，探讨左心室舒张功能障碍老年患者中左心房扩大与AF之间的关联。方法：这项前瞻性观察性研究于2023年12月至2024年5月连续纳入100例年龄≥60岁、经超声心动图证实存在LVDD且无AF记录病史的患者。进行全面的经胸超声心动图检查，评估左心房内径、采用Simpson法测量的双平面左心房容积、面积-长度法测量的左心房容积以及左心房容积指数（LAVI）。通过标准12导联心电图和节律评估确定AF的存在。使用适当的统计学分析比较有无AF患者的超声心动图参数。结果：研究人群平均年龄为68.37 ± 6.31岁，52%为男性。15%的参与者发现AF，而18%观察到轻度左心房扩大。在左心房扩大的患者中，72.2%患有AF，而左心房大小正常的患者中仅有2.4%患有AF（p < 0.001）。与无AF的患者相比，AF患者的双平面左心房容积（69.10 ± 9.61 vs. 52.21 ± 6.28 mL）、面积-长度法测量的左心房容积（71.42 ± 9.51 vs. 54.03 ± 6.53 mL）和左心房容积指数（37.33 ± 3.81 vs. 28.87 ± 3.65 mL/m2）显著更大（所有p < 0.001）。结论：通过超声心动图评估测量的左心房扩大，尤其是左心房容积指数，与左心室舒张功能障碍老年患者的心房颤动强烈相关。

title: Pressure-Waveform Guidance for Pulmonary Vein Occlusion During Cryoballoon Ablation: Procedural Efficiency and Repeat-Procedure Findings from a Large Single-Center Cohort
summary: Background/Objectives: The cryoballoon (CB) has simplified pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) for treating atrial fibrillation (AF). Vein occlusion is usually assessed utilizing contrast media which entails possible risks and increases fluoroscopy exposure. Pressure-guided assessment of occlusion has emerged as a potential alternative. The objective of this study is to compare procedural characteristics and repeat-procedure findings of pressure-guided and contrast-guided assessment of vein occlusion. Methods: From July 2018 to December 2023, 1166 patients (485 [41%] female, mean age 65 ± 10 years) with AF (64% paroxysmal) undergoing CB-PVI were enrolled at a single-center, 368 (32%) underwent a contrast-guided and 798 (68%) a pressure-guided approach. Results: Procedure duration (90 ± 20 vs. 93 ± 23 min) and ablation time (1342 ± 361 vs. 1368 ± 406 s) were similar in pressure- and contrast- guided groups, and the acute success rate of PVI was high in both groups. The pressure-guided approach had shorter X-ray times (5.7 ± 3.4 vs. 9.5 ± 4.8 min, p < 0.0001) and lower X-ray doses (82 ± 78.9 vs. 586 ± 546 cGy/cm2, p < 0.0001). In 112 redo-procedures for arrhythmia recurrence after CB-PVI, durable isolation of all veins was observed more often after pressure-guided procedures (28/56 [50%] vs. 13/56 [23%]); per-vein durability was also higher (174/224 [78%] vs. 150/224 [67%], p = 0.015). Conclusions: Pressure-waveform guidance during CB-PVI is a feasible alternative to contrast-guided occlusion assessment and was associated with substantially lower intraprocedural fluoroscopy exposure. Repeat-procedure findings suggest a possible durability signal, but this observation should be considered exploratory and confirmed in prospective studies.

AI.tldr: 在1166例冷冻球囊肺静脉隔离患者中，压力波形指导的封堵评估与造影指导相比急性成功率相当，但透视时间与剂量显著降低，再次手术中肺静脉持久隔离率更高。
AI.motivation: 冷冻球囊肺静脉隔离中，封堵评估通常依赖造影剂，存在造影剂相关风险并增加透视暴露。压力波形指导封堵评估作为潜在替代方案，其操作特征及对肺静脉持久隔离的影响尚缺乏大样本数据。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性队列研究，纳入2018年7月至2023年12月接受冷冻球囊肺静脉隔离的AF患者1166例（女性41%，平均年龄65±10岁，阵发性AF 64%），其中压力指导组798例（68%）、造影指导组368例（32%）。比较两组手术时间、消融时间、急性PVI成功率、透视时间与剂量，并在112例因心律失常复发再次手术的患者中比较肺静脉持久隔离率。
AI.result: 压力指导组与造影指导组手术时间（90±20 vs 93±23 min）和消融时间（1342±361 vs 1368±406 s）相近，两组急性PVI成功率均高。压力指导组透视时间更短（5.7±3.4 vs 9.5±4.8 min，p<0.0001），透视剂量更低（82±78.9 vs 586±546 cGy/cm2，p<0.0001）。112例再次手术中，压力指导组全部肺静脉持久隔离比例更高（28/56 [50%] vs 13/56 [23%]），按静脉计算的持久隔离率亦更高（174/224 [78%] vs 150/224 [67%]，p=0.015）。
AI.conclusion: 压力波形指导是冷冻球囊PVI中造影指导封堵评估的可行替代方案，可显著降低术中透视暴露，并提示可能更优的肺静脉持久隔离信号；但再次手术结果属探索性观察，需前瞻性研究证实，且单中心回顾性设计存在选择偏倚可能。

summary_zh: 背景/目的：冷冻球囊（CB）简化了治疗心房颤动（AF）的肺静脉隔离（PVI）。静脉闭塞通常使用造影剂评估，这涉及可能的风险并增加透视暴露。压力引导的闭塞评估已成为一种潜在的替代方法。本研究的目的是比较压力引导和造影引导评估静脉闭塞的手术特征和重复手术发现。方法：从2018年7月至2023年12月，单中心连续入选1166例接受CB-PVI的AF患者（485例[41%]女性，平均年龄65 ± 10岁；64%为阵发性），其中368例（32%）接受造影引导方法，798例（68%）接受压力引导方法。结果：压力引导组和造影引导组的手术时间（90 ± 20 vs. 93 ± 23 min）和消融时间（1342 ± 361 vs. 1368 ± 406 s）相似，两组的PVI急性成功率均较高。压力引导方法的X线时间更短（5.7 ± 3.4 vs. 9.5 ± 4.8 min，p < 0.0001），X线剂量更低（82 ± 78.9 vs. 586 ± 546 cGy/cm2，p < 0.0001）。在112例因CB-PVI后心律失常复发而进行的重复手术中，压力引导手术后更常见所有静脉的持久隔离（28/56 [50%] vs. 13/56 [23%]）；每静脉持久性也更高（174/224 [78%] vs. 150/224 [67%]，p = 0.015）。结论：CB-PVI期间的压力波形引导是造影引导闭塞评估的可行替代方法，并与术中透视暴露显著降低相关。重复手术发现提示可能的持久性信号，但这一观察应视为探索性，并需在前瞻性研究中确认。

title: Monitored anesthesia care versus general anesthesia for balloon-in-basket pulsed-field ablation of atrial fibrillation: an age-matched analysis of procedural timing and acute procedural outcomes.
summary:
BACKGROUND: General anesthesia (GA) has been the preferred sedation strategy for atrial fibrillation (AF) catheter ablation in the United States, in part because pulsed-field ablation (PFA) systems cause skeletal muscle stimulation and discomfort that can be poorly tolerated under lighter sedation. A recently introduced balloon-in-basket (BiB) PFA system (VOLT) has been reported to produce less muscle stimulation and pain, potentially allowing Monitored Anesthesia Care (MAC) instead of GA. Whether MAC offers procedural efficiency advantages without compromising ablation efficacy in this context has not been well characterized.

OBJECTIVE: To compare procedural timing, ablation efficacy, and safety between MAC and GA in patients undergoing BiB PFA (VOLT) for AF, using an age-matched design.

METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 39 consecutive MAC cases and a pool of 83 GA cases undergoing VOLT BiB PFA from a two-site electrophysiology registry. Each MAC patient was matched 1:1 to the nearest age available GA patient yielding 39 age-matched controls. Six different time intervals were collected: total room time, pre-procedure setup time, core procedure time, post-procedure turnover time, transseptal-to-left atrial (LA) sheath-out (dwell) time, and ablation catheter dwell time. Total ablation lesions delivered, acute procedural success (isolation of all four pulmonary veins), and procedural complications were also compared. Group comparisons were then made. In addition, EP laboratory facility cost savings and scheduling opportunity cost associated with the observed difference in total room time, using published EP/procedural-suite per-minute cost estimates were also determined.

RESULTS: Total room time (103.5 ± 20.0 vs. 126.2 ± 33.1 min; p = 0.0004), pre-procedure setup time (33.4 ± 10.0 vs. 50.3 ± 28.0 min; p = 0.0007), and post-procedure turnover time (14.8 ± 9.3 vs. 21.4 ± 8.3 min; p = 0.0030) were significantly shorter with MAC. Core procedure time (55.3 ± 20.5 vs. 55.3 ± 23.9 min), transseptal-to-LA-sheath-out time (34.2 ± 12.9 vs. 35.7 ± 18.5 min) did not differ significantly between groups (both p ≥ 0.62). Ablation catheter dwell time was modestly longer with MAC (27.7 ± 11.9 vs. 24.2 ± 15.5 min; p = 0.036). Total ablation lesions delivered (17.6 ± 5.1 vs. 18.8 ± 7.2, p = 0.68) and acute procedural success (39/39 [100%] vs. 39/39 [100%]) were similar between MAC and GA, with no procedural complications in either group. One MAC case (2.6%) was converted to general anesthesia interprocedurally for coughing attributed to airway secretions. Applying published EP/procedural-suite per-minute cost estimates ($29-$60/minute) to the observed 22.7-min reduction in total room time, MAC was associated with an estimated $658-$1,362 in facility cost savings per case, with potential opportunity cost benefit for additional case scheduling.

CONCLUSION: In an age-matched cohort undergoing BiB PFA (VOLT) for AF, MAC was associated with shorter total room time, pre-procedure setup time, and post-procedure turnover time than GA, with no difference in ablation lesion delivery, acute success, or complications. Anesthesia related time savings with MAC appear concentrated in room logistics rather than the ablation procedure itself, with no detectable difference in acute procedural outcomes in this small cohort, supporting MAC as a reasonable alternative to GA for BiB PFA.

AI.tldr: 在年龄匹配的房颤球篮式脉冲场消融队列中，MAC较全麻缩短总手术室时间、术前准备和术后周转时间，且不增加消融病灶数、急性成功率或并发症差异。
AI.motivation: 全麻是美国房颤导管消融的首选镇静策略，部分因脉冲场消融（PFA）系统引起骨骼肌刺激和不适，轻镇静下耐受差。新型球篮式（BiB）PFA系统（VOLT）据报肌肉刺激和疼痛更少，可能允许使用监测麻醉（MAC）替代全麻，但MAC是否在不影响消融疗效的前提下提供流程效率优势尚未明确。
AI.method: 回顾性分析两中心电生理注册研究中39例连续MAC和83例全麻下接受VOLT BiB PFA的房颤患者，按年龄1:1匹配获得39例全麻对照。收集6个时间间期：总手术室时间、术前准备时间、核心手术时间、术后周转时间、房间隔穿刺至左房鞘管撤出（驻留）时间和消融导管驻留时间。比较总消融病灶数、急性手术成功（四支肺静脉全部隔离）和手术并发症。另基于已发表的电生理/手术室每分钟成本估算，计算总手术室时间差异相关的设施成本节省和排程机会成本。
AI.result: MAC组总手术室时间（103.5±20.0 vs 126.2±33.1 min；p=0.0004）、术前准备时间（33.4±10.0 vs 50.3±28.0 min；p=0.0007）和术后周转时间（14.8±9.3 vs 21.4±8.3 min；p=0.0030）显著更短。核心手术时间（55.3±20.5 vs 55.3±23.9 min）和房间隔穿刺至左房鞘管撤出时间（34.2±12.9 vs 35.7±18.5 min）组间无显著差异（均p≥0.62）。MAC组消融导管驻留时间略长（27.7±11.9 vs 24.2±15.5 min；p=0.036）。总消融病灶数（17.6±5.1 vs 18.8±7.2，p=0.68）和急性手术成功率（39/39 [100%] vs 39/39 [100%]）相似，两组均无手术并发症。1例MAC（2.6%）因气道分泌物所致咳嗽术中转为全麻。基于已发表的每分钟29-60美元成本估算，MAC相关总手术室时间减少22.7分钟，估计每例节省设施成本658-1362美元，并可能带来额外排程的机会成本获益。
AI.conclusion: 在年龄匹配的接受BiB PFA（VOLT）的房颤队列中，MAC与更短的总手术室时间、术前准备时间和术后周转时间相关，消融病灶数、急性成功率和并发症无差异。MAC的麻醉相关时间节省集中于手术室后勤而非消融手术本身，该小队列未检测到急性手术结局差异，支持MAC作为BiB PFA中全麻的合理替代方案。

summary_zh:
背景：在美国，全身麻醉（GA）一直是心房颤动（AF）导管消融的首选镇静策略，部分原因是脉冲场消融（PFA）系统会引起骨骼肌刺激和不适，在较轻镇静下可能耐受不良。最近引入的球囊篮式（BiB）PFA系统（VOLT）据报道产生较少的肌肉刺激和疼痛，可能允许使用监测麻醉护理（MAC）代替GA。在这种情况下，MAC是否提供程序效率优势而不影响消融疗效尚未得到很好的表征。

目的：使用年龄匹配设计，比较接受BiB PFA（VOLT）治疗AF的患者中MAC和GA之间的程序时间、消融疗效和安全性。

方法：我们回顾性分析了来自两个中心电生理注册中心的39例连续MAC病例和83例接受VOLT BiB PFA的GA病例池。每个MAC患者按1:1匹配到年龄最接近的GA患者，产生39个年龄匹配的对照。收集六个不同的时间间隔：总房间时间、术前准备时间、核心程序时间、术后周转时间、房间隔穿刺至左心房（LA）鞘管拔出（停留）时间、以及消融导管停留时间。还比较了总消融损伤数、急性程序成功（所有四个肺静脉隔离）和程序并发症。然后进行组间比较。此外，还使用已发表的EP/程序套件每分钟成本估计，确定了与观察到的总房间时间差异相关的EP实验室设施成本节约和调度机会成本。

结果：MAC的总房间时间（103.5 ± 20.0 vs. 126.2 ± 33.1分钟；p = 0.0004）、术前准备时间（33.4 ± 10.0 vs. 50.3 ± 28.0分钟；p = 0.0007）和术后周转时间（14.8 ± 9.3 vs. 21.4 ± 8.3分钟；p = 0.0030）显著更短。核心程序时间（55.3 ± 20.5 vs. 55.3 ± 23.9分钟）、房间隔穿刺至LA鞘管拔出时间（34.2 ± 12.9 vs. 35.7 ± 18.5分钟）在组间无显著差异（均p ≥ 0.62）。MAC的消融导管停留时间稍长（27.7 ± 11.9 vs. 24.2 ± 15.5分钟；p = 0.036）。MAC和GA之间的总消融损伤数（17.6 ± 5.1 vs. 18.8 ± 7.2，p = 0.68）和急性程序成功（39/39 [100%] vs. 39/39 [100%]）相似，两组均无程序并发症。一例MAC病例（2.6%）因气道分泌物引起的咳嗽在术中转为全身麻醉。将已发表的EP/程序套件每分钟成本估计（$29-$60/分钟）应用于观察到的总房间时间减少22.7分钟，MAC与每例估计$658-$1,362的设施成本节约相关，并具有额外病例调度的潜在机会成本效益。

结论：在年龄匹配的接受BiB PFA（VOLT）治疗AF的队列中，MAC与较短的總房间时间、术前准备时间和术后周转时间相关，而消融损伤 delivery、急性成功或并发症无差异。MAC相关的麻醉时间节约似乎集中在房间物流而非消融程序本身，在这个小队列中未检测到急性程序结果的差异，支持MAC作为BiB PFA的合理替代GA。

title: Transcatheter valve-in-valve versus surgical aortic valve replacement for failed bioprostheses: Artificial-intelligence electrocardiogram age as a marker of mortality.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: To analyze outcomes of patients with failed stented bioprostheses undergoing redo surgical aortic valve replacement (redo SAVR) versus valve-in-valve transcatheter AVR (ViV-TAVR) and evaluate the impact of preoperative artificial-intelligence electrocardiogram (AI-ECG) age on all-cause mortality.

METHODS: Between 2010 and 2025, 1558 patients underwent repeat AVR for a failed bioprosthesis. To obtain a more homogenous cohort, patients with concomitant procedures were excluded, leaving 244 redo SAVR and 369 ViV-TAVR cases. Propensity-score matching (1:1) was then applied, yielding 167 balanced pairs. Preoperative ECGs were analyzed using a convolutional neural network to estimate AI-ECG age. The age gap was defined as AI-ECG age minus chronological age, with positive values indicating a physiologically older age.

RESULTS: The matched cohort had a mean chronological age of 72 ± 11 years and AI-ECG age of 68 ± 10 years. Mean age gap was -3.6 ± 9 years (range, -22 to +15 years). Compared with redo SAVR, ViV-TAVR was associated with greater median predismissal gradients (13 [9-19] mm Hg vs 9 [7-13] mm Hg, P < .001), and more frequent severe prosthesis-patient mismatch (25% vs 11%, P < .001). Operative mortality was 2.4% for redo-SAVR and 0.6% for ViV (P = .37). A positive age gap was an independent predictor of all-cause mortality (hazard ratio, 1.20; 95% CI, 1.16-1.24; P < .001). No significant interaction between treatment modality and age gap was observed (hazard ratio, 1.02; 95% CI, 0.96-1.07; P = .571). An increasing age gap was associated with measures of postoperative outcomes, including atrial fibrillation, blood product transfusion, prolonged intensive care unit stay, and prolonged hospitalization.

CONCLUSIONS: AI-ECG age gap is independently associated with mortality after repeat aortic valve replacement and provides prognostic information beyond chronological age. Increasing age gap is also associated with several markers of postoperative outcomes, supporting its role as a noninvasive measure of physiologic reserve.

AI.tldr: 在生物瓣衰败后重复主动脉瓣置换的患者中，AI-ECG年龄差（AI预测年龄减实际年龄）是独立于治疗方式的死亡预测因子，每增加1岁，全因死亡风险增加20%。
AI.motivation: 生物瓣衰败后需再次主动脉瓣置换，redo SAVR与ViV-TAVR的预后比较证据有限，且传统年龄不能准确反映生理储备，需探索AI-ECG年龄对预后的影响。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，纳入2010-2025年因生物瓣衰败行重复AVR的1558例患者，排除合并手术者后剩244例redo SAVR和369例ViV-TAVR，经1:1倾向性评分匹配得167对。用卷积神经网络分析术前心电图估算AI-ECG年龄，年龄差=AI-ECG年龄-实际年龄，正值提示生理年龄更老。主要终点为全因死亡，比较两种术式结局并评估年龄差的预测价值。
AI.result: 匹配队列平均实际年龄72±11岁，AI-ECG年龄68±10岁，平均年龄差-3.6±9岁。ViV-TAVR较redo SAVR出院前跨瓣压差更高（中位数13 vs 9 mmHg，P<0.001），严重患者-人工瓣膜不匹配更常见（25% vs 11%，P<0.001）。手术死亡率redo SAVR 2.4% vs ViV 0.6%（P=0.37）。年龄差阳性是全因死亡的独立预测因子（HR 1.20，95%CI 1.16-1.24，P<0.001），治疗方式与年龄差无显著交互作用（HR 1.02，95%CI 0.96-1.07，P=0.571）。年龄差增大与术后房颤、输血、ICU停留延长和住院延长相关。
AI.conclusion: AI-ECG年龄差是重复主动脉瓣置换术后死亡的独立预测因子，提供超越实际年龄的预后信息，并与多项术后结局相关，可作为无创的生理储备指标。但研究为回顾性、样本量有限，需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh:
目的：分析因支架生物瓣膜衰败而接受再次外科主动脉瓣置换术（redo SAVR）与瓣中瓣经导管主动脉瓣置换术（ViV-TAVR）的患者结局，并评估术前人工智能心电图（AI-ECG）年龄对全因死亡率的影响。

方法：2010年至2025年间，1558例患者因生物瓣膜衰败接受了再次主动脉瓣置换术。为获得更同质的队列，排除了合并其他手术的患者，剩余244例redo SAVR和369例ViV-TAVR病例。随后应用倾向性评分匹配（1:1），得到167对均衡配对。使用卷积神经网络分析术前心电图以估算AI-ECG年龄。年龄差定义为AI-ECG年龄减去实际年龄，正值表示生理年龄较老。

结果：匹配队列的平均实际年龄为72 ± 11岁，AI-ECG年龄为68 ± 10岁。平均年龄差为-3.6 ± 9岁（范围，-22至+15岁）。与redo SAVR相比，ViV-TAVR与更高的出院前中位跨瓣压差相关（13 [9-19] mm Hg vs 9 [7-13] mm Hg，P < .001），以及更频繁的严重人工瓣膜-患者不匹配（25% vs 11%，P < .001）。redo-SAVR的手术死亡率为2.4%，ViV为0.6%（P = .37）。年龄差为正是全因死亡率的独立预测因子（风险比，1.20；95% CI，1.16-1.24；P < .001）。未观察到治疗方式与年龄差之间存在显著交互作用（风险比，1.02；95% CI，0.96-1.07；P = .571）。年龄差增加与术后结局指标相关，包括心房颤动、血制品输注、重症监护室停留时间延长和住院时间延长。

结论：AI-ECG年龄差与再次主动脉瓣置换术后的死亡率独立相关，并提供了超越实际年龄的预后信息。年龄差增加还与若干术后结局标志物相关，支持其作为生理储备的无创测量指标的作用。

title: Major bleeding modifiers in anticoagulated patients with atrial fibrillation and heart failure: a systematic review
summary: Patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) and heart failure (HF) often require oral anticoagulation (OAC) but have renal dysfunction, anaemia, and polypharmacy. Evidence on bleeding-risk modifiers in patients with both AF and HF has not been synthesised specifically.We conducted a systematic review of studies reporting major bleeding modifiers in anticoagulated patients with atrial fibrillation and heart failure. Modifier domains, outcome definitions, study design features, and antithrombotic-treatment contexts were extracted. Structured narrative synthesis was the primary approach; only contrasts meeting the prespecified pooling criteria, with sufficiently comparable adjusted estimates, were evaluated in exploratory random-effects meta-analyses.Twenty-three studies provided 93 effect rows. Prominent clinically monitorable domains reported across the included studies were severe renal dysfunction (Cockcroft-Gault-based renal function <30 vs ≥80 mL/min: hazard ratio [HR] 5.77, 95% confidence interval [CI] 3.16-10.52), prior bleeding (HR 2.48, 1.44-4.28), inappropriate or unrevised anticoagulant dosing, anaemia, and concomitant antiplatelet therapy, with more limited evidence for nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug exposure. In a separate exploratory random-effects meta-analysis of the antithrombotic-treatment context, any direct oral anticoagulant (DOAC) versus warfarin or other non-DOAC oral anticoagulation was associated with lower major bleeding (pooled HR 0.69, 95% CI 0.55-0.87; k=6; I2=75%; τ2=0.05552). This was contextual safety evidence rather than a clinical modifier.This systematic review identifies clinically monitorable major bleeding modifier domains in anticoagulated patients with atrial fibrillation and heart failure. Quantitative synthesis was limited to a small number of comparable comparisons and should be interpreted as exploratory.

AI.tldr: 在房颤合并心衰的抗凝患者中，严重肾功能不全、既往出血、不恰当抗凝剂量、贫血和联用抗血小板药是可监测的大出血风险修饰因素，DOAC较华法林大出血风险更低（HR 0.69）。
AI.motivation: 房颤合并心衰患者常需口服抗凝，但多伴肾功能不全、贫血和多药共用，出血风险高；既往证据未专门针对这一双重疾病人群系统整合出血风险修饰因素。
AI.method: 系统综述，纳入报告房颤合并心衰抗凝患者大出血修饰因素的研究，提取修饰因素域、结局定义、研究设计特征和抗血栓治疗背景；以结构化叙述性综合为主，仅对满足预设合并标准且校正估计可比的对比进行探索性随机效应Meta分析。
AI.result: 共纳入23项研究、93条效应行。可监测的突出修饰因素包括：严重肾功能不全（Cockcroft-Gault法eGFR<30 vs ≥80 mL/min：HR 5.77，95%CI 3.16-10.52）、既往出血（HR 2.48，95%CI 1.44-4.28）、不恰当或未调整的抗凝剂量、贫血及联用抗血小板药；NSAID暴露证据有限。探索性Meta分析显示，任何DOAC vs 华法林或其他非DOAC口服抗凝药与大出血风险降低相关（合并HR 0.69，95%CI 0.55-0.87；k=6；I2=75%；τ2=0.05552），属背景性安全性证据而非临床修饰因素。
AI.conclusion: 本系统综述识别了房颤合并心衰抗凝患者中可临床监测的大出血修饰因素，但定量合并仅限少数可比对比，应视为探索性；提示临床应重点评估肾功能、既往出血史、抗凝剂量、贫血及抗血小板联用，DOAC可能较华法林降低大出血风险。

summary_zh:
背景：房颤（AF）合并心衰（HF）患者常需口服抗凝（OAC），但常伴有肾功能不全、贫血和多重用药。针对AF合并HF患者出血风险修正因素的证据尚未被专门综合。

方法：我们对报告抗凝治疗的房颤合并心衰患者大出血修正因素的研究进行了系统综述。提取了修正因素领域、结局定义、研究设计特征和抗血栓治疗背景。以结构化叙述性综合为主要方法；仅在探索性随机效应荟萃分析中评估符合预设合并标准、具有充分可比调整估计值的对比。

结果：23项研究提供了93行效应数据。纳入研究中报告的主要临床可监测领域包括严重肾功能不全（基于Cockcroft-Gault的肾功能<30 vs ≥80 mL/min：风险比[HR] 5.77，95%置信区间[CI] 3.16-10.52）、既往出血（HR 2.48，1.44-4.28）、不适当或未调整的抗凝剂量、贫血以及合并抗血小板治疗，非甾体抗炎药暴露的证据较为有限。在抗血栓治疗背景的单独探索性随机效应荟萃分析中，任何直接口服抗凝药（DOAC）与华法林或其他非DOAC口服抗凝相比，与大出血风险降低相关（合并HR 0.69，95% CI 0.55-0.87；k=6；I2=75%；τ2=0.05552）。这是背景性安全性证据，而非临床修正因素。

结论：本系统综述确定了抗凝治疗的房颤合并心衰患者中临床可监测的大出血修正因素领域。定量综合仅限于少量可比的比较，应视为探索性。

title: Sex-Specific Temporal Trends in the Incidence of Heart Failure Among Patients With Atrial Fibrillation: A Population-Based Study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Although there is evidence linking women to a higher risk of ischemic stroke in AF, it remains uncertain whether there are sex differences in the hazards of HF.

OBJECTIVES: This study sought to evaluate sex differences in the temporal trend of incident heart failure (HF) among patients with atrial fibrillation (AF).

METHODS: Using a territory-wide clinical registry in Hong Kong, patients newly diagnosed with AF between 1997 and 2021 were studied. Annual incidence rate (IR) and incidence rate ratio were estimated by Poisson regression analysis. Multivariate adjusted Fine-Gray regression models were performed to examine the subdistribution hazard ratio between women and HF, accounting for all-cause mortality as a competing event.

RESULTS: We included 130,132 individuals with newly diagnosed AF (median age: 76.6 years; IQR: 60.4-92.8; 48.6% female). Between 1997 and 2021, the annual IR (per 1000 person-years) of HF declined from 69.6 to 16.7 in women and from 44.5 to 13.7 in men over the years. Women maintained a higher IR than men for the entire follow-up period (IR: 25.3 vs 19.3 per 1000 person-years) and were associated with a higher risk of HF than men (incidence rate ratio [95% CI]: 1.34 [1.31-1.37]). When compared with men, women were older at the time of diagnosis of AF, had higher baseline CHA2DS2-VASc scores, and were more likely to be prescribed reduced doses of direct oral anticoagulants.

CONCLUSIONS: Despite an overall decrease in the risk of HF among AF patients over two decades of follow-up, women retained elevated residual adjusted HF risk after full adjustment for time-varying comorbidities.

AI.tldr: 香港130,132例新诊断房颤患者中，女性心衰年发病率始终高于男性（25.3 vs 19.3/1000人年），校正后风险比1.34，尽管20余年来两性心衰风险均显著下降。
AI.motivation: 既往证据显示女性房颤患者缺血性卒中风险更高，但女性与男性在心衰风险上是否存在性别差异尚不明确，且缺乏长期时间趋势的人群水平数据。
AI.method: 基于香港全境临床注册数据库的回顾性人群队列研究，纳入1997—2021年新诊断房颤患者130,132例（中位年龄76.6岁，女性48.6%）。采用Poisson回归估计年发病率及发病率比，以全因死亡为竞争事件，用多因素校正Fine-Gray回归模型评估女性与心衰的亚分布风险比。
AI.result: 女性心衰年发病率从1997年的69.6/1000人年降至2021年的16.7/1000人年，男性从44.5降至13.7/1000人年；整个随访期女性发病率持续高于男性（25.3 vs 19.3/1000人年），发病率比1.34（95%CI 1.31-1.37）。女性诊断房颤时年龄更大、基线CHA2DS2-VASc评分更高，且更常被处方减量直接口服抗凝药。
AI.conclusion: 尽管20余年来房颤患者心衰风险总体下降，女性在充分校正时间依赖性合并症后仍存在升高的残余心衰风险，提示需针对女性房颤患者加强心衰预防与随访管理；本研究为观察性注册研究，残余混杂可能影响因果推断。

summary_zh:
背景：尽管有证据表明女性房颤患者缺血性卒中风险较高，但心力衰竭（HF）风险是否存在性别差异仍不确定。

目的：本研究旨在评估房颤（AF）患者新发心力衰竭（HF）时间趋势的性别差异。

方法：利用香港全港临床登记数据库，研究1997年至2021年间新诊断AF的患者。通过泊松回归分析估计年发病率（IR）和发病率比。采用多变量调整的Fine-Gray回归模型检验女性与HF之间的亚分布风险比，并将全因死亡作为竞争事件。

结果：我们纳入了130,132例新诊断AF的患者（中位年龄：76.6岁；IQR：60.4-92.8；48.6%为女性）。1997年至2021年间，女性HF的年IR（每1000人年）从69.6降至16.7，男性从44.5降至13.7。在整个随访期间，女性的IR始终高于男性（IR：25.3 vs 19.3每1000人年），且女性HF风险高于男性（发病率比[95% CI]：1.34 [1.31-1.37]）。与男性相比，女性诊断AF时年龄更大，基线CHA2DS2-VASc评分更高，且更可能被处方减量的直接口服抗凝药。

结论：尽管在二十年的随访中AF患者HF风险总体下降，但在对时变合并症进行完全调整后，女性仍保留较高的残余调整HF风险。

Effects of Pulmonary Vein Isolation on Left Atrial Hemodynamic and Mechanical Function: Insights from Advanced and Emerging Echocardiographic Parameters in Responders and Non-Responders
summary: Background: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is associated with progressive remodeling of the left atrium (LA). Pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) is an established rhythm-control strategy; however, its long-term impact on LA mechanical and hemodynamic function remains insufficiently defined. Objectives: Our objective was to assess long-term changes in LA structure, mechanics, and hemodynamics after PVI, and to compare remodeling patterns between responders and non-responders. Methods: In this prospective observational study, 51 patients undergoing PVI were enrolled. Transthoracic echocardiography was performed before ablation and after 12 months. LA assessment included volumetric parameters, speckle-tracking-derived strain, and advanced functional indices (LA ejection fraction [LAEF], LA emptying fractions, LA function index [LAFI], and LA stiffness index [LAS-si]). Results: Forty-two patients (mean age 61 ± 9 years, 59.6% male) were included; a total of 32 (76.2%) were classified as responders and 10 (23.8%) as non-responders. Longitudinal differences between groups were tested using a Group × Time mixed-design ANOVA with Benjamini–Hochberg correction across the 19 echocardiographic parameters assessed. Non-responders showed a numerically greater decline in peak left atrial reservoir strain (PALS) than responders (95% CI 2.28–10.44; nominal p = 0.003), but this did not remain significant after correction for multiple comparisons (FDR-adjusted p = 0.06) and is therefore considered hypothesis-generating. Directionally consistent, non-significant trends toward greater adverse change among non-responders were also observed for LA volume index, LA ejection fraction, and LA stiffness index (all nominal p 0.07–0.13; all FDR-adjusted p ≥ 0.32). No parameter retained significance after correction for multiple comparisons. Conclusions: In this hypothesis-generating, exploratory study, recurrent arrhythmia after PVI was associated with numerically greater adverse left atrial remodeling than freedom from recurrence, but between-group differences did not remain statistically significant after correction for multiple comparisons. These findings should not be interpreted as evidence that PVI itself caused the observed changes, particularly in the absence of a non-ablated control group, and require confirmation in larger, adequately powered prospective studies incorporating continuous rhythm monitoring.
journal: Journal of Cardiovascular Development and Disease

AI.tldr: 51例房颤患者PVI术后12个月随访，复发者左房储器应变下降幅度数值上大于无复发者，但多重比较校正后差异无统计学意义。
AI.motivation: 房颤导致左房进行性重构，PVI是已确立的节律控制策略，但其对左房机械与血流动力学功能的长期影响尚不明确，且复发者与无复发者的重构模式差异缺乏证据。
AI.method: 前瞻性观察性研究，纳入51例接受PVI的患者，最终42例完成分析（平均年龄61±9岁，男性59.6%）。术前及术后12个月行经胸超声心动图，评估左房容积参数、斑点追踪应变及高级功能指标（LAEF、左房排空分数、LAFI、LAS-si），共19项参数。按复发情况分为应答者32例（76.2%）与无应答者10例（23.8%），采用组×时间混合设计ANOVA并以Benjamini–Hochberg法校正多重比较。
AI.result: 无应答者左房储器峰值应变（PALS）下降幅度数值上大于应答者（95%CI 2.28–10.44；名义P=0.003），但FDR校正后P=0.06，未达统计学显著。左房容积指数、LAEF及左房僵硬度指数亦呈方向一致但无显著性的不良变化趋势（名义P 0.07–0.13；FDR校正P均≥0.32）。校正后无任何参数保持显著。
AI.conclusion: 在本探索性、假设生成性研究中，PVI后心律失常复发与数值上更明显的左房不良重构相关，但组间差异经多重比较校正后不显著；因缺乏未消融对照组，不能推断PVI本身导致上述变化，需更大样本、含连续节律监测的前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh: 背景：心房颤动（AF）与左心房（LA）的进行性重构相关。肺静脉隔离（PVI）是一种成熟的节律控制策略；然而，其对左心房机械和血流动力学功能的长期影响仍未被充分定义。目的：我们的目标是评估PVI后左心房结构、力学和血流动力学的长期变化，并比较应答者和无应答者之间的重构模式。方法：在这项前瞻性观察性研究中，纳入了51例接受PVI的患者。在消融前和12个月后进行了经胸超声心动图检查。左心房评估包括容积参数、斑点追踪衍生的应变以及高级功能指标（左心房射血分数[LAEF]、左心房排空分数、左心房功能指数[LAFI]和左心房僵硬度指数[LAS-si]）。结果：共纳入42例患者（平均年龄61 ± 9岁，59.6%为男性）；总共32例（76.2%）被归类为应答者，10例（23.8%）为无应答者。组间纵向差异使用Group × Time混合设计ANOVA进行检验，并对评估的19项超声心动图参数采用Benjamini–Hochberg校正。无应答者显示左心房储备期峰值应变（PALS）的下降在数值上大于应答者（95% CI 2.28–10.44；名义p = 0.003），但在多重比较校正后未保持显著性（FDR校正p = 0.06），因此被认为是假设生成性的。在无应答者中，还观察到左心房容积指数、左心房射血分数和左心房僵硬度指数在方向上一致、但无显著性的更大不良变化趋势（所有名义p 0.07–0.13；所有FDR校正p ≥ 0.32）。多重比较校正后，没有任何参数保持显著性。结论：在这项假设生成性的探索性研究中，PVI后复发性心律失常与数值上更大的不良左心房重构相关，而非无复发，但组间差异在多重比较校正后未保持统计学显著性。这些发现不应被解释为PVI本身导致了观察到的变化的证据，特别是在缺乏非消融对照组的情况下，并且需要在更大规模、有足够把握度的前瞻性研究中加以确认，这些研究应包含连续节律监测。

title: Patterns and trends in atrial fibrillation and atrial flutter incidence rates in G20 countries (1990–2021) and predictions to 2050
summary: The long-term trend in atrial fibrillation (AF) and atrial flutter (AFL) incidence has rarely been reported from a global perspective. We aimed to explore the past temporal trends (1990-2021) in AF/AFL incidence in group of 20 countries and to predict future trends (2022-2050). Data on yearly AF/AFL incidence by age group and sex were extracted from the global burden of disease study 2021. Age-standardized incidence rates (ASIR) were computed from 1990 to 2021. The number of new cases and incidence rates were predicted to 2050 using the Bayesian age-period-cohort model. The ASIR for AF/AFL exhibited a slight increasing trend on a global scale from 1990 to 2021, with an average annual percent change of 0.5% (95% confidence interval: 0.5-0.5). Canada had the highest ASIR of AF/AFL (97.53/100,000) and showed a significant declining trend from 1990 to 2021, while the USA and Germany showed a clear upward trend and a "wave-like" upward trend, respectively. Notably, Italy experienced a significant increase in the ASIR of AF/AFL during the COVID-19 pandemic (2019-2021), with an annual percent change of 9.3% (95% confidence interval: 6.6-12.0). The ASIR of AF/AFL in developing countries increased more significantly than in developed countries (ASIR change percentage: 4.79% vs 0.20%). The ASIR of AF/AFL is predicted to remain stable or increase in most countries by 2050. AF/AFL remains a significant public health concern, necessitating the development of more precise strategies for prevention, control, and surveillance, particularly among specific populations and endemic countries.

AI.tldr: 1990-2021年全球AF/AFL年龄标化发病率年均增长0.5%，发展中国家增速高于发达国家，预测至2050年多数G20国家发病率稳定或上升。
AI.motivation: AF/AFL的长期全球发病趋势鲜有报道，缺乏从全球视角对G20国家发病模式及未来预测的系统分析，难以指导预防和监测策略。
AI.method: 基于GBD 2021数据，提取G20国家1990-2021年按年龄和性别分层的AF/AFL年发病率，计算年龄标化发病率（ASIR），采用贝叶斯年龄-时期-队列模型预测2022-2050年新发病例数和发病率。
AI.result: 全球ASIR年均变化百分比为0.5%（95%CI 0.5-0.5）。加拿大ASIR最高（97.53/10万）但呈显著下降趋势；美国和德国分别呈明显上升和“波浪状”上升趋势。意大利在COVID-19期间（2019-2021）ASIR显著增加，年变化百分比9.3%（95%CI 6.6-12.0）。发展中国家ASIR变化百分比为4.79%，高于发达国家的0.20%。预测至2050年多数国家ASIR稳定或上升。
AI.conclusion: AF/AFL仍是重要公共卫生问题，需针对特定人群和流行国家制定更精准的预防、控制和监测策略；但研究基于GBD建模数据，存在登记和诊断差异等局限性。

summary_zh: 心房颤动（AF）和心房扑动（AFL）发病率的长期趋势很少从全球视角进行报道。我们旨在探讨20国集团国家AF/AFL发病率的过去时间趋势（1990-2021年），并预测未来趋势（2022-2050年）。从2021年全球疾病负担研究中提取按年龄组和性别划分的年度AF/AFL发病率数据。计算了1990年至2021年的年龄标准化发病率（ASIR）。使用贝叶斯年龄-时期-队列模型预测了到2050年的新发病例数和发病率。1990年至2021年，全球范围内AF/AFL的ASIR呈现轻微上升趋势，平均年度百分比变化为0.5%（95%置信区间：0.5-0.5）。加拿大的AF/AFL ASIR最高（97.53/100,000），并在1990年至2021年间呈现显著下降趋势，而美国和德国分别呈现明显的上升趋势和“波浪状”上升趋势。值得注意的是，意大利在COVID-19大流行期间（2019-2021年）AF/AFL的ASIR显著增加，年度百分比变化为9.3%（95%置信区间：6.6-12.0）。发展中国家的AF/AFL ASIR增加比发达国家更显著（ASIR变化百分比：4.79% vs 0.20%）。预计到2050年，大多数国家的AF/AFL ASIR将保持稳定或增加。AF/AFL仍然是一个重要的公共卫生问题，需要制定更精确的预防、控制和监测策略，特别是在特定人群和地方性流行国家中。

title: Vascular Closure Devices After Femoral Access in Adult EP Procedures: Updated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Femoral vascular access is integral to diagnostic and therapeutic electrophysiology (EP) procedures but is associated with bleeding and access-site complications. Manual compression and figure-of-eight sutures remain widely used for hemostasis; however, they are resource intensive and delay ambulation. Vascular closure devices (VCDs) have been introduced to facilitate rapid hemostasis and improve procedural efficiency, yet evidence specific to adult EP procedures remain conflicting.

OBJECTIVES: To systematically evaluate the safety and efficacy of vascular closure devices compared with manual compression or figure-of-eight sutures for femoral access-site closure in adult electrophysiology procedures.

METHODS: A systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted in accordance with PRISMA 2020 guidelines. PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Cochrane CENTRAL, and Scopus were searched from inception through January 2026. Randomized controlled trials and observational studies enrolling adults (≥ 18 years) undergoing diagnostic electrophysiology studies or catheter ablation with femoral access were included. Structural and valvular interventions were excluded. Random-effects meta-analyses were performed. Safety outcomes were summarized using risk ratios (RRs), and efficiency outcomes using standardized mean differences (SMDs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs).

RESULTS: Eighteen studies (10 randomized controlled trials and 8 observational studies) involving 40,632 patients were included. Compared with manual compression, VCD was associated with significantly lower risks of access-site hematoma (RR, 0.59; 95% CI, 0.46-0.71), major bleeding (RR, 0.72; 95% CI, 0.55-0.88), minor bleeding (RR, 0.55; 95% CI, 0.17-0.93), and pseudoaneurysm formation (RR, 0.69; 95% CI, 0.54-0.83), with minimal heterogeneity for these outcomes. Absolute risk reductions were modest (number needed to treat: 90 for hematoma; 430 for pseudoaneurysm). VCDs significantly reduced time to hemostasis (SMD, -2.90; 95% CI, -3.71 to -2.08), time to ambulation (SMD, -1.84; 95% CI, -2.45 to -1.24), and time to hospital discharge (SMD, -1.12; 95% CI, -1.66 to -0.58), although heterogeneity for time-based outcomes was high. No significant differences were observed in infection or hospital readmission rates.

CONCLUSIONS: In adult electrophysiology procedures, vascular closure devices are associated with modest reductions in access-site complications and substantial improvements in procedural efficiency. These findings support selective adoption of VCDs to optimize patient recovery and workflow, particularly in high-volume EP centers.

AI.tldr: 在成人电生理手术中，血管闭合装置较手动压迫可轻度降低血管入路并发症，并显著缩短止血、下床及出院时间。
AI.motivation: 股静脉入路是电生理手术的基础，但手动压迫和8字缝合止血资源消耗大且延迟下床，血管闭合装置（VCD）证据在成人电生理人群中存在矛盾，需系统评价其安全性和有效性。
AI.method: 系统综述与荟萃分析，遵循PRISMA 2020，检索PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Cochrane CENTRAL和Scopus至2026年1月，纳入18项研究（10项RCT和8项观察性研究），共40,632例成人诊断性电生理检查或导管消融患者，排除结构性和瓣膜介入，采用随机效应模型，安全性终点用风险比（RR），效率终点用标准化均数差（SMD）及95%CI。
AI.result: 与手动压迫相比，VCD显著降低入路部位血肿（RR 0.59，95%CI 0.46-0.71）、大出血（RR 0.72，95%CI 0.55-0.88）、小出血（RR 0.55，95%CI 0.17-0.93）和假性动脉瘤（RR 0.69，95%CI 0.54-0.83），异质性低；绝对风险降低幅度有限（NNT：血肿90，假性动脉瘤430）。VCD显著缩短止血时间（SMD -2.90，95%CI -3.71至-2.08）、下床时间（SMD -1.84，95%CI -2.45至-1.24）和出院时间（SMD -1.12，95%CI -1.66至-0.58），但时间终点异质性高。感染和再入院率无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 在成人电生理手术中，VCD与入路并发症的轻度降低和手术效率的显著改善相关，支持在高容量电生理中心选择性使用VCD以优化患者恢复和工作流程；但绝对获益有限且时间终点异质性高，需结合患者和中心条件个体化决策。

summary_zh:
背景：股血管入路是诊断性和治疗性电生理（EP）手术的重要组成部分，但与出血和入路部位并发症相关。手动压迫和8字缝合仍是广泛使用的止血方法；然而，它们资源消耗大且延迟下床活动。血管闭合装置（VCDs）已被引入以促进快速止血和提高手术效率，但针对成人EP手术的具体证据仍存在矛盾。

目的：系统评估血管闭合装置与手动压迫或8字缝合相比，在成人电生理手术中用于股动脉入路部位闭合的安全性和有效性。

方法：根据PRISMA 2020指南进行了系统综述和荟萃分析。检索了PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Cochrane CENTRAL和Scopus从建库至2026年1月。纳入随机对照试验和观察性研究，研究对象为接受诊断性电生理检查或经股动脉入路导管消融的成人（≥18岁）。排除结构性和瓣膜介入治疗。进行随机效应荟萃分析。安全性结局使用风险比（RRs）总结，效率结局使用标准化均数差（SMDs）及95%置信区间（CIs）总结。

结果：共纳入18项研究（10项随机对照试验和8项观察性研究），涉及40,632名患者。与手动压迫相比，VCD与显著降低的入路部位血肿（RR，0.59；95% CI，0.46-0.71）、大出血（RR，0.72；95% CI，0.55-0.88）、小出血（RR，0.55；95% CI，0.17-0.93）和假性动脉瘤形成（RR，0.69；95% CI，0.54-0.83）风险相关，这些结局的异质性极小。绝对风险降低幅度适中（需治疗人数：血肿为90；假性动脉瘤为430）。VCDs显著缩短了止血时间（SMD，-2.90；95% CI，-3.71至-2.08）、下床活动时间（SMD，-1.84；95% CI，-2.45至-1.24）和出院时间（SMD，-1.12；95% CI，-1.66至-0.58），尽管基于时间的结局异质性较高。感染或再入院率未观察到显著差异。

结论：在成人电生理手术中，血管闭合装置与入路部位并发症的适度减少和手术效率的显著改善相关。这些发现支持选择性采用VCDs以优化患者康复和工作流程，尤其是在高容量EP中心。

title: Safety of Pulsed Field Ablation: Established Evidence, Emerging Risks, and Knowledge Gaps.
summary: Pulsed field ablation (PFA) has rapidly emerged as an important ablation technology for atrial arrhythmias and is increasingly being explored for ventricular arrhythmias. As clinical experience expands, a precise understanding of its safety profile is essential. This review summarizes contemporary evidence on the safety of PFA, distinguishes procedure-related complications from those attributable to electroporation, and highlights areas in which evidence remains limited.

AI.tldr: 脉冲场消融安全性证据综述：操作相关并发症与电穿孔特异性风险需区分，部分领域证据仍有限。
AI.motivation: 脉冲场消融（PFA）已快速成为房性心律失常的重要消融技术，并逐步探索用于室性心律失常；随着临床经验积累，需精确理解其安全性特征，明确哪些并发症与操作相关、哪些源于电穿孔本身，并识别证据缺口。
AI.method: 本文为综述，总结PFA安全性的当代证据，区分操作相关并发症与电穿孔归因并发症，并指出证据有限的领域；摘要未报告系统检索策略、纳入研究数量或样本量。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体安全性数值（如并发症发生率、效应量、95%CI或P值），仅定性指出需区分操作相关与电穿孔相关并发症，并强调部分领域证据有限。
AI.conclusion: PFA安全性需从操作相关和电穿孔特异性两个层面认识；当前证据在若干领域仍不充分，提示临床实践中应关注新兴风险并开展进一步研究以填补知识缺口。

summary_zh: 脉冲场消融（PFA）已迅速成为一种重要的房性心律失常消融技术，并日益被探索用于室性心律失常。随着临床经验的积累，对其安全性特征的精确理解至关重要。本综述总结了关于PFA安全性的当代证据，区分了手术相关并发症与归因于电穿孔的并发症，并强调了证据仍然有限的领域。

title: Supranormal lung function and incident atrial fibrillation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Whether supranormal lung function is associated with incident atrial fibrillation (AF), and whether obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA) modifies this association, remain to be determined.

METHODS: We analysed 2,408 participants from the Sleep Heart Health Study who were free of AF at baseline and had no spirometric airflow obstruction. The primary analysis classified forced expiratory volume in 1 second (FEV1) as below normal, normal, or supranormal using race-neutral Global Lung Function Initiative (GLI) Global (2022) reference equations. Categories defined by forced vital capacity (FVC) were examined in a secondary analysis. Associations with incident AF were evaluated using multivariable logistic regression to estimate odds ratios (ORs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Firth penalised logistic regression and sensitivity analyses were used to assess the robustness of the findings. Interaction with OSA was explored.

RESULTS: Among 2,408 participants, 282 developed AF. Compared with normal FEV1, supranormal FEV1 was associated with lower odds of incident AF in the primary adjusted model (OR, 0.420; 95% CI, 0.198-0.888). The corresponding Firth estimate was 0.443 (95% CI, 0.199-0.869). Supranormal FVC showed a similar association in standard logistic regression (OR, 0.351; 95% CI, 0.167-0.736) and Firth penalised logistic regression (OR, 0.371; 95% CI, 0.168-0.721). The direction of the associations was generally consistent across sensitivity analyses. There was no statistically significant evidence of effect modification by OSA.

CONCLUSIONS: Supranormal lung function was associated with lower odds of incident AF. These findings support supranormal spirometry as a potential marker of favourable systemic and cardiopulmonary physiology.

AI.tldr: 在无气流阻塞人群中，超常肺功能（FEV1或FVC高于正常）与房颤新发风险降低约55%-65%相关，且该关联不受阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停影响。
AI.motivation: 超常肺功能是否与房颤新发相关，以及阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）是否修饰该关联，此前尚未明确。
AI.method: 基于睡眠心脏健康研究（Sleep Heart Health Study）的回顾性队列分析，纳入2408例基线无房颤且无气流阻塞的参与者。主要分析采用种族中立的GLI Global（2022）参考方程将FEV1分为低于正常、正常和超常三组，次要分析采用FVC分类。终点为新发房颤。采用多变量logistic回归估计OR及95%CI，并用Firth惩罚logistic回归和敏感性分析验证稳健性，同时探索与OSA的交互作用。
AI.result: 中位随访期间282例发生房颤。与正常FEV1相比，超常FEV1与新发房颤风险降低相关（校正OR 0.420，95%CI 0.198-0.888；Firth估计OR 0.443，95%CI 0.199-0.869）。超常FVC也显示类似关联（标准logistic回归OR 0.351，95%CI 0.167-0.736；Firth回归OR 0.371，95%CI 0.168-0.721）。敏感性分析结果方向一致。未发现OSA对该关联有显著效应修饰（交互作用P值摘要未报告）。
AI.conclusion: 超常肺功能与房颤新发风险降低相关，提示超常肺量计指标可能是良好全身及心肺生理状态的潜在标志物。该发现对房颤风险评估有潜在意义，但研究为观察性设计，残余混杂不能排除，且OSA交互作用未达统计学显著，需进一步验证。

summary_zh:
背景：超常肺功能是否与心房颤动（AF）的发生相关，以及阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）是否修饰这种关联，仍有待确定。

方法：我们分析了睡眠心脏健康研究中的2,408名参与者，这些参与者在基线时无AF，且无肺功能气流阻塞。主要分析使用种族中立的全球肺功能倡议（GLI）全球（2022）参考方程，将第一秒用力呼气容积（FEV1）分类为低于正常、正常或超常。在二次分析中检查了由用力肺活量（FVC）定义的类别。使用多变量逻辑回归评估与 incident AF 的关联，以估计比值比（ORs）和95%置信区间（CIs）。使用Firth惩罚逻辑回归和敏感性分析评估发现的稳健性。探讨了与OSA的交互作用。

结果：在2,408名参与者中，282人发生了AF。与正常FEV1相比，超常FEV1在主要调整模型中与较低的 incident AF 几率相关（OR，0.420；95% CI，0.198-0.888）。相应的Firth估计值为0.443（95% CI，0.199-0.869）。超常FVC在标准逻辑回归（OR，0.351；95% CI，0.167-0.736）和Firth惩罚逻辑回归（OR，0.371；95% CI，0.168-0.721）中显示出类似的关联。关联的方向在敏感性分析中总体一致。没有统计学显著证据表明OSA有效应修饰作用。

结论：超常肺功能与较低的 incident AF 几率相关。这些发现支持超常肺功能测定作为有利的系统性和心肺生理学的潜在标志物。

title: An Obesity Paradox in Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence after Cardioversion: Evidence From a Vietnamese Cohort
summary: Introduction Predictors of Atrial Fibrillation (AF) recurrence after Direct-Current Cardioversion (DCCV) remain incompletely characterized in Southeast Asian populations. About 3 months of AF recurrence rate was evaluated, and clinical and echocardiographic factors associated with early recurrence were examined in a Vietnamese cohort. Methods This single-center observational cohort study included 96 patients with AF who underwent successful DCCV between December 2022 and April 2025 at the Tam Duc Heart Hospital in Vietnam. Baseline clinical, echocardiographic, and biochemical parameters were collected. The primary outcome was AF recurrence within 3 months. Multivariable logistic regression identified independent predictors. Model discrimination was assessed using receiver operating characteristic analysis. Results AF recurred in 39 patients (40.6%). Larger Left Atrial Diameter (LAD) was independently associated with recurrence (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] per 1 mm, 1.13; 95% CI, 1.03–1.25; p = 0.011), while higher Body Mass Index (BMI) was inversely associated (aOR per 1 kg/m 2 , 0.85; 95% CI, 0.74–0.99; p = 0.038). An integrative model (LAD, BMI, age) showed modestly improved discrimination versus LAD alone (AUC 0.73 vs . 0.62; p = 0.03). Discussion Larger left atrial size reflects structural remodeling and remains a consistent predictor of AF recurrence. The inverse association between BMI and recurrence may reflect a potential obesity paradox but should be considered hypothesis-generating given the modest sample size and possible residual confounding. Conclusion Larger left atrial size and lower BMI were independently associated with early AF recurrence after successful DCCV. A simple model incorporating LAD, BMI, and age may assist preliminary risk stratification but requires external validation before clinical application.

AI.tldr: 越南房颤患者直流电复律后3个月内复发率40.6%，左房内径增大是独立危险因素，而BMI较高与复发风险降低相关，提示可能的肥胖悖论。
AI.motivation: 东南亚人群中房颤直流电复律后复发的预测因素尚不明确，既往证据多来自欧美人群，缺乏越南队列数据，本研究旨在评估早期复发率及相关临床和超声心动图因素。
AI.method: 单中心观察性队列研究，纳入2022年12月至2025年4月在越南Tam Duc心脏医院成功行直流电复律的96例房颤患者，收集基线临床、超声心动图和生化参数。主要终点为3个月内房颤复发。采用多变量logistic回归识别独立预测因素，并用ROC分析评估模型区分度。
AI.result: 39例（40.6%）患者复发。左房内径增大与复发独立相关（每增加1 mm，aOR 1.13；95% CI 1.03–1.25；p=0.011），而BMI较高与复发风险降低独立相关（每增加1 kg/m²，aOR 0.85；95% CI 0.74–0.99；p=0.038）。整合模型（左房内径、BMI、年龄）的区分度较单用左房内径略有提高（AUC 0.73 vs 0.62；p=0.03）。
AI.conclusion: 左房内径增大和较低BMI是成功直流电复律后早期房颤复发的独立相关因素。包含左房内径、BMI和年龄的简单模型可能有助于初步风险分层，但样本量有限且可能存在残余混杂，肥胖悖论需进一步验证，临床应用前需外部验证。

summary_zh:
引言：直流电复律（DCCV）后心房颤动（AF）复发的预测因素在东南亚人群中仍不完全明确。本研究在越南队列中评估了约3个月的AF复发率，并检查了与早期复发相关的临床和超声心动图因素。

方法：这项单中心观察性队列研究纳入了2022年12月至2025年4月在越南Tam Duc心脏医院成功接受DCCV的96例AF患者。收集了基线临床、超声心动图和生化参数。主要结局是3个月内AF复发。多变量逻辑回归确定了独立预测因素。使用受试者工作特征分析评估模型区分度。

结果：39例患者（40.6%）AF复发。较大的左心房内径（LAD）与复发独立相关（调整比值比[aOR]每1 mm，1.13；95% CI，1.03–1.25；p = 0.011），而较高的体重指数（BMI）呈负相关（aOR每1 kg/m2，0.85；95% CI，0.74–0.99；p = 0.038）。一个整合模型（LAD、BMI、年龄）与单独LAD相比显示出适度改善的区分度（AUC 0.73 vs. 0.62；p = 0.03）。

讨论：较大的左心房尺寸反映了结构重构，并且仍然是AF复发的 consistent 预测因素。BMI与复发之间的负相关可能反映了潜在的肥胖悖论，但鉴于样本量适中且可能存在残余混杂，应视为产生假设。

结论：较大的左心房尺寸和较低的BMI与成功DCCV后早期AF复发独立相关。一个包含LAD、BMI和年龄的简单模型可能有助于初步风险分层，但在临床应用前需要外部验证。

title: Assessment of Patients' Awareness of Anticoagulant Use in Atrial Fibrillation: A Cross-Sectional Survey.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: Atrial fibrillation (AF) increases thromboembolic risk, and oral anticoagulants (OACs) substantially reduce this risk; however, their safe and effective use requires adequate patient knowledge. We aimed to assess AF- and OAC-related awareness among Turkish patients and to identify predictors of knowledge.

METHOD: This single-center, cross-sectional survey was conducted between July 1, 2024 and January 1, 2025, and included consecutive adults with non-valvular AF receiving warfarin or direct OACs for at least three months. A structured questionnaire collected data on demographic characteristics, comorbidities, medication use, adherence, and knowledge across six domains: arrhythmia name, treatment indication, dosing schedule, side effects, drug and food interactions, and consequences of dose modification. A composite knowledge score (range, 0���6) was calculated. Multivariable linear regression was used to evaluate predictors of knowledge, including age, sex, and education level. Ethics approval was obtained, and all participants provided written informed consent.

RESULTS: A total of 261 patients were included (median age, 67 years; 50.2% women). Hypertension and diabetes mellitus were present in 64.8% and 32.2% of patients, respectively. Direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs) accounted for 72.4% of prescriptions, whereas 27.6% of patients received warfarin. Although 36% of participants had AF for more than six years, only 16.5% could correctly name their arrhythmia. While 92% knew they were taking an anticoagulant, 24% misunderstood its indication. Knowledge of side effects was limited, with 68% reporting no awareness. Awareness of interactions was poor: 88% reported no knowledge of drug���drug interactions, and 71% were unaware of food interactions. Most patients knew their dosing schedule (92.3%) and reported that they would not double a missed dose (99.6%). Self-reported adherence was high (94% 'always' and 4% 'often'), and taking medication with meals was associated with better adherence (���� = 17.0, P < 0.001). The mean knowledge score was 2.8 +- 1.3 (Cronbach's �� = 0.50). Higher educational attainment and female sex were associated with greater knowledge, whereas age was inversely associated with knowledge.

CONCLUSION: Despite high self-reported adherence, substantial knowledge gaps persist among patients receiving anticoagulation for AF, particularly regarding side effects and drug or food interactions. Targeted, health-literacy-sensitive educational strategies may improve medication safety and clinical outcomes in patients receiving anticoagulation for AF.

AI.tldr: 土耳其非瓣膜性房颤抗凝患者虽自报依从性高，但知识评分仅2.8/6，对副作用和药物/食物相互作用认知严重不足。
AI.motivation: 房颤增加血栓栓塞风险，口服抗凝药可显著降低风险，但安全有效使用需要患者充分的知识。既往证据显示患者对抗凝治疗认知不足，但土耳其人群的数据有限，且缺乏对知识预测因素的分析。
AI.method: 单中心横断面调查，2024年7月1日至2025年1月1日连续纳入接受华法林或直接口服抗凝药至少3个月的非瓣膜性房颤成人患者。使用结构化问卷收集人口学特征、合并症、用药、依从性及六个领域的知识（心律失常名称、治疗指征、给药方案、副作用、药物和食物相互作用、剂量调整后果），计算复合知识评分（0-6分）。采用多变量线性回归分析年龄、性别和教育水平等知识预测因素。
AI.result: 共纳入261例患者（中位年龄67岁，50.2%女性）。高血压和糖尿病分别占64.8%和32.2%。直接口服抗凝药占72.4%，华法林占27.6%。36%患者房颤病程超过6年，但仅16.5%能正确说出心律失常名称。92%知道正在服用抗凝药，但24%误解其指征。68%对副作用无认知。88%不了解药物相互作用，71%不了解食物相互作用。92.3%知道给药方案，99.6%表示不会加倍漏服剂量。自报依从性高（94%“总是”和4%“经常”），随餐服药与更好依从性相关（β=17.0，P<0.001）。平均知识评分2.8±1.3（Cronbach's α=0.50）。较高教育水平和女性与更高知识相关，年龄与知识负相关。
AI.conclusion: 尽管自报依从性高，房颤抗凝患者仍存在显著知识缺口，尤其是副作用和药物/食物相互作用方面。需要针对健康素养的教育策略以提高用药安全和临床结局。临床电生理实践中应加强患者教育，特别是对老年、低教育水平和男性患者。局限性包括单中心设计、自报依从性可能高估、知识评分信度中等。

summary_zh:
目的：心房颤动（AF）增加血栓栓塞风险，口服抗凝药（OACs）可显著降低该风险；然而，其安全有效的使用需要患者具备足够的知识。我们旨在评估土耳其患者对AF和OAC相关知识的认知，并确定知识的预测因素。

方法：这项单中心、横断面调查于2024年7月1日至2025年1月1日进行，连续纳入接受华法林或直接口服抗凝药治疗至少三个月的非瓣膜性AF成年患者。采用结构化问卷收集人口学特征、合并症、用药情况、依从性以及六个领域的知识：心律失常名称、治疗指征、给药方案、副作用、药物和食物相互作用以及剂量调整的后果。计算综合知识评分（范围0-6）。采用多变量线性回归评估知识的预测因素，包括年龄、性别和教育水平。研究获得伦理批准，所有参与者均提供书面知情同意。

结果：共纳入261例患者（中位年龄67岁；50.2%为女性）。高血压和糖尿病分别占64.8%和32.2%。直接口服抗凝药（DOACs）占处方的72.4%，而27.6%的患者接受华法林。尽管36%的参与者AF病程超过六年，但仅16.5%能正确说出其心律失常名称。92%知道自己在服用抗凝药，但24%误解其指征。对副作用的知识有限，68%报告不知晓。对相互作用的认识较差：88%报告不了解药物-药物相互作用，71%不了解食物相互作用。大多数患者知道其给药方案（92.3%），并报告不会将漏服的剂量加倍（99.6%）。自我报告的依从性高（94%“总是”和4%“经常”），随餐服药与更好的依从性相关（β = 17.0，P < 0.001）。平均知识评分为2.8 ± 1.3（Cronbach's α = 0.50）。较高的教育程度和女性与更高的知识相关，而年龄与知识呈负相关。

结论：尽管自我报告的依从性高，但接受AF抗凝治疗的患者仍存在显著的知识差距，特别是在副作用和药物或食物相互作用方面。针对性的、对健康素养敏感的教育策略可能会改善接受AF抗凝治疗患者的用药安全和临床结局。

title: Albumin-based nutritional-inflammatory indices and prognosis in critically ill patients with acute myocardial infarction: a MIMIC-IV cohort study.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: This study investigated the associations between 12 albumin-based nutritional-inflammatory indices and adverse outcomes in critically ill patients with acute myocardial infarction and compared their prognostic performance.

METHODS: A retrospective cohort study was conducted using the MIMIC-IV database, which includes data from 2,255 critically ill AMI patients. Twelve nutritional and inflammatory indices were assessed: Advanced Lung Cancer Inflammation Index (ALI), Blood Urea Nitrogen to Albumin Ratio (BAR), Creatinine to Albumin Ratio (CAR), Controlling Nutritional Status (CONUT) score, Geriatric Nutritional Risk Index (GNRI), Hemoglobin-Albumin-Lymphocyte-Platelet (HALP) score, Lactate to Albumin Ratio (LAR), Monocyte to Albumin Ratio (MAR), Neutrophil to Albumin Ratio (NAR), Neutrophil Percentage to Albumin Ratio (NPAR), Prognostic Nutritional Index (PNI), and Red Cell Distribution Width to Albumin Ratio (RAR). The primary outcomes were 30-day and 365-day all-cause mortality (ACM), while secondary outcomes included new-onset atrial fibrillation (NOAF), new-onset ventricular arrhythmia (NOVA), and acute heart failure (AHF).

RESULTS: In fully adjusted models, lower levels of GNRI, HALP, and PNI, and higher levels of BAR, CAR, CONUT, LAR, NPAR, and RAR were independently associated with increased 30-day and 365-day ACM. Restricted cubic spline analyses revealed nonlinear relationships for several indices (ALI, BAR, CAR, LAR, PNI). Among the indices evaluated, LAR showed the highest discriminatory performance for 30-day all-cause mortality (AUC = 0.719), whereas BAR showed the highest discriminatory performance for 365-day all-cause mortality (AUC = 0.717). Incremental predictive analyses further supported the additional prognostic information provided by these indices compared with albumin alone. Multiple nutritional indices were significantly associated with both NOAF and NOVA during AMI hospitalization, whereas no significant associations were found with AHF or mechanical complications. However, the findings for mechanical complications should be interpreted cautiously because of the limited number of events.

CONCLUSION: Albumin-based nutritional-inflammatory indices provide additional prognostic information in critically ill patients with acute myocardial infarction. LAR and BAR showed the greatest discriminatory performance for short- and long-term mortality, respectively, but should be considered adjunctive risk-stratification markers rather than stand-alone clinical decision tools.

AI.tldr: 在MIMIC-IV危重AMI患者中，基于白蛋白的营养炎症指标与30天及365天全因死亡独立相关，LAR对短期死亡、BAR对长期死亡的判别力最佳。
AI.motivation: 危重急性心肌梗死患者营养与炎症状态常并存，既往多用单一白蛋白评估预后，缺乏对多种白蛋白相关营养炎症复合指标的系统比较，也缺乏其与房颤、室性心律失常等电生理相关结局关联的证据。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，基于MIMIC-IV数据库纳入2255例危重AMI患者，评估ALI、BAR、CAR、CONUT、GNRI、HALP、LAR、MAR、NAR、NPAR、PNI、RAR共12项白蛋白相关营养炎症指标。主要终点为30天和365天全因死亡，次要终点为新发房颤、新发室性心律失常和急性心力衰竭；采用多因素校正模型、限制性立方样条及ROC曲线下面积评估关联与判别力，并做增量预测分析。
AI.result: 完全校正模型中，GNRI、HALP、PNI较低及BAR、CAR、CONUT、LAR、NPAR、RAR较高均与30天和365天全因死亡风险升高独立相关；ALI、BAR、CAR、LAR、PNI呈非线性关系。LAR对30天全因死亡判别力最高（AUC=0.719），BAR对365天全因死亡判别力最高（AUC=0.717），增量分析显示其优于单用白蛋白。多项指标与住院期间新发房颤和新发室性心律失常显著相关，与急性心衰及机械并发症无显著关联，但机械并发症事件数有限需谨慎解读。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI及P值。
AI.conclusion: 白蛋白相关营养炎症指标可为危重AMI患者提供额外预后信息，LAR和BAR分别对短期与长期死亡判别力最佳，但仅宜作为辅助风险分层工具而非独立临床决策依据；其与房颤及室性心律失常的关联提示营养炎症状态可能参与电生理并发症发生，需前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
目的：本研究探讨了12种基于白蛋白的营养-炎症指数与危重急性心肌梗死患者不良结局之间的关联，并比较了它们的预后预测效能。

方法：采用MIMIC-IV数据库进行了一项回顾性队列研究，该数据库包含2,255例危重AMI患者的数据。评估了12种营养和炎症指数：晚期肺癌炎症指数（ALI）、血尿素氮与白蛋白比值（BAR）、肌酐与白蛋白比值（CAR）、控制营养状态（CONUT）评分、老年营养风险指数（GNRI）、血红蛋白-白蛋白-淋巴细胞-血小板（HALP）评分、乳酸与白蛋白比值（LAR）、单核细胞与白蛋白比值（MAR）、中性粒细胞与白蛋白比值（NAR）、中性粒细胞百分比与白蛋白比值（NPAR）、预后营养指数（PNI）以及红细胞分布宽度与白蛋白比值（RAR）。主要结局为30天和365天全因死亡率（ACM），次要结局包括新发心房颤动（NOAF）、新发室性心律失常（NOVA）和急性心力衰竭（AHF）。

结果：在完全校正模型中，较低的GNRI、HALP和PNI水平，以及较高的BAR、CAR、CONUT、LAR、NPAR和RAR水平，与30天和365天ACM风险增加独立相关。限制性立方样条分析揭示了若干指数（ALI、BAR、CAR、LAR、PNI）的非线性关系。在评估的指数中，LAR对30天全因死亡率的区分效能最高（AUC = 0.719），而BAR对365天全因死亡率的区分效能最高（AUC = 0.717）。增量预测分析进一步支持了这些指数相较于单独白蛋白所提供的额外预后信息。多种营养指数与AMI住院期间NOAF和NOVA均显著相关，而未发现与AHF或机械并发症有显著关联。然而，由于事件数量有限，机械并发症的研究结果应谨慎解读。

结论：基于白蛋白的营养-炎症指数为危重急性心肌梗死患者提供了额外的预后信息。LAR和BAR分别对短期和长期死亡率显示出最高的区分效能，但应被视为辅助性风险分层标志物，而非独立的临床决策工具。

title: Central Composite Design-Optimized Dabigatran Etexilate Cubosomes for Sustained Oral Release and Enhanced In Vivo Pharmacokinetics.
summary:
OBJECTIVES: Dabigatran etexilate mesylate (DEM), a prodrug of the direct thrombin inhibitor dabigatran used for stroke prevention in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation, exhibits poor aqueous solubility, P-glycoprotein-mediated efflux, and limited oral bioavailability, which pose challenges for oral delivery. This study aimed to develop and optimize a cubosome-based nanocarrier system to enhance the oral bioavailability and sustain the release of DEM.

METHODS: DEM-loaded cubosomes were prepared using glycerol monooleate (GMO) and Poloxamer 407 by melt dispersion-emulsification. A Central Composite Design (CCD) was employed to optimize formulation variables based on particle size, entrapment efficiency, and drug release responses. Optimized formulations were characterized by dynamic light scattering, TEM, FT-IR, DSC, and XRD analyses. In vitro drug release and in vivo pharmacokinetic studies in Wistar rats were performed to evaluate sustained release behavior and relative oral bioavailability enhancement.

RESULTS: The optimized cubosomes exhibited nanoscale particle size (~ 19-30 nm), narrow size distribution, high entrapment efficiency (~ 87%), and sustained biphasic drug release up to 24 h. Structural characterization supported incorporation of DEM within the lipid matrix and reduced drug crystallinity. In vivo pharmacokinetic evaluation demonstrated prolonged plasma exposure and enhanced relative bioavailability compared with the marketed formulation, with approximately 2.28-fold higher relative bioavailability.

CONCLUSIONS: The optimized cubosomal system effectively improved the oral delivery and sustained release of DEM. The formulation demonstrated enhanced relative bioavailability and prolonged systemic exposure, supporting further development for oral DEM delivery. Anticoagulant efficacy, gastrointestinal safety, and appropriate dosing regimens remain to be established.

AI.tldr: CCD优化的大黄酸达比加群酯立方体纳米载体粒径约19-30 nm、包封率约87%，在大鼠中相对生物利用度提高约2.28倍并实现24小时缓释。
AI.motivation: 达比加群酯甲磺酸盐（DEM）是直接凝血酶抑制剂达比加群的前药，用于非瓣膜性房颤卒中预防，但水溶性差、受P-糖蛋白外排影响、口服生物利用度有限，制约其口服递送，因此需要开发纳米载体改善吸收并实现缓释。
AI.method: 制剂学研究。以单油酸甘油酯（GMO）和Poloxamer 407为材料，采用熔融分散-乳化法制备载DEM立方体；用中心复合设计（CCD）以粒径、包封率、释药行为为响应优化处方；用动态光散射、TEM、FT-IR、DSC、XRD表征；开展体外释放试验及Wistar大鼠体内药代动力学研究，评价缓释行为与相对口服生物利用度。
AI.result: 优化立方体粒径约19-30 nm、分布窄、包封率约87%，体外呈双相缓释达24小时；结构表征提示DEM嵌入脂质基质且药物结晶度降低。大鼠药代动力学显示血浆暴露时间延长，相对生物利用度较市售制剂提高约2.28倍。抗凝疗效、胃肠道安全性及合适给药方案摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 该立方体纳米系统可改善DEM口服递送并实现缓释，提高相对生物利用度、延长全身暴露，支持进一步开发；但尚缺乏抗凝疗效、胃肠道安全性和剂量方案数据，距离临床用于房颤卒中预防仍有较大距离，对当前电生理抗凝实践暂无直接影响。

summary_zh:
目的：甲磺酸达比加群酯（DEM）是直接凝血酶抑制剂达比加群的前体药物，用于非瓣膜性心房颤动的卒中预防，其水溶性差、存在P-糖蛋白介导的外排以及口服生物利用度有限，给口服给药带来挑战。本研究旨在开发并优化基于立方体的纳米载体系统，以提高DEM的口服生物利用度并实现缓释。

方法：采用熔融分散-乳化法，以单油酸甘油酯（GMO）和泊洛沙姆407制备载DEM立方体。采用中心复合设计（CCD），基于粒径、包封率和药物释放响应优化处方变量。通过动态光散射、TEM、FT-IR、DSC和XRD分析对优化处方进行表征。进行体外药物释放和Wistar大鼠体内药代动力学研究，以评估缓释行为和相对口服生物利用度的提高。

结果：优化的立方体表现出纳米级粒径（约19-30 nm）、窄粒径分布、高包封率（约87%）以及长达24小时的持续双相药物释放。结构表征支持DEM掺入脂质基质中并降低药物结晶度。体内药代动力学评价显示，与市售制剂相比，血浆暴露时间延长，相对生物利用度提高，相对生物利用度约高2.28倍。

结论：优化的立方体系统有效改善了DEM的口服递送和缓释。该制剂表现出提高的相对生物利用度和延长的全身暴露，支持进一步开发用于DEM口服递送。抗凝疗效、胃肠道安全性和适当的给药方案仍有待确定。

title: Ventricular Arrhythmias
summary: In the absence of heart disease, premature ventricular complexes (PVCs) are generally benign and do not clearly portend an increased risk of sudden or cardiac death, regardless of their frequency or pattern. Sustained ventricular tachycardia (VT) is typically secondary to an underlying heart disease. Non-sustained VT typically occurs in patients with underlying heart disease. The most common polymorphic VT is a polymorphic VT without baseline QT prolongation. Even without QT prolongation, bradycardia and long pauses may lead to early after depolarizations and spontaneous action potentials that initiate reentry in a patient with underlying myocardial disease. Implantable cardioverter defibrillatoris indicated in patients with LQT syndrome and prior cardiac arrest. Arrhythmogenic right ventricular dysplasia or cardiomyopathy presents between 10 and 50 years of age, more commonly in men, and is familial in 30–50% of the cases. Pre-participation cardiac screening of athletes is a matter of controversy.

AI.tldr: 无结构性心脏病时，无论频度或形态，室性早搏通常良性，不明确增加猝死或心源性死亡风险；持续性室速多继发于基础心脏病。
AI.motivation: 临床常需判断室性心律失常的预后意义及干预指征，尤其无心脏病患者的室早、非持续性室速，以及多形性室速的机制与危险分层尚需梳理。
AI.method: 本文为综述性论述，未报告系统检索策略、纳入研究数量或统计方法；基于现有证据总结不同室性心律失常的临床意义与处理原则。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量数据或统计结果。要点：无心脏病者室早通常良性；持续性室速多继发基础心脏病；非持续性室速多见于基础心脏病患者；最常见多形性室速不伴基线QT延长，但心动过缓与长间歇可致早期后除极和自发性动作电位，在心肌病患者中诱发折返；LQT综合征且有心脏骤停史者推荐ICD；致心律失常性右室发育不良/心肌病发病年龄10–50岁，男性多见，30–50%家族性；运动员参赛前心脏筛查存在争议。
AI.conclusion: 室性心律失常的危险分层应结合基础心脏病、QT间期及家族史；无心脏病室早多无需过度干预，而LQT合并心脏骤停等高风险者需ICD。运动员筛查争议提示需个体化评估。本文为叙述性综述，缺乏系统证据评价，结论需结合指南与个体情况。

summary_zh: 在无心脏病的情况下，室性早搏（PVCs）通常是良性的，无论其频率或模式如何，均不明确预示猝死或心源性死亡风险增加。持续性室性心动过速（VT）通常继发于潜在的心脏病。非持续性VT通常发生于有潜在心脏病的患者。最常见的多形性VT是不伴基线QT延长的多形性VT。即使无QT延长，心动过缓与长间歇也可能导致早期后除极和自发性动作电位，从而在存在潜在心肌疾病的患者中诱发折返。植入式心律转复除颤器适用于LQT综合征及既往心脏骤停的患者。致心律失常性右心室发育不良或心肌病发病年龄在10至50岁之间，男性更常见，30–50%的病例呈家族性。运动员的参赛前心脏筛查存在争议。

title: E-cigarettes and cardiovascular health: a review of components, mechanisms, and clinical risk.
summary: Electronic cigarettes (e-cigarettes) have become one of the most urgent public health issues of the twenty-first century. Originally marketed as less harmful than burning cigarettes, e-cigarettes have gained enormous popularity, especially among young adults, thus leading to nicotine addiction and new trends of cardiovascular damage. Even though e-cigarettes limit exposure to products of combustion, they supply similar doses of nicotine and other elements such as aldehydes, metals, and flavoring by-products, whose cardiovascular effects are incompletely characterized. This narrative review addresses a comprehensive analysis of the cardiovascular effects of e-cigarettes, particularly the contribution to the development of arrhythmias and cardiomyopathy. Evidence was synthesized from in vitro, animal models, and clinical research that covers e-cigarette constituents, delivery mechanisms of toxins, and both acute and chronic cardiovascular effects. E-liquid constituents can result in an autonomic imbalance, increasing heart rate and pressure, conductivity, and the predisposition of arrhythmias and cardiomyopathies. Recent research has shown oxidative stress, endothelial dysfunction, and autonomic imbalance instigated by nicotine and non-nicotinic additives, which destabilize cardiac electrophysiology. However, most human data remain short-term, with limited sample sizes and heterogeneous exposure assessment, underscoring the lack of longitudinal evidence on long-term outcomes such as myocardial infarction, heart failure, or sudden cardiac death. The clinical and public health implications are significant, and it is imperative to shift the focus to vaping as a separate cardiovascular risk factor, particularly among young adults. To reduce the increasing burden of e-cigarette-related cardiovascular disease, preventive actions and enhanced monitoring must be prioritized. They become cardiovascular toxic through nicotine and other chemical exposures, and there is growing evidence of arrhythmogenic and cardiomyopathic effects. Strong prospective studies are urgently needed to define dose-response relationships, long-term outcomes, and cessation strategies.

AI.tldr: 电子烟通过尼古丁和非尼古丁成分导致自主神经失衡、氧化应激和内皮功能障碍，增加心律失常和心肌病风险，但长期结局证据不足。
AI.motivation: 电子烟被营销为比传统香烟危害小，但在年轻人群中广泛使用，导致尼古丁成瘾和心血管损害。其心血管效应尚未完全明确，尤其是对心律失常和心肌病的影响，且缺乏长期结局的纵向证据。
AI.method: 叙述性综述，综合体外、动物模型和临床研究证据，分析电子烟成分、毒素递送机制以及急性和慢性心血管效应。摘要未报告系统检索策略、样本量或统计方法。
AI.result: 电子烟液体成分可导致自主神经失衡，增加心率和血压，影响传导性，并增加心律失常和心肌病易感性。尼古丁和非尼古丁添加剂引起氧化应激、内皮功能障碍和自主神经失衡，破坏心脏电生理稳定性。但多数人类数据为短期、样本量小、暴露评估异质，缺乏对心肌梗死、心力衰竭或心源性猝死等长期结局的纵向证据。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 电子烟通过尼古丁和其他化学暴露产生心血管毒性，日益证据显示其致心律失常和致心肌病效应。临床和公共卫生意义重大，应将电子烟视为独立心血管危险因素，尤其在年轻成人中。需优先采取预防措施和加强监测，并迫切需要进行前瞻性研究以明确剂量-反应关系、长期结局和戒烟策略。

summary_zh: 电子烟（e-cigarettes）已成为二十一世纪最紧迫的公共卫生问题之一。电子烟最初被宣传为比燃烧型香烟危害更小，但已获得极大流行，尤其是在年轻成人中，从而导致尼古丁成瘾和心血管损害的新趋势。尽管电子烟限制了燃烧产物的暴露，但它们提供相似剂量的尼古丁和其他成分，如醛类、金属和调味副产物，这些成分对心血管的影响尚未完全明确。本叙述性综述对电子烟的心血管影响进行了全面分析，特别是对心律失常和心肌病发展的作用。证据综合自体外、动物模型和临床研究，涵盖电子烟成分、毒素递送机制以及急性和慢性心血管效应。电子烟液成分可导致自主神经失衡，增加心率和血压、传导性，以及心律失常和心肌病的易感性。近期研究表明，尼古丁和非尼古丁添加剂引发的氧化应激、内皮功能障碍和自主神经失衡会破坏心脏电生理的稳定性。然而，大多数人体数据仍为短期、样本量有限且暴露评估异质性大，凸显了缺乏关于心肌梗死、心力衰竭或心源性猝死等长期结局的纵向证据。临床和公共卫生意义重大，必须将电子烟视为独立的心血管危险因素，尤其是在年轻成人中。为减轻电子烟相关心血管疾病日益增加的负担，必须优先采取预防措施和加强监测。它们通过尼古丁和其他化学暴露产生心血管毒性，并且越来越多的证据表明其具有致心律失常和致心肌病效应。迫切需要强有力的前瞻性研究来确定剂量-反应关系、长期结局和戒烟策略。

title: Systematic Review on the Safety of Physical Exercise in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy: Recommendations from the Brazilian Society of Cardiology.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Although historically discouraged due to the risk of arrhythmias and sudden cardiac death (SCD), physical exercise (PE) may be safe and beneficial for individuals with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM).

OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the association between PE and the incidence of mortality and arrhythmic events in adults with HCM, stratifying the analysis according to different types and intensities of exercise.

METHODS: Systematic review of randomized clinical trials (RCTs) and observational studies identified in PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Library through December 2024. Studies including individuals exposed to different intensities of PE were eligible. Risk of bias was assessed using the RoB 2 and ROBINS-I tools, and certainty of evidence using GRADE. Recommendations were developed by an expert panel of the Brazilian Society of Cardiology.

RESULTS: Eight studies (four RCTs and four observational studies; 9,744 participants) were included. None reported an increased risk of mortality or severe arrhythmic events associated with PE, even at moderate or vigorous intensities. Syncope was rare. Additionally, a Korean observational study involving more than 7,000 participants (mean age: 59 years) demonstrated reduced all-cause mortality with higher physical activity intensity (dose-response curve). In low-risk athletes, competitive sports were not associated with severe adverse events. The quality of evidence ranged from moderate to very low.

CONCLUSION: PE in HCM should be encouraged based on individualized assessment. In patients without high-risk criteria for SCD, benefits appear to outweigh risks. For higher-risk subgroups, recommendations are more cautious and based on expert consensus.

AI.tldr: 系统综述显示肥厚型心肌病患者进行体育锻炼未增加死亡或严重心律失常事件风险，中高强度运动亦安全，但证据质量中至极低。
AI.motivation: 肥厚型心肌病（HCM）患者因心律失常和心源性猝死（SCD）风险，历史上被建议避免体育锻炼（PE），但近期证据提示PE可能安全且有益，需系统评估PE与死亡及心律失常事件的关系，并按运动类型和强度分层，以指导临床推荐。
AI.method: 系统综述纳入截至2024年12月PubMed、Embase和Cochrane Library的随机临床试验（RCT）和观察性研究，对象为暴露于不同强度PE的HCM成人。使用RoB 2和ROBINS-I评估偏倚风险，GRADE评估证据确定性，由巴西心脏病学会专家小组制定推荐。
AI.result: 共纳入8项研究（4项RCT，4项观察性研究；9,744例参与者）。无研究报道PE增加死亡或严重心律失常事件风险，即使中等或剧烈强度；晕厥罕见。一项韩国观察性研究（>7,000例，平均年龄59岁）显示更高体力活动强度与全因死亡率降低相关（剂量反应曲线）。低风险运动员中竞技运动未与严重不良事件相关。证据质量中至极低。
AI.conclusion: 基于个体化评估，HCM患者应鼓励PE；无SCD高危标准者获益大于风险，高危亚组推荐更谨慎且基于专家共识。临床实践应个体化评估后鼓励运动，但需注意证据质量有限。

summary_zh:
背景：尽管历史上因心律失常和心源性猝死（SCD）风险而不鼓励运动，但体育锻炼（PE）对肥厚型心肌病（HCM）患者可能安全且有益。

目的：评估PE与HCM成人患者死亡率和心律失常事件发生率之间的关联，并根据不同的运动类型和强度对分析进行分层。

方法：对截至2024年12月在PubMed、Embase和Cochrane Library中检索到的随机临床试验（RCT）和观察性研究进行系统评价。纳入暴露于不同强度PE的个体的研究。使用RoB 2和ROBINS-I工具评估偏倚风险，并使用GRADE评估证据确定性。建议由巴西心脏病学会的专家小组制定。

结果：共纳入8项研究（4项RCT和4项观察性研究；9,744名参与者）。没有研究报告PE与死亡率或严重心律失常事件风险增加相关，即使在中度或剧烈强度下也是如此。晕厥罕见。此外，一项涉及7,000多名参与者（平均年龄：59岁）的韩国观察性研究表明，较高的体力活动强度可降低全因死亡率（剂量反应曲线）。在低风险运动员中，竞技运动与严重不良事件无关。证据质量从中等到极低不等。

结论：基于个体化评估，应鼓励HCM患者进行PE。对于没有SCD高风险标准的患者，获益似乎大于风险。对于较高风险亚组，建议更为谨慎，并基于专家共识。

title: Weighted gene co-expression network reveals CCND1 as a promising biomarker and therapeutic target for myocardial fibrosis in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
summary: Background Myocardial fibrosis represents a critical prognostic indicator of poor outcomes in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM), frequently predisposing patients to lethal ventricular arrhythmias and progressive heart failure. However, the upstream molecular mechanisms driving cardiac fibrogenesis in HCM remain largely unresolved. This study aimed to identify key fibrotic pathways and regulatory genes in HCM patients using weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA).Methods and results We quantified the severity of myocardial fibrosis using late gadolinium enhancement (LGE) on cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging and integrated these imaging data with transcriptomic co-expression networks to identify key modules associated with HCM-related fibrosis. WGCNA identified four fibrosis-associated modules containing 251 candidate genes (defined by gene significance > 0.5 and module membership > 0.8). Functional enrichment analysis revealed that activation of the TGF-β1 pathway and cell proliferation-related pathways significantly contributes to HCM fibrogenesis. We subsequently identified 323 differentially expressed genes (DEGs; 103 up-regulated and 220 down-regulated) between HCM patients with LGE and healthy controls. Integrating WGCNA candidate genes with the DEGs yielded 9 overlapping genes. Spearman correlation and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analyses demonstrated that the expression levels of MYH11, C10orf71, CCND1, JMJD4, and SNAP47 positively correlated with the extent of myocardial fibrosis (LGE%). Following validation in a transverse aortic constriction (TAC) mouse model, elevated CCND1 expression in cardiac fibroblasts emerged as a prominent feature of HCM-related fibrosis. In vitro assays in neonatal rat cardiac fibroblasts confirmed that CCND1 expression increases upon TGF-β1 stimulation. Notably, treatment with methotrexate (MTX), a CCND1 inhibitor, significantly reduced CCND1 expression and suppressed fibroblast activation following TGF-β1 stimulation.Conclusions To our knowledge, this is the first study to integrate CMR imaging with WGCNA to identify key pathways and hub genes associated with myocardial fibrosis in HCM patients. Our findings suggest that TGF-β1 and cell proliferation-related pathways contribute to fibrogenesis in HCM. We identify the cell-cycle-related gene CCND1 as a potential fibrotic marker in HCM, and our preliminary preclinical data suggest that its inhibitor, MTX, may warrant further investigation as a candidate therapeutic agent targeting myocardial fibrosis.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过整合CMR影像与转录组数据，发现CCND1是肥厚型心肌病心肌纤维化的潜在生物标志物，其抑制剂甲氨蝶呤可抑制成纤维细胞活化。
AI.motivation: 心肌纤维化是肥厚型心肌病（HCM）不良预后的关键指标，易导致室性心律失常和心力衰竭，但其上游分子机制尚不明确，缺乏有效治疗靶点。
AI.method: 研究采用加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA），结合心脏磁共振延迟钆增强（LGE）评估的纤维化程度与转录组数据，识别与HCM纤维化相关的模块和关键基因。样本量摘要未报告。通过差异表达分析、Spearman相关和ROC曲线筛选候选基因，并在横向主动脉缩窄（TAC）小鼠模型和新生大鼠心脏成纤维细胞中验证。
AI.result: WGCNA识别出4个纤维化相关模块，含251个候选基因；功能富集显示TGF-β1通路和细胞增殖通路激活。差异表达分析发现323个DEGs（103上调，220下调），与WGCNA候选基因取交集得到9个重叠基因。MYH11、C10orf71、CCND1、JMJD4和SNAP47表达与LGE%正相关。TAC小鼠中CCND1在心脏成纤维细胞中表达升高，体外实验证实TGF-β1刺激增加CCND1表达，甲氨蝶呤（MTX）可降低CCND1表达并抑制成纤维细胞活化。
AI.conclusion: 本研究首次整合CMR与WGCNA识别HCM纤维化关键通路，提示TGF-β1和细胞增殖通路参与纤维化，CCND1作为潜在纤维化标志物，其抑制剂MTX可能成为靶向心肌纤维化的候选治疗药物，但需进一步临床前和临床研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：心肌纤维化是肥厚型心肌病（HCM）不良预后的关键预后指标，常使患者易发生致命性室性心律失常和进行性心力衰竭。然而，驱动HCM中心脏纤维化的上游分子机制在很大程度上仍未明确。本研究旨在利用加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）识别HCM患者中关键的纤维化通路和调控基因。

方法与结果：我们通过心脏磁共振（CMR）成像上的晚期钆增强（LGE）量化心肌纤维化的严重程度，并将这些影像数据与转录组共表达网络整合，以识别与HCM相关纤维化相关的关键模块。WGCNA识别出四个纤维化相关模块，包含251个候选基因（定义为基因显著性 > 0.5且模块成员度 > 0.8）。功能富集分析显示，TGF-β1通路和细胞增殖相关通路的激活显著促进HCM纤维化发生。我们随后在伴有LGE的HCM患者与健康对照之间识别出323个差异表达基因（DEGs；103个上调，220个下调）。将WGCNA候选基因与DEGs整合，得到9个重叠基因。Spearman相关和受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线分析表明，MYH11、C10orf71、CCND1、JMJD4和SNAP47的表达水平与心肌纤维化程度（LGE%）呈正相关。在横向主动脉缩窄（TAC）小鼠模型中进行验证后，心脏成纤维细胞中CCND1表达升高成为HCM相关纤维化的突出特征。新生大鼠心脏成纤维细胞的体外实验证实，CCND1表达在TGF-β1刺激后增加。值得注意的是，使用CCND1抑制剂甲氨蝶呤（MTX）治疗可显著降低CCND1表达，并抑制TGF-β1刺激后的成纤维细胞活化。

结论：据我们所知，这是首个将CMR成像与WGCNA整合以识别HCM患者心肌纤维化相关关键通路和枢纽基因的研究。我们的发现提示TGF-β1和细胞增殖相关通路促进HCM中的纤维化发生。我们确定细胞周期相关基因CCND1作为HCM中潜在的纤维化标志物，并且我们的初步临床前数据提示其抑制剂MTX可能值得进一步研究作为靶向心肌纤维化的候选治疗药物。

title: Ticagrelor-Induced Bradyarrhythmias in Acute Coronary Syndrome: A Case Series of Three Patients
summary: Ticagrelor is a reversible oral P2Y12 receptor inhibitor recommended in preference to clopidogrel for most patients with acute coronary syndrome.In addition to inhibiting platelets, it raises extracellular adenosine, which is thought to explain its underappreciated capacity to cause bradyarrhythmia.We report three consecutive patients with acute coronary syndrome who developed serious bradyarrhythmias after ticagrelor administration.The first, a 58-year-old woman treated with a drug-eluting stent to the left anterior descending artery, developed high-grade atrioventricular block with asystolic pauses that required a temporary pacing wire, after which ticagrelor was stopped, prasugrel was substituted, and she recovered.The second, a 48-year-old woman with an anterior myocardial infarction, had a cardiac arrest with complete heart block after ticagrelor loading, was resuscitated, paced temporarily, switched to prasugrel, and recovered.The third, a 77-year-old man with an inferoposterior and right ventricular myocardial infarction, had recurrent asystole and ventricular arrhythmia that persisted despite switching to prasugrel and required a permanent pacemaker.None of the patients were receiving an atrioventricular nodal blocking drug, and in every patient the treated coronary lesion was patent on a repeat angiogram, which made ongoing ischemia from stent failure an unlikely sole explanation.A formal Naranjo assessment rated the association as possible in each case.A ticagrelor-induced adverse effect should be considered in any patient who develops unexplained bradycardia or syncope after its administration.Early rhythm monitoring and prompt withdrawal are the key steps, and although the rhythm usually recovers, permanent pacing may be needed when conduction disease is superimposed on ischemic injury to the conduction system.

AI.tldr: 替格瑞洛用于急性冠脉综合征后可能诱发严重缓慢性心律失常，三例患者中两例停药换用普拉格雷后恢复，一例需永久起搏。
AI.motivation: 替格瑞洛是急性冠脉综合征（ACS）的首选P2Y12抑制剂，除抗血小板外还可升高细胞外腺苷，被认为可能引起缓慢性心律失常，但临床认识不足。既往缺乏系统报道，本研究通过病例系列提示这一潜在不良反应，以填补临床警觉缺口。
AI.method: 单中心病例系列，连续纳入3例接受替格瑞洛治疗的ACS患者，描述其缓慢性心律失常的发生、处理及转归。未设对照，未报告样本量计算或统计检验。终点为缓慢性心律失常事件（高度房室传导阻滞、心脏停搏、室性心律失常）及恢复情况。采用Naranjo量表评估药物不良反应因果关系。
AI.result: 3例患者均在替格瑞洛给药后出现严重缓慢性心律失常：例1（58岁女性，LAD药物洗脱支架）出现高度房室传导阻滞伴心脏停搏，需临时起搏，停用替格瑞洛换用普拉格雷后恢复；例2（48岁女性，前壁心梗）替格瑞洛负荷后发生心脏骤停伴完全性房室传导阻滞，复苏后临时起搏并换用普拉格雷后恢复；例3（77岁男性，下后壁及右室心梗）反复心脏停搏和室性心律失常，换用普拉格雷后仍持续，需永久起搏。所有患者均未使用房室结阻滞药物，重复造影显示靶病变通畅，排除支架失败所致缺血。Naranjo评估均为“可能”相关。
AI.conclusion: 替格瑞洛相关缓慢性心律失常虽罕见但可致命，临床应警惕用药后不明原因心动过缓或晕厥。早期心律监测和及时停药是关键，多数心律可恢复，但若传导系统存在缺血损伤，可能需要永久起搏。本病例系列样本量小、因果关系仅为“可能”，需更大规模研究验证。

summary_zh: 替格瑞洛是一种可逆的口服P2Y12受体抑制剂，推荐优先于氯吡格雷用于大多数急性冠脉综合征患者。除抑制血小板外，它还可升高细胞外腺苷水平，这被认为可解释其未被充分认识到的致心动过缓作用。我们报告了三例连续入院的急性冠脉综合征患者，他们在接受替格瑞洛后出现了严重的心动过缓性心律失常。第一例为58岁女性，左前降支置入药物洗脱支架后，出现高度房室传导阻滞伴心脏停搏，需临时起搏导线，随后停用替格瑞洛，换用普拉格雷，患者恢复。第二例为48岁女性，前壁心肌梗死，在替格瑞洛负荷后发生心脏骤停伴完全性心脏传导阻滞，经复苏、临时起搏、换用普拉格雷后恢复。第三例为77岁男性，下后壁及右心室心肌梗死，出现反复心脏停搏和室性心律失常，尽管换用普拉格雷仍持续存在，需植入永久起搏器。所有患者均未使用房室结阻滞药物，且每例患者复查血管造影显示治疗的冠状动脉病变均通畅，这使得支架失败导致的持续缺血不太可能是唯一解释。正式的Naranjo评估将每例的关联性评定为可能。任何患者在接受替格瑞洛后出现不明原因的心动过缓或晕厥，都应考虑替格瑞洛引起的不良反应。早期心律监测和及时停药是关键步骤，尽管心律通常可恢复，但当传导系统疾病叠加于缺血性损伤时，可能需要永久起搏。

title: Longitudinal Changes in Wearable-Captured Physiology Before Sudden Cardiac Death.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Consumer wearables provide continual physiological data, including multiple cardiovascular metrics, yet their use in detecting physiological changes that precede cardiac events remains limited.

CASE SUMMARY: A 76-year-old man with structural heart disease experienced sudden cardiac death minutes after high-intensity indoor cycling. Change-point analysis of wearable-captured physiology revealed a coordinated step-change, with most changes clustering 4-6 months before the sudden cardiac death: heart rate variability halved, resting and nocturnal heart rate rose, deep sleep and 6-minute walk distance fell. These coincided with a fatigue complaint and a murmur prompting echocardiography, which revealed severe left ventricular dilation with preserved ejection fraction (approximately 60%), severe mitral regurgitation, moderate aortic regurgitation, and trace tricuspid regurgitation, consistent with advanced structural heart disease.

DISCUSSION: The key signal was not any single abnormal value but a coordinated, sustained step-change from the patient's own baseline that preceded imaging. Data of this kind could complement the episodic measurements cardiovascular care now relies on, informing both when to re-evaluate patients with known heart disease and how wearable heart-rate kinetics might guide their exercise.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGE: Embedding continuous digital physiology monitoring into traditional cardiology has the potential to aid clinicians in timely evaluation and intervention.

AI.tldr: 一例76岁结构性心脏病患者在心源性猝死前4-6个月，可穿戴设备捕捉到心率变异性减半、静息及夜间心率升高、深睡眠和6分钟步行距离下降的协同性阶跃变化。
AI.motivation: 消费级可穿戴设备可连续提供多项心血管生理指标，但其在识别心脏事件前生理变化方面的价值尚不明确，既往证据多基于间断测量，缺乏对猝死前纵向生理轨迹的细致刻画。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。对象为76岁男性结构性心脏病患者，在室内高强度骑行后数分钟发生心源性猝死。对可穿戴设备连续采集的生理数据进行变化点分析，观察心率变异性、静息及夜间心率、深睡眠时长、6分钟步行距离等指标的纵向轨迹，并与临床事件及超声心动图结果进行时间关联。摘要未报告样本量以外的统计方法及终点定义细节。
AI.result: 变化点分析显示多数生理指标在猝死前4-6个月出现协同性阶跃变化：心率变异性减半，静息及夜间心率升高，深睡眠时长和6分钟步行距离下降。同期患者主诉疲劳并发现心脏杂音，超声心动图显示左心室严重扩张、LVEF约60%、重度二尖瓣反流、中度主动脉瓣反流及微量三尖瓣反流，符合晚期结构性心脏病。摘要未报告效应量、95%置信区间及P值。
AI.conclusion: 关键信号并非某一单项异常值，而是患者相对于自身基线的协同、持续性阶跃变化，且早于影像学发现。连续数字生理监测有望补充当前依赖间断测量的心血管诊疗模式，帮助判断已知心脏病患者何时需要重新评估，并指导运动强度；但本例为单例报告，结论外推受限，需更大样本验证。

summary_zh:
背景：消费级可穿戴设备提供持续不断的生理数据，包括多项心血管指标，但其在检测心脏事件前生理变化方面的应用仍然有限。

病例摘要：一名76岁男性，患有结构性心脏病，在室内高强度骑行几分钟后发生心脏性猝死。对可穿戴设备捕获的生理数据进行变点分析，揭示了一个协调的阶跃变化，大多数变化集中在心脏性猝死前4-6个月：心率变异性减半，静息和夜间心率升高，深睡眠和6分钟步行距离下降。这些变化与患者主诉疲劳和发现心脏杂音同时出现，促使进行超声心动图检查，结果显示重度左心室扩张伴射血分数保留（约60%）、重度二尖瓣反流、中度主动脉瓣反流和微量三尖瓣反流，符合晚期结构性心脏病。

讨论：关键信号不是任何单一的异常值，而是先于影像学检查出现的、相对于患者自身基线的协调、持续的阶跃变化。这类数据可以补充心血管护理目前依赖的间歇性测量，为已知心脏病患者何时重新评估以及可穿戴设备心率动力学如何指导其运动提供信息。

要点：将连续数字生理监测嵌入传统心脏病学，有可能帮助临床医生及时进行评估和干预。

title: Early Versus Delayed Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillator Implantation After Sustained Ventricular Arrhythmia in Suspected Myocarditis: A Systematic Review with Narrative Synthesis and a Resource-Adapted Decision Framework
summary: This OSF registration documents a completed systematic review with narrative synthesis examining the clinical question of early versus delayed permanent implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) implantation after sustained ventricular tachycardia (VT) or ventricular fibrillation (VF) in patients with suspected myocarditis. The review addresses an important area of clinical uncertainty because ventricular arrhythmias occurring during acute myocarditis may resolve as myocardial inflammation improves, while some patients may retain a persistent arrhythmogenic substrate and remain at risk of recurrent malignant ventricular arrhythmias or sudden cardiac death. The review therefore focuses on determining which clinical, imaging, arrhythmic, and health-system factors may support early ICD implantation and under what circumstances protected deferral with reassessment may be appropriate. The population of interest includes adolescents and adults with suspected, clinically diagnosed, cardiac magnetic resonance-supported, or biopsy-confirmed myocarditis or inflammatory cardiomyopathy who experienced sustained VT, VF, aborted sudden cardiac death, or a closely related major ventricular-arrhythmic presentation. Outcomes of interest include recurrent VT/VF, appropriate ICD or wearable cardioverter-defibrillator therapy, sudden cardiac death, mortality, ventricular functional recovery, and prognostic features relevant to the timing of permanent ICD implantation. Eligible evidence includes clinical practice guidelines, consensus documents, observational cohorts, registries, and systematic reviews or meta-analyses. The review was conducted and reported in accordance with PRISMA 2020. The auditable search included MEDLINE/PubMed, relevant guideline repositories of the European Society of Cardiology, American Heart Association/American College of Cardiology, and Heart Rhythm Society, together with backward and forward citation searching. Searches covered the period from database inception to 21 August 2026. Search strategies were also developed for Embase, Scopus, Web of Science Core Collection, and CENTRAL. Study selection involved title and abstract screening followed by full-text assessment. Data extracted included study design, myocarditis definition and subtype, arrhythmia phenotype, sample size, left ventricular ejection fraction, cardiac magnetic resonance and late gadolinium enhancement findings, ICD or wearable cardioverter-defibrillator use, follow-up duration, recurrent ventricular arrhythmias, appropriate device therapy, mortality, and factors relevant to device timing. Risk of bias was assessed using design-specific tools, including ROBINS-I for non-randomized studies, AMSTAR 2 for systematic reviews and meta-analyses, AGREE II for clinical practice guidelines, and the JBI checklist for expert consensus documents. Because no eligible study directly compared early permanent ICD implantation with delayed implantation with adequate adjustment for confounding, a meta-analysis was not considered appropriate. Instead, the evidence was organized into a structured narrative synthesis covering four major domains: risk of recurrent ventricular arrhythmia, prognostic markers, temporary bridging strategies, and health-system/resource capacity. These domains were used to develop a resource-adapted, hypothesis-generating clinical decision framework rather than a validated prediction model. The principal intended outcomes of the project are to clarify the strength and limitations of the evidence regarding ICD timing after myocarditis-related sustained ventricular arrhythmia; identify clinical characteristics that may support earlier ICD consideration; describe circumstances in which monitored deferral and reassessment may be reasonable; evaluate the potential role of wearable cardioverter-defibrillators and other temporary protection strategies; and examine how access to cardiac magnetic resonance imaging, rhythm monitoring, emergency services, follow-up, implantation expertise, and long-term device support may influence management decisions. The resulting framework is intended to support multidisciplinary, individualized decision-making rather than replace guideline recommendations or specialist clinical judgment. As this registration was created after completion of the review, it should be regarded as a retrospective OSF registration rather than a prospective protocol registration. The manuscript itself states that the review was not prospectively registered and that an internal protocol specified the population, timing strategies, outcomes, evidence domains, and resource-adaptation variables before full-text synthesis.

AI.tldr: 在疑似心肌炎合并持续性室性心律失常患者中，缺乏直接比较早期与延迟ICD植入的研究，现有证据仅支持基于复发风险、预后标志、临时桥接策略和资源条件的个体化决策框架。
AI.motivation: 急性心肌炎相关的持续性室速/室颤可能随炎症消退而缓解，但部分患者存在持续致心律失常基质，面临复发恶性室性心律失常或心源性猝死风险。目前早期与延迟永久ICD植入的时机选择缺乏高质量证据，临床决策存在不确定性。
AI.method: 系统综述，遵循PRISMA 2020，检索MEDLINE/PubMed、ESC/AHA/ACC/HRS指南库及Embase、Scopus、Web of Science、CENTRAL等，截至2026年8月21日。纳入指南、共识、观察性队列、注册研究和系统综述/Meta分析，人群为疑似、临床诊断、CMR支持或活检确诊心肌炎/炎症性心肌病且发生持续性VT、VF、心脏骤停生还或相关室性心律失常的青少年及成人。因无研究直接比较早期与延迟植入且充分校正混杂，未行Meta分析，采用叙述性综合，按复发风险、预后标志、临时桥接策略、卫生系统/资源能力四个域组织证据，并构建资源适配的假设性决策框架。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体样本量、效应量、95%CI或P值。证据综合显示：无符合条件的研究直接比较早期与延迟永久ICD植入；证据主要来自观察性队列、注册研究和指南/共识。框架识别了可能支持早期ICD考虑的临床、影像、心律失常及卫生系统因素，以及监测下延迟并再评估的适用情形，并评估了可穿戴心律转复除颤器和其他临时保护策略的潜在作用。
AI.conclusion: 现有证据不足以确定心肌炎相关持续性室性心律失常后ICD植入的最佳时机，临床应采用多学科、个体化决策，结合复发风险、预后标志、临时保护策略及资源可及性。该框架为假设生成性，不能替代指南推荐或专科临床判断；主要局限性为缺乏直接比较证据、无法Meta分析及回顾性注册。

summary_zh: 本OSF注册文件记录了一项已完成的系统综述及叙述性综合，探讨的临床问题是：对于疑似心肌炎患者，在发生持续性室性心动过速（VT）或心室颤动（VF）后，早期与延迟植入永久性植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）的比较。该综述涉及一个重要的临床不确定性领域，因为急性心肌炎期间发生的室性心律失常可能随着心肌炎症改善而消退，而部分患者可能遗留持续存在的致心律失常基质，并仍面临复发性恶性室性心律失常或心源性猝死的风险。因此，本综述侧重于确定哪些临床、影像学、心律失常及卫生系统因素可能支持早期植入ICD，以及在何种情况下采取保护性延迟并重新评估可能是合适的。感兴趣的人群包括疑似、临床诊断、心脏磁共振支持或活检确诊的心肌炎或炎症性心肌病，且经历过持续性VT、VF、心脏骤停复苏成功或密切相关的主要室性心律失常表现的青少年和成人。感兴趣的结果包括复发性VT/VF、适当的ICD或可穿戴式心律转复除颤器治疗、心源性猝死、死亡率、心室功能恢复以及与永久性ICD植入时机相关的预后特征。符合条件的证据包括临床实践指南、共识文件、观察性队列、注册研究以及系统综述或荟萃分析。本综述按照PRISMA 2020进行和报告。可审计的检索包括MEDLINE/PubMed、欧洲心脏病学会、美国心脏协会/美国心脏病学会和心律学会的相关指南库，以及前后向引文检索。检索覆盖从数据库建库至2026年8月21日的时段。还制定了针对Embase、Scopus、Web of Science核心合集和CENTRAL的检索策略。研究选择包括标题和摘要筛选，随后进行全文评估。提取的数据包括研究设计、心肌炎定义和亚型、心律失常表型、样本量、左心室射血分数、心脏磁共振和晚期钆增强发现、ICD或可穿戴式心律转复除颤器的使用、随访时间、复发性室性心律失常、适当的器械治疗、死亡率以及与器械时机相关的因素。使用针对设计类型的工具评估偏倚风险，包括非随机研究的ROBINS-I、系统综述和荟萃分析的AMSTAR 2、临床实践指南的AGREE II以及专家共识文件的JBI清单。由于没有符合条件的直接比较早期永久性ICD植入与延迟植入且对混杂因素进行充分调整的研究，因此认为荟萃分析不合适。取而代之的是，将证据组织为涵盖四个主要领域的结构化叙述性综合：复发性室性心律失常的风险、预后标志物、临时桥接策略以及卫生系统/资源能力。这些领域被用于开发一个资源适配的、产生假设的临床决策框架，而非经过验证的预测模型。该项目的主要预期成果是阐明关于心肌炎相关持续性室性心律失常后ICD时机的证据强度和局限性；识别可能支持更早考虑ICD的临床特征；描述监测下延迟和重新评估可能合理的情况；评估可穿戴式心律转复除颤器和其他临时保护策略的潜在作用；并检查心脏磁共振成像、心律监测、急救服务、随访、植入专业知识和长期器械支持的获取如何影响管理决策。由此产生的框架旨在支持多学科、个体化的决策，而非取代指南推荐或专科临床判断。由于本注册是在综述完成后创建的，应将其视为回顾性OSF注册而非前瞻性方案注册。手稿本身声明该综述未进行前瞻性注册，且内部方案在全文综合前已指定了人群、时机策略、结果、证据领域和资源适配变量。

title: 18 F-FDG PET/CT in Cardiac Sarcoidosis: Pioneering Evidence from the Arab Middle East.
summary:
OBJECTIVES: Cardiac sarcoidosis can lead to arrhythmias, heart failure, and sudden cardiac death. Positron emission tomography/computed tomography (PET/CT) is crucial for diagnosis and monitoring, yet data from the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region remain scarce. This study evaluated the role of PET/CT in diagnosing and managing cardiac sarcoidosis at a tertiary referral center in the Middle East.

MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective study included 19 patients with biopsy-proven sarcoidosis who underwent fluorine-18 fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) PET/CT for suspected cardiac involvement at a tertiary referral medical center in Lebanon between 2014 and 2024. Complementary imaging with echocardiography, cardiac magnetic resonance imaging, and electrocardiography was also analyzed alongside treatment approaches and follow-up outcomes.

RESULTS: FDG PET/CT identified cardiac involvement in 12 patients, with diffuse or focal FDG uptake patterns correlating with symptom severity and electrocardiographic abnormalities. These patients exhibited higher rates of arrhythmias, conduction abnormalities, and reduced global longitudinal strain and E/A ratio on echocardiography. Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated late gadolinium enhancement in most cases with FDG PET/CT-confirmed cardiac sarcoidosis, supporting the presence of myocardial inflammation. Treatment included corticosteroids, immunosuppressive agents, and device implantation in selected cases. Follow-up FDG PET/CT showed significant reductions in FDG uptake, indicating therapeutic response.

CONCLUSION: This study underscores the clinical utility of FDG PET/CT in diagnosing and managing cardiac sarcoidosis, particularly in resource-limited settings like the MENA region. FDG PET/CT enabled early detection, guided treatment decisions, and facilitated monitoring of therapeutic response. These findings highlight the need for broader access to FDG PET/CT imaging in the region to optimize patient outcomes.

AI.tldr: 在黎巴嫩三级中心19例活检证实的结节病患者中，FDG PET/CT检出12例心脏受累，并指导治疗与监测疗效。
AI.motivation: 心脏结节病可导致心律失常、心力衰竭和心源性猝死，FDG PET/CT对诊断和监测至关重要，但中东和北非地区数据匮乏，本研究旨在评估其在该地区的临床应用价值。
AI.method: 回顾性研究，纳入2014至2024年黎巴嫩某三级转诊中心19例活检证实的结节病并疑似心脏受累的患者，均行18F-FDG PET/CT，同时分析超声心动图、心脏磁共振和心电图，以及治疗方式和随访结局。
AI.result: FDG PET/CT检出12例心脏受累，弥漫或局灶性FDG摄取模式与症状严重程度和心电图异常相关；这些患者心律失常、传导异常发生率更高，整体纵向应变和E/A比值降低；心脏磁共振在多数FDG PET/CT确诊者中显示晚期钆增强；治疗包括糖皮质激素、免疫抑制剂和部分器械植入；随访FDG PET/CT显示FDG摄取显著减少。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间和P值。
AI.conclusion: FDG PET/CT有助于心脏结节病的早期检出、治疗决策和疗效监测，尤其在资源有限的中东地区；需扩大该影像技术的可及性以改善患者结局，但本研究为回顾性小样本，结论需更大规模研究验证。

summary_zh:
目的：心脏结节病可导致心律失常、心力衰竭和心源性猝死。正电子发射断层扫描/计算机断层扫描（PET/CT）对诊断和监测至关重要，然而来自中东和北非（MENA）地区的数据仍然匮乏。本研究评估了PET/CT在中东一家三级转诊中心诊断和管理心脏结节病中的作用。
